catuḥsaptatitamaṃ parva vidhikrameṇa pūrveṇa sādaro mudamuddvahan | āpṛcchata trikūṭeśo dayitāmityapi priyām ||1||
ko jānāti priye bhūgo darśanaṃ cārudarśane | mahāpratibhaye yuddhe kiṃ bhavenna bhavediti ||2|| ucustaṃ dayitā nātha nanda nanda ripūñjaya | dacayāmaḥ sarvathā bhūyaḥ saṃkhyatastvāṃ samāgatam ||3|| ityukto dayitānetrasahasrarabhivīkṣitaḥ | nirjagāma bahirnātho rattasāṃ vikaṭaprabhā ||4|| apaśyañca śaradbhānubhāsvaraṃ bahurūpayā| vidyayā kṛtanirmāṇamaindraṃ nāma mahāratham ||5|| yuktaṃ dantisahasraṇa prāvṛṣeṇyaghanatviṣā | prabhāparikara meruṃ jigīṣantamiva sthitam ||6|| mattāste kariṇo gaṇḍapragalahānanirbharāḥ | sitapītacaturdaṣṭrāḥ śaṅkhacāmaraśobhinaḥ ||7|| muktādāmasamākīrṇā mahāghaṇṭānināditāḥ | airāvatasamā nānādhāturāgavibhūṣitāḥ ||8|| durdāntā vinayādhānabhūmayo dhanagarjitāḥ| virejuḥ kālameghaughasannibhāścāruvibhramāḥ || manoharābhakeyūra vidaṣṭabhujamastakaḥ | tamasau rathamārūḍhaḥ śunāsorasamadyutiḥ ||10|| viśālanayanastatra sthito nirupamākṛtiḥ | ojasā sakalaṃ lokamagrasiṣṭeva rāvaṇaḥ ||11|| sahastrairdaśabhiḥ svasya sadṛśaiḥ khecarādhipaḥ | viyadvallabhanāthāyaiḥ svahitaiḥ kṛtamaṇḍalaḥ ||12|| mahābalaḥ suracchāyairabhiprāyānuvedibhiḥ | kruddhaḥ sugrīvavaidehī pratyabhīyāya rāvaṇaḥ ||13||
athānantara pūrvakṛta puṇyodayase harṣako dhāraṇa karatā huā rāvaṇa ādarake sātha apanī priya strī mandodarīse isa prakāra pūchatā hai ki he priye ! cārudarśane ! mahā bhayakārī yuddha honā hai ataḥ kauna jāne phira tumhārā darśana ho yā na ho ||1-2|| yaha suna saba striyoṃne kahā ki he nātha | sadā vṛddhiko prāpta hoo, śatruoṃko jīto| tumheṃ hama saba śīghra hī yuddhase lauṭā huā dekheṃgī ||3|| aisā kahakara jise hajāroṃ striyā~ apane netroṃse dekha rahī thīṃ tathā jisakī prabhā atyanta viśāla thī aisā rākṣasoṃkā rājā rāvaṇa nagarake bāhara nikalā ||4|| bāhara nikalate hī usane bahurūpiṇī vidyāke dvārā nirmita tathā śarad ṛtuke sūryake samāna dedīpyamāna aindra nāmakā mahāratha dekhā ||5|| vaha mahāratha varṣākālīna meghoṃke samāna kāntivāle eka hajāra hāthiyoṃse jutā thā, kāntike maṇḍalase sahita thā, aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno meru parvatako hī jītanā cāhatā ho ||6|| usameṃ jute hue hāthī madonmatta the, inake gaṇḍasthaloṃse jharane bhara rahe the, unake sapheda pīle raṃgake cāra cāra khaḍa़e dā~ta the, ve śaṅkhoṃ tathā camaroṃse suśobhita the, motiyoṃ kī mālāoṃse yukta the, unake gale meṃ ba~dhe baḍa़e baḍa़e ghaṇṭā śabda kara rahe the, ve airāvata hāthīke samāna the, nānā dhātuoṃke raṃgase suśobhita the, unakā jītanā aśakya thā, ve vinayakī bhūmi the, meghoṃke samāna garjanāse yukta the, kṛṣṇa meghoṃke samūhake samāna the tathā sundara vibhramako dhāraṇa karate hue śobhāyamāna the ||7-6|| jisakī bhujāke agrabhāgapara manohara bājūbanda baṃdhā huā thā tathā jisakī kānti indrake samāna thī, aisā rāvaṇa usa vidyā nirmita rathapara ārūḍha huā ||10|| viśāla nayana tathā anupama ākṛtiko dhāraṇa karanevālā rāvaṇa usa rathapara ārūḍha huā apane tejase māno samasta lokako grasa hī rahā thā ||11|| jo apane samāna the, apanā hita karanevāle the, mahā balavāna the, devoṃke samāna kāntise yukta the aura abhiprāyako jānanevāle the aise gaganavallabhanagarake svāmīko ādi lekara daśa hajāra vidyādhara rājāoṃse ghirā rāvaṇa sugrīva aura

padmapurāṇe dṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇato'tyantabhīmaniḥsvānakāriṇaḥ | mallukā gagane gṛdhrā bhramanti chamabhāskarāḥ ||14|| jānanto'pi nimittāni kathayanti mahākṣayam | śauryamānotkaṭāḥ kruddhā yayureva mahānarāḥ ||15|| pamābho'pi svasainyasthaḥ paryapṛcchat savismayaḥ| bho bho madhyeyametasyā nagaryāstejasā jvalan ||16|| jāmbūnadamayaiḥ kūṭaḥ suviśālairalaṅkṛtaḥ | sataḍinmeghasaṃghātacchāyaḥ kināmako giriḥ ||17|| pṛcchate'smai suṣeṇācā sammohaṃ samupāgatāḥ | na śekuḥ sahasā vaktumapṛcchacca sa tānmuhuḥ ||18|| brūta kiṃ nāmadheyo'yaṃ giriratra nirīcyate | agadañjāmbavādyāstamatho vepathumandharāḥ ||16|| daśyate 'padmanābhāyaṃ ratho'yaṃ bahurūpayā| vidyayā kalpito'smākaṃ mṛtyusaṃjvarakovidaḥ ||20|| kiṣkindharājaputreṇa yo'sau gatvābhiroṣataḥ | rāvaṇo'vasthitaḥ so'tra mahāmāyāmayodayaḥ ||21|| śrutvā tadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ sārathiṃ jagau| rathaṃ samānaya kṣipramityuktaḥ sa tathā'karot ||22|| tataḥ kṣubdhārṇavasvānā bhīmā bheyaḥ samāhatāḥ | śaṅkhakoṭisvanonmiśrāḥ śeṣavāditrasaṅgatāḥ ||23|| śrutvā taṃ ninadaṃ hṛṣṭā bhaṭā vikaṭaceṣṭitāḥ | sannaddhā badbhutūṇīrā lacamaṇasyāntike sthitāḥ ||24|| mā bhaiṣīrdayite tiṣṭha nivartasva śucaṃ tyaja | ahaṃ lakeśvaraṃ jitvā pratyemyadya tavāntikam ||25|| iti garvotkaṭā vīrā samāśvāsya varāṅganāḥ | antaḥpurāta susamaddhā vinirjagmuryathāyatham ||26|| parasparapratispardhāvegacoditavāhanāḥ | rathādibhiyayuryodhāḥ śastrāvekṣaṇacañcalāḥ ||27||
rathaṃ mahebhasaṃyuktaṃ gambhīrodāranisvanam | bhūtasvanaḥ samārūḍho vireje khecarādhipaḥ ||28|| bhāmaṇḍalako dekha kupita hotā huā unake sanmukha gayā| rāvaṇakī dakṣiṇa diśāmeṃ bhālū atyanta bhayaṅkara śabda kara rahe the aura ākāśameṃ sūryako ācchādita karate hue gīdha ma~ḍarā rahe the ||12-- 14|| śūravīratāke ahaṃkārase bhare mahāsubhaṭa yadyapi yaha jānate the ki ye apaśakuna maraṇako sūcita kara rahe haiṃ tathāpi ve kupita ho āge baḍha़e jāte the ||15||
___ apanī senāke madhyameṃ sthita rāmane bhī āścarya cakita ho sainikoṃse pūchā ki he bhadra. puruṣo ! isa nagarīke bīca meṃ tejase dedīpyamāna, suvarṇamayī baḍa़e-baḍa़e śikharoṃse alaṃkṛta, tathā bijalīse sahita megha samūhake samāna kāntiko dhāraṇa karanevālā yaha kauna sā parvata hai ? ||1617|| supeṇa ādi vidyādhara svayaṃ bhrāntimeṃ paḍa़ gaye isalie ve pūchanevāle rāmake lie sahasā uttara deneke lie samartha nahīṃ ho sake | phira bhī rāma unase bāra bāra pūche jā rahe the ki kaho yaha yahā~ kauna sā parvata dikhāī de rahā hai? tadanantara bhayase kā~pate hue jāmbava ādine dhīme svarameṃ kahā ki he rāma ! yaha bahurūpiṇī vidyāke dvārā nirmita vaha ratha hai jo hama logoṃko kālajvara utpanna karane meṃ nipuṇa hai ||18-20|| sugrīvake putra agadane jākara jise kupita kiyā thā aisā vaha mahāmāyāmaya abhyudayako dhāraṇa karanevālā rāvaṇa isa para savāra hai ||21|| jāmbava ādike ukta vacana suna lakṣmaṇane sārathise kahā ki śīghra hī ratha lāo| sunate hī sārathine ājñā pālana kiyā arthāt ratha lākara upasthita kara diyā ||22|| tadanantara jinake śabda kṣubhita samudrake śabdake samāna the, jinake śabdoṃke sātha karoḍa़oṃ śaṅkhoṃke śabda mila rahe the aisī bhayaṃkara bheriyā~ bajāī gaī ||23|| usa śabdako sunakara vikaṭa ceṣṭāoṃke dhāraka yoddhā, kavaca pahina tathā tarakasa bā~dha lakṣmaṇake pāsa ā khaḍa़e hue ||24|| 'he priye ! ḍara mata, yahīṃ ṭhahara, lauṭa jā, śoka taja, maiṃ lakeśvarako jītakara āja hī tere samīpa vāpisa ā jāū~gā' isa prakāra garvīle vīra, apanī uttama striyoṃko sāntvanā de kavaca ādise taiyāra ho yathāyogya rītise bāhara nikale ||25-26|| jo parasparakī pratispardhā vaśa vegase apane vāhanoṃko prerita kara rahe the, tathā jo śastroṃkī ora dekha dekha kara cañcala ho rahe the aise yodhā ratha ādi vāhanoṃpara ārūḍha ho cale ||27|| mahāgaja
1. padmanāgo'yaṃ ma0| 2. mṛtyuḥ sa jvarakovidaḥ ma0| .

sodaraṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ | kṣurikāyāṃ karaṃ cakre svavadhāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 1 || vārayantī vadhaṃ tasya niśceṣṭīkṛtavigrahā | mūrcchā kālaṃ kiyantaṃ cicakāropakṛtiṃ parām ||2|| labdhasaṃjño jighāṃsuḥ svaṃ tāpaṃ duḥsahamuddahan | rāmeṇa vidhutaḥ kṛcchrāduttīrthaṃ nijato rathāt || 3|| tyaktāvakavaco bhūmyāṃ punarmūrddhāmupāgataḥ | pratibuddhaḥ punaścakre vilāpaṃ karuṇākaram ||4|| hā bhrātaḥ karuṇodāra śūra saṃśritavatsala | manohara kathaṃ prāpto'syavasthāmiti pāpikām ||5|| kiṃ tanmadvacanaṃ nātha gadyamānaṃ hitaṃ param | na mānitaṃ yato yuddhe vīkṣe tvāṃ cakratāḍitam || 6 || kaṣṭaṃ bhūmitale deva vidyādharamaheśvara | kathaṃ supto'si laṅkeśa bhogadurlalitātmakaḥ ||7|| uttiṣṭha dehi me vākyaṃ cāruvākya guṇākara | sādhāraya kṛpādhāra magnaṃ māṃ śokasāgare || 8 || etasminnantare jñātadaśānana nipātanam | kṣubdhamantaḥpuraṃ śokamahākallolasaṅkulam ||6|| sarvāśca vanitā vāṣpadhārāsikkamahītalāḥ | raṇakṣoṇīṃ samājagmurmuhuḥ praskhalitakramāḥ || 10 || taṃ cūḍāmaṇisaṅkāśaṃ citerālokya sundaram | niścetanaṃ patiṃ nāryo nipeturativegataḥ ||11|| rambhā candrānanā candramaṇḍalā pravarovaṃśī | mandodarī mahādevī sundarī kamalānanā ||12|| rūpiṇī rukmiṇī śīlā ratnamālā tanūdarī | śrīkāntā śrīmatī bhadrā kanakābhā mṛgāvatī ||13|| śrīmālā mānavī lakṣmīrānandānaṅgasundarī | vasundharā taḍinmālā padmā padmāvatī sukhā || 14 ||
athānantara bhāīko paḍa़ā dekha mahāduḥkhase yukta vibhīṣaṇane apanā vadha karaneke lie churīpara hātha rakhā ||1|| so usake isa vadhako rokatī tathā śarīrako niśśreṣṭa karatī mūrcchāne kucha kāla taka usakā baḍa़ā upakāra kiyā ||2|| jaba saceta huā taba punaḥ ātmaghātakī icchā karane lagā so rāma ne apane ratha se utara kara use baḍa़ī kaṭhināī se pakaḍa़ kara rakkhā ||3|| jisane aba aura kavaca choḍa़ diye the aisā vibhīṣaṇa punaḥ mūrcchita ho pṛthivī para paḍa़ā rahā | tatpaścāt jaba punaḥ saceta huā taba karuṇā utpanna karane vālā vilāpa karane lagā ||4|| vaha kaha rahā thā ki he bhāī ! he udāra karuṇāke dhārī | he śūra vīra ! he āśritajanavatsala ! he manohara ! tuma isa pāpa pūrṇa daśāko kaise prāpta ho gaye ? ||5|| he nātha | kyā usa samaya tumane mere kahe hue hitakārī vacana nahīṃ māne isīlie yuddha meṃ tumheṃ cakra se tāḍa़ita dekha rahā hū~ || 6 || he deva ! he vidyādharoṃ ke adhipati ! he laṃkā svāmī ! tuma to bhogoṃ se lālita hue the phira āja pṛthivītala para kyoṃ so rahe hī ? ||7|| he sundara vacana bolane vāle ! he guṇoṃke khāni ! uṭho mujhe bacana deo mujhase vārtālāpa karo | he kṛpāke ādhāra ! śoka rūpī sāgara meṃ ḍūbe hue mujhe sāntvanā deo ||8||
tadanantara isī bīca meṃ jise rāvaṇake giranekā samācāra vidita ho gayā thā aisā antaḥpara śokakī baḍa़ī baḍa़ī laharoṃse vyāpta hotā huā cubhita ho uṭhā ||6|| jinhoṃne aśrudhārā se pṛthivī talako sīṃcā thā tathā jinake paira bārabāra laḍa़khaḍa़ā rahe the aisī samasta striyāṃ raṇabhūmi
āī ||10|| aura pṛthivīke cūḍāmaṇike samāna sundara patiko niścetana dekha atyanta vega se bhūmipara gira paḍa़īṃ || 11 || rambhā, candrānanā, candramaṇḍalā, pravarā, urvaśī, mandodarī, mahādevī, sundarī, kamalānanā, rūpiṇī, rukmiṇī, śīlā, ratnamālā, tanūdarī, śrīkāntā, śrīmatī, bhadrā, kanakābhā, mṛgāvatī, śrīmālā, mānavī, lakṣmī, ānandā, anaṅgasundarī, vasundharā, taḍinmālā,

dekhī padmāvatī kāntiḥ prītiḥ sandhyāvalī śubhā| prabhāvatī manovegā ratikāntā manovatī ||15|| mahādaśaivamādīnāṃ sahasrāṇi suyoṣitām | parivārya patiṃ cakrurākrandaṃ sumahāśucā ||16|| kāścinmohaṃ gatāḥ satyaḥ siktāścandanavāriṇā | samutplutamṛṇālānāṃ pajhinīnāṃ śriyaṃ dadhuḥ ||17|| āśliṣṭadayitāḥ kāścidgāḍhaṃ mūrchāmupāgatāḥ | añjanādilamāsaktasandhyārekhādyutiṃ dadhuḥ ||18||
kāścidurastāḍanacañcalāḥ | ghanāghanasamāsa tiḍinmālākṛti śritāḥ ||16|| vidhāya badanāmbhoja kācidake suvihvalā| vakṣaḥsthalaparāmarśakāriṇī mūrchitā muhuḥ ||20|| hā hā nātha gataḥ kvāsi tyaktvā māmatikātarām | kathaṃ nā'pekṣase duḥkhanimagnaṃ janamātmanaḥ ||24|| sa svaṃ sattvayutaḥ kāntimaṇḍanaḥ paramadyutiḥ | vibhūtyā śakrasakāśo mānī bharatabhūpatiḥ ||22|| pradhānapuruṣo bhūtvā mahārāja manoramaḥ | kimarthaṃ svapiṣi kṣoṇyāṃ vidyādharamaheśvaraḥ ||23|| uttiṣṭha kānta kāruṇya-para svajanavatsala | amṛtapratima vākyaṃ yacchaikamapi sundaram ||24|| aparādhavimuktānāmasmākaṃ saktacetasām | prāṇeśvara kimityevaṃ sthitastvaṃ kopasaṅgataḥ ||25|| parihāsakathāsaktaṃ dantajyotsnāmanoharam | vadanendumimaṃ nātha sakṛddhāraya pūrvavat ||26|| varāṅganāparikrīḍāsthāne smi'nnapi sundare | vakṣaḥsthale kathaṃ nyastaṃ padaṃ te cakradhārayā ||27|| bandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśastavāyaṃ daśanacchadaḥ | nārmottarapradānāya kathaṃ sphurati nādhunā ||28|| prasīda na ciraṃ kopaḥ sevito jātucitvayā | pratyutāsmākameva tvamakaroḥ sāntvanaṃ purā ||26||
padā, padmāvatī, sukhā, devī, padmāvatī, kānti, prīti, sandhyāvalī, śubhā, prabhāvatī, manovegā, ratikāntā aura manovatī, ādi aṭhāraha hajāra striyā~ patiko ghera kara mahāśoka se rudana karane lagīṃ ||12-16|| jinake ūpara candanakā jala sīṃcā gayā thā aisī mūrchāko prāpta huī kitanī hī striyā~, jinake mṛṇāla ukhāḍa़ liye gaye haiṃ aisī kamaliniyoṃkī śobhā dhāraṇa kara rahīṃ thīṃ ||17|| patikā āliṅgana kara gāḍha़ mūrchāko prāpta huī kitanī hī striyāṃ añjavagirise saṃsakta saṃdhyāko kāntiko dhāraṇa kara rahī thīṃ ||18|| jinakī mūrchā dūra ho gaī thī tathā jo chātīke pīṭanemeṃ caścala thīṃ aisī kitanī hī striyāṃ megha kauṃdhatī huī vidyunmālākī ākṛtiko dhāraṇa kara rahī thīṃ ||16|| koī eka strī patikā mukhakamala apanī godameṃ rakha atyanta vihvala ho rahī thī tathā vakṣaḥsthalakā sparśa karatī huī bārabāra mūrcchita ho rahī thī ||20||
ve kaha rahī thīṃ ki hāya hāya he nātha! tuma mujha atiśaya bhīruko choḍa़ kahā~ cale gaye ho? duḥkhameṃ ḍūbe hue apane logoṃkī ora kyoṃ nahīṃ dekhate ho ? ||21|| he mahārāja ! tuma to dhairya guṇase sahita ho, kānti rūpī ābhūṣaṇase vibhūṣita ho. parama kīrti ke dhāraka ho, vibhūtimeṃ indra ke samāna ho, mānī ho, bharata kṣetrake svāmī ho, pradhāna puruṣa ho, manako ramaṇa karane vāle ho, aura vidyādharoṃke rājā ho phira isataraha pṛthivī para kyoṃ so rahe ho ? ||22-23|| he kānta ! he dayātatpara, he svajanavatsala ! uṭho eka bāra to amṛta tulpa sundara vacana deo ||24|| he prāṇanātha ! hama loga aparādhase rahita haiṃ tathā hama logoṃkā citta eka āpa hī meṃ āsakta hai phira kyoṃ isataraha kopako prāpta hue ho ? ||25|| he nātha! parihāsakī kathāmeṃ tatpara aura dāṃtoṃkī kānti rūpī cāṃdanīse manohara isa mukha rūpī candramāko eka bāra to pahaleke samāna dhāraṇa karo ||26|| tumhārā yaha sundara vakṣaḥsthala uttama striyoṃkā krīḍa़ā sthala hai phira bhī isapara cakra dhārāne kaise sthāna jamā liyā ? ||27|| he nātha ! dupahariyāke phūlake samāna lāla lāla yaha tumhārā oṃṭha krīḍa़ā pūrṇa uttara deneke lie isa samaya kyoṃ nahīṃ phaḍa़ka rahā hai ? ||28|| prasanna hoo, tumane kabhī itanā lambā

udapādyeṣa yastvattaḥ kalpalokāt paricyutaḥ | bandhane meghavāho'sau duḥkhamāste tathendrajit ||30|| vidhāya sukṛtajñena vīreṇa guṇaśālinā | padmābhena saha prītiṃ bhrātṛputrau vimocaya ||31|| jīviteśa samuttiṣṭha prayaccha vacanaṃ priyam | suciraṃ deva kiṃ śeṣe vidhatsva nṛpateḥ kriyām || 32 || virahāgnipradīptāni bhṛśaṃ sundaravibhrama | kānta vidhyāpayāṅgāni prasīda praṇayipriya || 33 || avasthāmetakāṃ prāptamidaṃ vadanapaṅkajam| priyasya hṛdayālokya dīryate śatadhā na kim || 34 || vajrasāramidaṃ nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ duḥkhabhājanam | jñātvāpi yattavāvasthāmimāṃ tiṣṭhati nirdayam || 35|| vidhe kiṃ kṛtamasmābhirbhavataḥ sundaretaram | vihitaṃ yena karmedaṃ svayā nirdayaduṣkaram || 36 || samāliṅganamātreṇa dūraṃ nirdhūya mānakam | parasparārpaṇasvādu nātha yanmadhusevitam || 37|| yaccānyatpramadāgotragrahaṇaskhalite sati | kācīguṇena nīto'si bahuśo bandhanaṃ priye || 38 || vataṃsendīvarāghātāt kopaprasphuritādharam | prāpito'si prabho yacca kiñjalkocchu sitālikam || 36 || premako pavināśāya yaccātipriyavādinā | kṛtaṃ padārpaṇaṃ mūrdhni hṛdayadravakāraṇam ||40|| yāni cātyantaramyāṇi ratāni parameśvara | kānta cāṭusametāni sevitāni yathepsitam ||41|| paramānandakārīṇi tadetāni manohara | adhunā smaryamāgāni dahanti hṛdaye bhṛśam ||42|| kuru prasādamuttiṣṭa pādāveṣā namāmi te | na hi priyajane kopaḥ suciraṃ nātha śobhate || 43 || evaṃ rāvaṇapatnīnāṃ śrutvāpi paridevanam | kasya na prāṇinaḥ prāptaṃ hṛdayaṃ dravatāmalam 3 ||44||
krodha nahīṃ kiyā apitu hama logoṃko tuma pahale sāntvanā dete rahe ho ||26|| jisane svarga lokase cyuta ho kara āpase janma grahaṇa kiyā thā aisā vaha meghavāhana aura indrajit śatruke bandhanameṃ duḥkha bhoga rahā hai || 30 || so sukṛtako jānane vāle guṇaśālī vīra rāmake sātha prīti kara apane bhāī kumbhakarṇa tathā putroṃko bandhana se chuḍa़āo ||31|| he prāṇanātha ! uṭho, priya vacana pradāna karo | he deva ! cirakāla taka kyoṃ so rahe ho ? uṭho rājakārya karo ||32|| he sundara ceṣṭāoṃke dhāraka ! he kānta ! he premiyoṃse prema karane vāle ! prasanna hoo aura viraha rūpī agnise jalate hue hamāre aṃgoṃ ko śānta karo ||33|| re hṛdaya ! isa avasthāko prāpta hue patike mukha kamalako dekhakara tū sau ṭūka kyoṃ nahīṃ ho jātā hai ? ||34|| jāna paḍa़tā hai ki hamārā yaha duḥkhakā bhājana hṛdaya
kā banā huā hai isīlie to tumhārī isa avasthāko jānakara bhī nirdaya huā sthita hai ||35|| he vidhātaḥ ! hama logoṃne tumhārā kauna sā aśobhanīka kārya kiyā thā jisase tumane yaha aisā kārya kiyā jo nirdaya manuṣyoṃke lie bhī duṣkara hai -kaṭhina hai ||26|| he nātha ! āliṅgana mātrase mānako dūrakara paraspara - eka dūsare ke ādāna-pradānase manohara jo madhukā pāna kiyā thā ||37|| he priya ! anya strīkā nāma lenerūpa aparādha hone para jo maiṃne tumheṃ anekoṃ bāra mekhalāsūtra se bandhana meṃ ḍālā thā ||38|| he prabho ! maiṃne krodhase oṃṭhako kampita karate hue jo usa samaya tumheṃ karṇābharaṇake nīla kamalase tāḍa़ita kiyā thā aura usa kamalakī keśara tumhāre lalāṭa meṃ jā lagī thī || 36 || praṇaya kopako naṣṭa karaneke lie madhura vacana kahate hue jo tumane hamāre paira uṭhā kara apane mastaka para rakha liye the aura usase hamārā hṛdaya tatkāla dravībhūta ho gayā thā, aura he parameśvara ! he kānta ! madhura vacanoṃse sahita atyanta ramaṇīya jo rata icchānusāra āpake sātha sevana kiye gaye the | he manohara ! parama ānandako karane vāle ve saba kārya isa samaya eka-ekakara smṛti-patha meṃ āte hue hṛdayameṃ tīvra dāha utpanna kara rahe haiṃ ||40-42 || he nātha ! prasanna hoo, uṭho, maiṃ āpake caraṇoṃ meṃ namaskāra karatī hū~| kyoṃki priyajanoṃ para cirakālataka rahane vālā krodha śobhā nahīṃ detā ||43|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! isa taraha rāvaṇakī striyoṃkā vilāpa sunakara kisa prāṇīkā hṛdaya atyanta dravatāko prāpta nahīṃ huā thā ? ||46||

atha padmābhasaumitrau sākaṃ khecarapuṅgavaiḥ | snehagarbha pariṣvajya bāpāpūritalocanau ||45|| ūcatuḥ karuṇoktau parisāntvanakovidau | vibhīṣaṇamidaṃ vākyaṃ lokavṛttāntapaṇḍita ||46 || rājavalaṃ ruditvaivaṃ viṣādamadhunā tyaja | jānāsyeva nanu vyaktaṃ karmaṇāmiti ceṣṭitam ||47 || pūrvakarmānubhāvena pramādaṃ bhajatāṃ nṛṇām | prāptavyaṃ jāyate'vaśyaṃ tatra śokasya kaḥ kramaḥ || 48 || pravarttate yadākārye jano nanu tadaiva saḥ | mṛtaśviramṛte tasmin kiṃ śokaḥ kriyate'dhunā || 46 || yaḥ sadā paramaprītyā hitāya jagato rataḥ | samāhitamatirvāḍhaṃ prajākarmaṇi paṇḍitaḥ ||50|| sarvaśāstrārthasambodhakṣālitātmāpi rāvaṇaḥ | mohena balinā nīto'vasthāmetāṃ sudāruṇām ||51|| ret vināśametena prakāreṇānubhūtavān | nūnaṃ vināśakāle hi nṛṇāṃ dhvāntāyate matiḥ ||52|| rāmīyavacanasyānte prabhāmaṇḍalapaṇḍitaḥ | jagāda vacanaṃ bibhranmādhuryaṃ paramotkaṭam ||53 || vibhīṣaṇa raṇe bhīme yudhyamāno mahāmanāḥ | mṛtyunā vīrayogyena rāvaṇaḥ svasthitiṃ śritaḥ ||54 || kiṃ tasya patitaṃ yasya māno na patitaḥ prabhoḥ | nanvasyantamasau dhanyo yo sūnpratyaryamuñcata || 55|| mahāsattvasya vīrasya śocyaṃ tasya na vidyate | śatrundamasamā loke śocyāḥ pārthivagotrajāḥ ||56|| lakṣmīharidhvajodbhūto babhūvācapure nṛpaḥ | arindama iti khyātaḥ purandarasamaśriyā ||57|| sa jitvā śatrusaṅghātaṃ nānādeśavyavasthitam | pratyāgacchannijaṃ sthānaṃ devīdarśanakāṃkṣayā ||58||
athānantara jinake netra ā~suoṃse vyāpta the, jo karuṇā prakaṭa karane meṃ udyata the, sāntvanā dene meṃ nipuṇa the, tathā loka vyavahārake paṇḍita the aise rāma-lakṣmaṇa śreṣṭha vidyādharoṃke sātha vibhīṣaṇakā snehapūrṇa āliṅgana kara yaha vacana bole ||43-43 || ki he rājan ! isa taraha ronā vyartha hai, aba viṣāda choḍa़o, āpa jānate haiṃ ki yaha karmoṃ kī ceṣṭā hai ||47|| pūrva karma ke prabhāva se pramāda karanevāle manuṣyoṃ ko jo vastu prāpta hone yogya hai vaha avaśya hī prāpta hotī hai isameṃ śokakā kyā avasara hai ? ||486 || manuṣya jaba akārya meṃ pravṛtta hotā hai vaha tabhī mara jātā hai phira rāvaṇa to cirakāla bāda marā hai ataḥ aba śoka kyoṃ kiyā jātā hai ? || 46 || jo sadā parama prītipūrvaka jagatkā hita karane meṃ tatpara rahatā thā, jisakī buddhi sadā sāvadhāna rūpa rahatī thī, jo prajāke kārya meṃ paṇḍita thā, aura samasta śāstroṃ ke artha jñānase jisakī ātmā dhulī huī thī aisā rāvaṇa balavān mohake dvārā isa avasthā ko prāpta huā hai ||50-52 || usa rāvaṇane isa aparādha se vināśakā anubhava kiyā hai so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki vināśake samaya manuṣyoṃkī buddhi andhakāra ke samāna ho jātī hai || 52 ||
tadanantara rāmake kahane ke bāda atiśaya catura bhāmaṇḍalane paramotkaṭa mādhuryako dhāraṇa karanevāle nimnāṃkita vacana kahe ||13|| usane kahā ki he vibhīṣaṇa ! bhayaṃkara raṇameṃ yuddha karatā huā mahāmanasvī rāvaṇa vīroṃke yogya mṛtyuse mara kara ātmasthiti athavā vargasthitiko prāpta huā hai ||24|| jisa prabhukā māna naṣṭa nahīṃ huā usakā kyā naṣṭa huā ? arthāt kucha nahīṃ | yathārtha meṃ rāvaṇa atyanta dhanya hai jisane śatruke sammukha prāṇa choḍa़e || 55 || vaha to mahā dhairyaśālī vīra rahā ataḥ usake viṣaya meṃ śoka karane yogya bāta hī nahīṃ hai | loka meṃ jo kṣatriya ariṃdamake samāna haiṃ ve hī śoka karane yogya haiṃ || 56 || isakī kathā isa prakāra hai ki akṣapura nāmā nagara meṃ lakṣmī aura haridhvajase utpanna huā ariṃdama nāmakā eka rājā thā jo indrake samāna sampatti se prasiddha thā ||57|| vaha eka bāra nānā deśoṃ meṃ sthita śatru samūhako jīta kara apanī strīko dekhane

aṣṭasaptatitamaṃ parva
tato haladharo'vocat kartavyaṃ kimataḥ param | maraṇāntāni vairāṇi jāyante hi vipaścitām ||1|| paraloke gatasyāto lakeśasyottamaṃ vapuḥ | mahānarasya saṃskāra prāpayāmaḥ sukhaidhitam ||2|| tatrābhinandite vākye vibhīṣaṇasamanvitau | balanārāyaṇī sākaṃ śeṣastāṃ kakubhaṃ śritau ||3|| yatra mandodarī śokavihvalā kurarīsamam | yoṣitsahasramadhyasthā virauti karuṇāvaham ||4|| avatīrya mahānāgāt satvaraṃ balakeśavī | mandodarīmupāyātau sākaṃ khecarapuṅgavaḥ ||5|| raṣṭvā tau sutarāṃ nāryo rurudurmuktakaṇṭhakam | virugṇaratnavalayā vasudhāpāṃsudhūsarāḥ ||6|| mandodaryā samaṃ sarvamaṅganānivahaṃ balaḥ | vāgbhiścitrābhirāninye samāśvāsaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||7|| karāgurugośīrṣacandanādibhiruttamaiḥ | saṃskārya rāvaṇaṃ yātāḥ sarve padmasaro mahat ||8|| upaviśya sarastīre pa noktaṃ sucetasā | kumbhādayo vimucyantāṃ sāmantaiḥ sahitā iti ||6|| khecareśaistataḥ kaiściduktaṃ te krūramānasāḥ | hanyantāṃ vairiṇo yadvamriyantāṃ bandhane svayam ||10|| baladevo jagī bhūyaḥ kṣātraṃ nedaṃ viceṣṭitam | prasiddhā vā na vijñātā bhavadbhiḥ kimiyaṃ sthitiḥ ||11|| suptabaddhanatatrastadantadaṣṭādayo bhaṭāḥ| na hantavyā iti kṣātro dharmo jagati rājate ||12|| evamastviti sannaddhāstānānetuṃ mahābhaṭāḥ | nānā''yudhadharā jagmuḥ sthāsyādeśaparāyaṇāḥ ||13|| indrajitkumbhakarṇaśca mārīco dhanavāhanaḥ | tathā mayamahādaityapramukhāḥ khecarottamāḥ ||14|| pūritā nigaḍaiḥ sthūlaramī khaṇakhaṇāyitaiḥ | pramādarahitaiḥ śūrairānīyante samāhitaiḥ ||15||
tadanantara śrīrāmane kahā ki aba kyā karanā cāhie ? kyoṃki vidvānoṃke vaira to maraṇa paryanta hī hote haiṃ ||1|| acchā ho ki hama loga paralokako prāpta hue mahāmānava lakeśvarako sukhase baḍha़āye hue uttama śarīrakā dāha saṃskāra karāveṃ ||2|| rāmake ukta vacanakī sabane praśaṃsā kī | taba vibhīṣaṇa sahita rāma lakṣmaṇa anya saba vidyādhara rājāoṃke sātha usa diśāmeṃ pahuṃce jahā~ hajāroṃ striyoṃke bīca baiṭhī mandodarī śokase vihvala ho kurarīke samāna karuṇa vilāpa kara rahī thī||3-4|| rāma aura lakṣmaṇa mahāgajase utara kara pramukha vidyādharoṃke sātha mandodarīke pāsa gaye ||5|| jinhoṃne ratnoṃkī cūḍa़iyā~ toḍa़kara pheṃka dī thīṃ tathā jo pṛthivīkī dhūlise dhūsara śarīra ho rahī thīṃ aisī saba striyā~ rāma lakṣmaṇako dekha galā phāḍa़ phāḍa़kara atyadhika rone lagīṃ ||3|| buddhimān rāmane mandodarīke sātha sātha samasta striyoṃke samūhako nānā prakārake vacanoṃse sāntvanā prāpta karāī ||7|| tadanantara kapūra, aguru, gośīrṣa aura candana ādi uttama padārthoṃse rāvaṇakā saṃskāra kara saba padma nāmaka mahāsarovara para gaye ||8|| uttama cittake dhāraka rāmane sarovarake tīrapara baiṭhakara kahā ki saba sāmantoṃke sātha kumbhakarṇādi choḍa़ diye jāveṃ ||6|| yaha suna kucha vidyādhara rājoāṃne kahā ki ve baḍa़e krūra hṛdaya haiṃ ataḥ unheṃ śatruoṃke samāna mārā jāya athavā ve svayaṃ hī bandhanameṃ paḍa़e paḍa़e mara jāveṃ ||10|| taba rāmane kahā ki yaha kṣatriyoṃkī ceṣṭā nahīṃ| kyā āpa loga kṣatriyoṃkī isa prasiddha nītiko nahīṃ jānate ki sote hue, bandhanameṃ ba~dhe hue, namrībhṛta, bhayabhīta tathā dā~toṃmeṃ tṛṇa dabāye hue ādi yodhā mārane yogya nahīṃ haiṃ| yaha kṣatriyoṃkā dharma jagatmeṃ sarvatra suśobhita hai ||11-12|| taba 'evamastu' kahakara svāmīkī ājñā pālana karanemeṃ tatsara, nānā prakārake śastroṃke dhāraka mahāyoddhā kavacādise yukta ho unheṃ lāneke liye gaye ||13||
tadanantara indrajit , kumbhakarṇa, mārīca, meghavāhana tathā maya mahādaityako ādi lekara

78
padmapurāṇe
vilokyānīyamānāṃstāndiṅmataṅgajasamibhān | jajalpuḥ kapayaḥ svairaṃ saṃhatisthāḥ parasparam ||16|| prajvalantī citāṃ vīcaya rāvaṇīyāṃ ruṣaṃ yadi | prayātīndrajito jātu kumbhakarṇanṛpo'pi vā ||17|| anayorekakasyāpi tato vikṛtimīyuṣaḥ | kaḥ samarthaḥ puraḥ sthātuṃ kapidhvajabale nṛpaḥ ||18|| yo yatrāvasthitastasmāt sthānādudyāti naiva saḥ | anayorhi balaṃ dṛṣṭametaiḥ saṅgrāmamūrddhani ||16|| bhāmaṇḍalena cātmīyā gaditā bhaṭapuṅgavāḥ | yathā nāyāpi viśrammo vidhātavyo vibhīṣaṇe ||20|| kadācit svajanānetān prāpya nirdhūtabandhanān | bhrātṛduḥkhānutaptasya jāyate'sya vikāritā ||21|| ityudbhūtasamāśake vaidehādibhirāvṛtāḥ | nīyante kumbhakarṇādhā balanārāyaṇāntikam ||22|| rāgadveṣavinirmuktā manasā munitāṃ gatāḥ | dharaṇīṃ saumyayā dṛṣṭyā vīkṣamāṇāḥ śubhānanāḥ ||23|| saṃsāre sāragandho'pi na kaścidiha vidyate | dharma eko mahābandhuḥ sāraḥ sarvaśarīriṇām ||24|| vimokṣaṃ yadi nāmāsmāt prāpsyāmo bandhanāda vayam | pāraṇāṃ pāṇipātreṇa kariṣyāmo nirambarāḥ ||25|| pratijñāmevamārūḍhā rāmasyāntikamāśritāḥ | vibhīṣaṇaṃ samājagmuḥ kumbhakarṇādayo nṛpāḥ ||26|| vṛtte yathāyathaṃ tatra duḥkhasambhāṣaṇe'gadan | praśāntāḥ kumbhakarṇādyā balanārāyaṇāviti ||27|| aho vaḥ paramaṃ dhairya gāmbhīyaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ balam | surairapyajayo nīto mṛtyuṃ yadrākṣasādhipaḥ ||28|| paraṃ kṛtāpakāro'pi mānī niyūṃḍhabhāṣitaḥ | atyunnataguṇaḥ śatruḥ ślāghanīyo vipaścitām ||26||
aneka uttama vidyādhara jo rāmake kaṭakameṃ kaida the tathā khana khana karanevālo baḍa़ī moṭī beḍa़iyoṃse jo sahita the ve pramāda rahita sāvadhāna cittake dhāraka śūravīroṃ dvārā lāye gaye ||14-15|| diggajoṃke samāna una sabako lāye jāte dekha, samahake bīca baiṭhe hae vidyādhara icchānusāra paraspara isa prakāra vārtālāpa karane lage ki yadi kahīṃ rāvaṇakī jalatī citāko dekhakara indrajit athavā kumbhakarṇa krodhako prāpta hotā hai athavā ina domeṃ se eka bhī bigaḍa़ uṭhatā hai to usake sāmane khaḍa़ā honeke lie vānaroṃkī senāmeṃ kauna rājā samartha haiṃ ? ||16-18|| usa samaya jo jahā~ baiṭhā thā usa sthānase nahīṃ uṭhā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki ye saba raṇake agrabhāgameṃ unakā bala dekha cuke the ||16|| bhāmaṇḍalane apane pradhāna yoddhāoṃse kaha diyā ki vibhīṣaṇakā aba bhī viśvāsa nahīṃ karanā cāhiye ||20|| kyoṃki kadācit bandhanase chūṭe hue ina ātmīya janoṃko pākara bhāīke duḥkhase saṃtapta rahanevāle isake bikāra utpanna ho sakatā hai ||21|| isa prakāra jinheṃ nānā prakārakī śaṅkāe~ utpanna ho rahī thīṃ aise bhāmaṇḍala ādike dvārā ghire hue kumbhakarṇādi rāma lakṣmaṇake samīpa.lāye gaye ||22||
ve kumbhakarṇādi sabhī puruṣa rāga-dveṣase rahita ho hṛdayase munipanāko prāpta ho cuke the, saumya dṛṣṭise pṛthivīko dekhate hue ā rahe the, sabake mukha atyanta śubha-śānta the ||23|| ve apane manameṃ yaha pratijñā kara cuke the ki isa saṃsārameṃ kucha bhī sāra nahīṃ hai eka dharma hī sāra hai jo saba prāṇiyoṃkā mahābandhu hai | yadi hama isa vandhanase chuṭakārā prāpta kareṃge to nirgrantha sādhu ho pāṇi-mātra se hī āhāra grahaṇa kareṃge| isa prakārakī pratijñāko prāpta hue ve saba rāmake samīpa āye| kumbhakarṇa ādi rājā vibhīṣaṇake bhī sammukha gaye ||24-26|| tadanantara jaba duḥkhake sayamakā vārtālāpa dhīre-dhīre samāpta ho gayā taba parama śāntiko dhāraṇa karanevāle kumbhakarṇādi ne rāma-lakṣmaṇase isa prakāra kahā ki aho! āpa logoṃkā dhairya, gāmbhīrya, ceṣṭā tathā bala ādi sabhī utkṛṣṭa hai kyoṃki jo devoṃ ke dvārā bhī ajeya thā aise rāvaṇako āpane mṛtyu prāpta karā dī ||27-28|| atyanta apakārī, mānī aura kaṭubhāṣī honepara bhī yadi śatrumeṃ utkṛṣṭa guṇa haiṃ to baha vidvānoṃkā praśaṃsanīya hī hotā hai ||26||

74

mahādundubhinirghoṣapratime rāmanisvane | jānakīsvanitaṃ jajñe vīṇāniḥkagakomalam ||27|| saviśalyastataścakrī sugrīvo raśmimaṇḍalaḥ | tathā vāyusutādyāśca maṅgalastotratatparāḥ ||28|| baddhapāṇipuṭā dhanyā bhāvitā jinapugave | gṛhītamukulāmbhojā iva rājanti te tadā ||26|| vimuñcatsu svanaṃ teṣu murajasvanasundaram | meghadhvanikṛtāśaṅkā nanṛtuśchekabahiṇaḥ ||30|| kṛtvā stutiṃ praṇāmaṃ ca bhūyo bhūyaḥ sucetasaḥ | yathāsukhaṃ samāsīnāḥ prāṅgaṇe jinaveśmanaḥ ||31|| yāvatte vandanāṃ cakrustāvadrājā vibhīṣaṇaḥ | sumālimālyavadratnaśravaprabhṛtibāndhavān ||32|| saṃsārānityatābhāvadeśanātyantakovidaḥ | parisāntvanamāninye mahāduḥkhanipīḍitān ||33|| āyauṃ tāta svakarmotthaphalabhojiṣu jantuṣu | vidhīyate mudhā śokaḥ kriyatāṃ svahite manaḥ ||34|| raṣṭāgamā mahācittā yūyamevaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ | vistha jāto yadi prāṇī mṛtyu na pratipadyate ||35|| puṣpasaundaryasaṅkāśaṃ yauvanaṃ durvyatikramam | pallavaśrīsamālacamīrjīvitaṃ vidyudadhruvam ||36|| jalabubudasaṃyogapratimā bandhusaṅgamāḥ | sandhyārāgasamā bhogāḥ kriyāḥ svapnakriyopamāḥ ||37|| yadi nāma praparan jantavo naiva pañcatām | kathaṃ sa bhavatāṃ gotramāgataḥ syādbhavāntarāt ||38|| mātmano'pi yadā nāma niyamādviśarārutā| tadā kathamivātyartha kriyate śokamūḍhatā ||36|| evametaditi dhyānaṃ saṃsārācāragocaram | satāṃ śokavināśāya paryāptaṃ kṣaṇamātrakam ||40||

jaba taka ina sabane vandanākī taba taka rājā vibhīṣaṇane samālī, mālyavāna tathā ratnaśravā ādi parivārake logoṃko jo ki mahāduḥkhase paḍa़ita ho rahe the sāntvanā dī| vibhīṣaṇa saṃsārakī anityatākā bhāva batalāne meṃ atyanta nipuṇa thā ||32-33|| usane sāntvanā dete hue kahā ki he āryo ! he tāta ! saṃsārake prāṇī apane-apane karmoṃ ke anusāra phalako bhogate hī haiṃ ataḥ śoka karanā vyartha hai ātmahitameṃ mana lagāie ||34|| āpa loga to āgamake dṛṣṭā, viśāla hṛdaya aura vijñapuruṣa haiṃ ataḥ jānate haiṃ ki utpanna huā prāṇī mṛtyuko prāpta hotā hai yā nahīṃ ||35|| jisakā varṇana karanā baḍa़ā kaṭhina hai aisā yauvana phūlake saundayake samāna hai, lakṣmī pallavakī śobhāke samāna hai, jīvana bijalīke samāna anitya hai ||36|| bandhu janoṃke samāgama jalake babūleke samāna haiṃ, bhoga sandhyākī lālīke tulya hai, aura kriyāe~ svapnakī kriyāoṃke samāna haiṃ ||37|| yadi ye prāṇī mṛtyuko prāpta nahīṃ hote to vaha rāvaṇa bhavāntarase āpake gotrameṃ kaise ātā ? ||38|| are! jaba hama logoṃko bhī eka dina niyamase naṣṭa ho jānā hai taba yaha śoka viṣayaka mūrkhatā kisa lie kī jātī hai ? ||36|| 'yaha aisā hai' arthāt naṣṭa honā isakā svabhāva hī hai isa prakāra saṃsārake svabhāvakā dhyāna karanā satpuruṣoṃ ke śokako kṣaṇamātrameṃ naṣṭa karaneke lie paryāpta hai| bhāvārtha-jo aisā vicāra karate haiṃ ki saṃsārake padārtha naśvara hī haiṃ unakā śoka kṣaṇa mātrameṃ naṣṭa ho jātā hai ||40|| bandhujanoṃke sātha kathita,

bhavatyeva hi śokena saṅgo bandhuviyoginaḥ | balādiva viśālena smṛtivibhraṃśakāriṇā ||42|| tathā'pyanādike'muṣminsaṃsāre bhramato mama | kena bāndhavatāṃ prāptā iti jñātvā suguhyatām ||43|| yathā śaktyā jinendrāṇāṃ bhavadhvaṃsavidhāyinām | vidhāya śāsane cittamātmā svārthe niyujyatām ||4|| evamādibhirālāpairmadhuraihṛdayaṅgamaiḥ | parisāntvya samādhāya bandhūn kṛtye gṛhaṃ gataḥ ||45|| agrāṃ devīsahasrasya vyavahāravicakṣaṇām | 'prajighāya vidagdhākhyāṃ mahiṣī halino'ntikam ||46|| āgatya sābhijātena praṇāmena kṛtārthatām | sasītau bhrātarau vākyamidaṃ kramavidabravīt ||47|| asmatsvāmigṛhaṃ deva svagṛhāśayalakṣitam | katuṃ pādatalāsaṅgānmahānugrahamarhasi ||48|| vartate salathā yāvatteṣāṃ vārtāsamudbhavā | svayaṃ bibhīṣaṇastāvatprāptośyantamahādaraḥ||46|| uttaṣṭita grahaṃ yāmaḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti | tenoktaḥ sānugaḥ pastadgṛhaṃ gantumudyataḥ ||50|| yānairnānāvidhaistuṅgairgajairambudasannibhaiḥ | taraṅgañcacalairaśvai rathaiḥ prāsādaśobhibhiḥ ||5|| vidhāya kṛtasaṃskāraṃ rājamārga nirantaram | vibhīṣaṇagṛhaṃ tena prasthitāste yathākramam ||52|| pralayāmbudanirghoṣāstūryaśabdāḥ samudratāḥ | śaṅkhakoṭiravonmiśrā gahvarapratinādinaḥ ||53|| bhambhābherīmṛdaṅgānāṃ paṭahānāṃ sahasraśaḥ | lampākakāhalādhunadhudundubhīnāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ ||54|| jhallāmlātakaḍhakānāṃ haikānāṃ ca nirantaram | guñjāhukārasundānāṃ tathā pūritamambaram ||55||
sphītaihalahalāśabdairaṭṭahāsaiśca santataiḥ | nānāvāhananādaiśca digantā badhirīkṛtāḥ ||56|| anubhūta aura dṛṣṭa padārtha sat puruṣoṃke manako eka kṣaṇa hī santāpa dete haiṃ adhika nahīṃ ||4|| jisakā bandhu-janoṃke sātha viyoga hotā hai yadyapi usakā smṛtiko naṣṭa karanevāle viśāla śokake sātha samāgama māno bala pūrvaka hī hotā hai tathāpi isa anādi saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa karate hue mere kauna-kauna loga bandhu nahīṃ hae haiṃ aisā vicāra kara usa śokako chipānā cāhie ||42-43|| isalie saṃsārako naṣṭa karanevāle śrī jinendradevake śāsanameṃ yathāśakti mana lagākara ātmāko ātmāke hitameṃ lagāie ||44|| ityādi hṛdayako lagane vāle madhura vacanoṃse sabakoṃ kāmameṃ lagākara vibhīṣaṇa apane ghara gayā ||45|
__ ghara ākara usane eka hajāra striyoṃ meṃ pradhāna tathā saba vyavahārameṃ vicakṣaṇa vidagdhā nāmaka rānīko śrī rāmake samīpa bhejā ||46|| tadanantara kramako jānane vālī vidagdhāne ākara prathama hī sītā sahita rāma-lakṣmaṇako kulake yogya praṇāma kiyā| tatpaścāt yaha vacana kahe ki he deva ! hamāre svāmīke gharako apanā ghara samajha caraṇa-talake saṃsargase pavitra kījie ||47-48|| jaba taka una sabake bīcameṃ yaha vārtā ho rahī thī taba taka mahā ādarase bharā vibhīṣaṇa svayaṃ ā pahu~cā ||4ā āte hī usane kahā ki uṭhie, ghara cale prasannatā kījie| isa prakāra vibhīṣaṇake kahane para rāma, apane anugāmiyoṃke sātha usake ghara jāne ke lie udyata ho gaye ||50|| rāja mārga kī avirala sajāvaṭa kī gaī aura usase ve nānā prakārake vāhanoṃ, megha samāna ū~ce hāthiyoṃ, laharoṃ ke samāna cañcala ghoṃḍa़oṃ aura mahaloṃke samāna suśobhita rathoṃ para yathākramase savāra ho vibhīṣaṇake gharakī ora cale ||51-52|| pralaya kālīna meghoṃ kī garjanāke samāna jinakā viśāla śabda thā jinameṃ karoḍa़oṃ śaṅkhoṃkā śabda mila rahā thā tathā guphāoṃmeṃ jinakī pratidhvani paḍa़ rahī thī aise turahīke viśāla śabda utpanna hue ||53|| bhaṃbhā, bherī, mṛdaṅga, hajāroṃ paṭaha, laṃpāka, kāhalā, dhundhu, dundubhi, jhāṃjha, amlātaka, ḍhakkā, haikā, guṃjā, huṃkāra aura sunda nāmaka vāditroṃke śabdase ākāśa bhara gayā ||54-55|| atyanta vistārako prāpta huā hala halā śabda, bahuta bhārī aṭṭahāsa aura nānā vāhanoṃke śabdoṃse diśāe~ bahirī ho gaī ||56|| kitane hī vidyādhara vyāghroṃkī pīṭha

bhaśītitamaṃ parva
kecicchārdūlapṛṣṭasthāḥ kecit kesari pṛṣṭhagāḥ | kecid rathādibhirvīrāḥ prasthitāḥ khecareśvarāḥ ||57|| nartakīnaṭabhaṇḍādyairnṛtyadbhiratisundaram | vandivṛndaiśca te jagmuḥ stūyamānā mahāsvanaiḥ ||58|| akāṇḍakaumudīsargamaṇḍitaiśchantramaṇḍalaiḥ | nānāyudhadalaiśvāsana bhānubhāsastirohitāḥ ||56|| divyastrīvadanāmbhojakhaṇḍanandanamuttamam | kurvantaste pariprāptā vibhīṣaṇanṛpālayam ||6|| vibhūti tadā teṣāṃ babhūva śubhalakṣaṇā| sā paraṃ dhanivāsānāṃ vidyate janitādbhutā ||61|| avatīryātha nāgendrād ratnā_dipuraskṛtī| ramyaṃ vivaśatu : sana sasītau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||62|| madhye mahālayasyāsya ratnatoraṇasaṅgatam | padmaprabhajinendrasya bhavanaṃ hemasanibham ||63|| prāntāvasthitahālīparivāramanoharam | śeṣaparvatamadhyasthaṃ mandaraupamyamāgatam ||6|| hemastambhasahasreṇa tamuttamabhāsuram | pūjitāyāmavistāraṃ nānāmaṇigaṇārcitam ||65|| bahurūpadharairyuktaṃ candrābhaibalabhīpuṭaḥ | gavākṣaprāntasaṃsaktairmukkājālairvirājitam ||66|| anekādbhutasaṅkīrṇairyuktaḥ pratisarādibhiḥ | pradeśairvividhaiḥ kāntaṃ pāpapramathanaṃ param ||67|| evaṃvidhe gṛhe tasmin padmarāgamayoṃ prabhoḥ | padmaprabhajinendrasya pratimā 'pratimojjhitām ||6|| bhāsamambhojakhaṇḍānāṃ diśantīṃ maṇibhūmiṣu | stutvā ca parivanditvā yathā'haṃ samavasthitāḥ||66|| yathāyathaṃ tato yātā khecarendrā nirūpitam | samāśrayaṃ balaṃ citte vibhrāṇāścakriṇāṃ tathā ||7|| atha vidyādharastrībhiḥ padmalacamaṇayoḥ pṛthaka | sītāyāśca śarīrasya kriyāyogaḥ pravartitaḥ ||7||
para baiṭha kara jā rahe the, kitane hī siṃhoṃkī pīṭha para savāra ho kara cala rahe the aura kitane hī ratha ādi vāhanoṃse prasthāna kara rahe the ||57| unake āge āge nartakiyā~ naṭa tathā bhāṃḍa़ ādi sundara nṛtya karate jāte the tathā cāraṇoṃke samūha baḍa़ī ucca dhvanimeṃ unakā virada bakhānate jā rahe the ||58|| asamayameṃ prakaṭa huī cā~danīke samāna manohara chatroṃke samūhase tathā nānā śastroṃke samūhase sūryako kiraṇe ācchādita ho gaī thī ||56|| isa prakāra sundarī striyoṃke mukha-kamaloṃko vikasita karate hue ve saba vibhīṣaṇake rājabhavanameṃ pahu~ce ||60|| usa samaya rāma lakṣmaṇa ādiko śubha-lakṣaṇoṃse yukta jo vibhūti thī vaha devoṃke lie bhī āścarya utpanna karane vālī thīṃ ||61||
athānantara hāthīse utarakara, jinakā ratnoṃke ardha ādise satkāra kiyā gayā thā aise sītā sahita rāma lakṣmaṇane vibhīṣaṇake sundara bhavanameṃ praveśa kiyā ||62|| vibhīṣaṇake viśāla bhavanake madhyameṃ śrī padmaprabha jinendrakā vaha mandira thā jo ratnamayī toraṇoṃse sahita thā, svarṇake samāna dedīpyamāna thā, samīpameṃ sthita mahaloṃke samūhase manohara thā, śeṣa nāmaka parvatake madhyameṃ sthita thā, premakī upamāko prāpta thā, svarṇamayī hajāra khambhoṃse yukta thā, uttama dedīpyamāna thā, yogya lambāī aura vistārase sahita thā, nānā maṇiyoṃke samūhase śobhita thā, candramāke samāna camakatī huī nānā prakārako valabhiyoṃse yukta thā, jharokhoṃke samīpa laṭakatī huī motiyoṃkī jālīse suśobhita thā, aneka adbhuta racanāoṃse yukta pratisara ādi vividha pradeśoṃse sundara thā, aura pāpako naṣṭa karane vālā thā ||63-67|| isa prakārake usa mandirameṃ śrī padmaprabha jinendra kī padmarāga maṇi nirmita vaha anupama pratimā virājamāna thī| jo apanī prabhāse maṇimaya bhūmimeṃ kamala-samūha kī śobhā prakaṭa kara rahī thī | sabaloga usa pratimākī stuti-vandanā kara yathā yogya baiṭha gathe ||68-66|| tadanantara vidyādhara rājā, hṛdayameṃ rāma aura lakṣmaṇako dhāraṇa karate hue jahā~ jisake lie jo sthāna banāyā gayā thā vahā~ yathā yogya rītise cale gaye ||70||

-rrrraman
prastuta kī ||71|| sarva prathama unheṃ sugandhita hitakārī tathā manohara varṇa vāle telakā madana kiyā gayā, phira ghrāṇa aura śarīrake anukūla padārthoṃkā upaṭana kiyā giyā ||72|| tadanantara snānako caukīpara pūrva diśākī ora mukha kara baiṭhe hue unakā baḍa़e vaibhavase kramapūrvaka maṅgala maya snāna karāyā gayā ||73|| usa samaya śarīrako ghisanā pānī choḍa़nā ādi kī layarsa sahita manako haraṇa karane vāle tathā saba prakārakī sāja-sāmagrīse yakta bāje baja rahe the ||7|| gandhodakase paripūrṇa suvarṇa, marakata maṇi, hīrā, sphaṭika maṇi tathā indranīlamaṇi nirmita kalaśoṃse unakā abhiṣeka pūrṇa huā ||75|| tadanantara acchī taraha snāna karane ke bāda unhoṃne pavitra vastra dhāraṇa kiye, uttama alaṃkāroṃse śarīra alaṃkṛta kiyā aura tadanantara mandirameṃ praveśa kara śrī padmaprabha jinendrakī vandanā kī ||76||
athānantara una sabake lie jo bhojana taiyāra kiyā gayā thā, usakī kathā bahuta vistṛta hai | usa samaya ghī dūdha dahī ādikī bāvaḍa़iyā~ bharī gaī thīṃ aura khāne yogya uttamottama padārthoṃ ke māno parvata banāye gaye the arthāt parvatoṃke samāna baḍa़ī-baḍa़ī rāśiyā~ lagāī gaī thīṃ ||77|| mana ghrāṇa aura netroṃke lie abhīṣṭa jo bhī vastue~ candana ādi vanāmeṃ utpanna huī thīṃ ve lākara bhojana-bhūmimeṃ ekatrita kī gaī thīṃ ||78|| vaha bhojana svabhāvase hī madhura thā phira jānakīke samīpa rahate hue to kahanā hī kyā thā ? usa samaya śrīrāmake manakī jo daśā thī usakā varṇana kaise kiyā jā sakatā hai ! ||7|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! pā~co indriyoṃkī sārthakatā tabhī hai jaba iṣṭa padārthoṃkā saṃyoga hone para unheṃ saṃtoṣa utpanna hotā hai ||80|| isa jantune usī samaya bhojana kiyā hai, usī samaya sūṃghā hai, usī samaya sparśa kiyā hai, usī samaya dekhā hai aura usī samaya sunā hai jaba ki use priyajanakā samāgama prāpta hotā hai | bhāvārtha-priyajanake vighameṃ bhojana ādi kārya niḥsāra jāna paḍa़te haiṃ ||81|| viraha kālameṃ svarga tulya bho deśa narakake samāna jāna paḍa़tā hai aura priyajanake samāgama rahate hue mahāvana bhī svargake samāna jāna paḍa़tā hai ||2|| sundara adbhuta aura bahuta prakārake rasāyana sambandhī rasoṃ kī tathā nānā prakārake bhakṣya padāthāsa una saba ko bhojana-kriyā pūrṇa huī ||83|| jo yathā yogya bhūmi para baiṭhāye gaye the, jinakā sammāna kiyā gayā thā tathā jo apane apane parivāra

mārīcaḥ kalpavāsitvaṃ prāpyā'nye ca maharṣayaḥ | sasvaṃ yathāvidhaṃ yasya phalaṃ tasya tathāvidham ||143|| vaidehyāḥ paśya māhātmyaṃ dṛḍhavratasamudbhavam | yathā sampālitaṃ śīlaṃ dviṣantaśca vivarjitāḥ || 144 || sītāyā atulaṃ dhairyaṃ rūpaṃ subhagatā matiḥ | kalyāṇaguṇapūrṇāyāḥ snehabandhaśca bhartari || 145 || śīlataḥ svargagāminyā svabhartṛparituṣṭayā | caritaṃ rāmadevasya sītayā sādhu bhūṣitam || 146 || ekena vrataratnena puruṣāntaravarjinā | svargārohaṇasāmarthyaṃ yoṣitāmapi vidyate || 147 ||

isa prakāra mūṭha-mūṭha hī pativratākā abhimāna rakhane vālī strī pati-vratā nahīṃ hai ||15|| yaha mana rūpī. hāthī laukika śāstrarūpī nirbala aṃkuśake dvārā vaśa nahīṃ kiyā jā sakatā isalie vaha isa jīvako kumatimeṃ le jātā hai ||156|| uttama buddhiko dhāraṇa karane vālā bhavyajīva, jinavāṇī rūpī aṅkaśake dvārā hī manarūpī hāthīko dayā aura sukhase sahita samīcīnamārgameṃ le jā sakatā hai ||157|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki aba maiṃ vidvānoṃke bīca paramparāse āgata abhimānāke śīla vaṇenakī kathā saṃkṣepameṃ kahatā hū~ so suna ||158||

1.8
padmapurāṇe
āryācchandaḥ īḍagguṇo vidhijñaḥ prāsuvihārī mayaḥ praśāntātmā | paṇḍitamaraṇaṃ prāpto'bhūdīśāne suraśreṣṭhaḥ ||20|| etanmayasya sādhormāhātmyaṃ ye paṭhanti sañcittāḥ |
arayaḥ kravyādā vā hiṃsanti na tān kadācidapi ||20|| ityāce raviṣeṇācāryaprokta padmapurāṇe mayopākhyānaṃ nāmā'śītitamaṃ parva ||8||
podanapura atyanta śānta ho gayā tathā dharmameṃ usakā citta laga gayā ||207| isa prakārake guṇoṃse yukta, dharmakī vidhiko jānanevāle, praśānta citta tathā pāsuka sthānameṃ bihāra karanevāle maya munirāja, paṇḍita maraṇako prāpta ho śreṣṭha deva hue ||208|| isa taraha jo uttama citta hokara maya munirājake isa māhātmyako paḍha़te haiṃ, śatru athavā māṃsabhojī siṃhādi unakī kabhī bhī hiṃsā nahīṃ karate ||206||
isa prakāra ārṣa nāmase prasiddha, raviṣeṇācārya dvārā kathita padmapurāṇameṃ maya munirājakā
varṇana karanevālā assīvā~ parva samāpta huā ||8||

ekāśītitamaṃ parva
brahmalokabhavākārāṃ lakṣmī lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ | candrāṅkacūḍadevendrapratimo'nubhavanasau ||1|| bhatta'putraviyogāgnijvālāśoṣitavigrahām | vismṛtaḥ kathamekāntaṃ jananīmaparājitām ||2|| saptamaṃ talamārūḍhā prāsādasya sakhīvṛtā | udvignā'sraprapūrṇākṣā navadhenurivākulā ||3|| . vīkṣate sā diśaḥ sarvāḥ putrasnehaparāyaṇā | kāṃdantī darśanaṃ tīvaśokasāgaravartinī ||4|| patākāśikhare tiṣṭhannutpatotpatavāyasa | padmaḥ putro mamā''yātu tava dāsyāmi pāyasam ||5|| ityuktvā ceṣṭitaṃ tasya dhyātvā dhyānaṃ manoharam | vilāpaṃ kurute netra durdinakāriṇī ||6|| hā vatsaka va yāto'si satataṃ sukhalālitaḥ | videśabhramaṇe prītistava keyaṃ samudgatā 1|| pādapallavayoḥ pīḍāṃ prāpnopi paruṣe pathi | viśramiṣyasi kasyā'dho gahanasyotkaṭaśramaḥ ||8|| mandabhāgyāṃ parityajya makāmatyarthaduḥkhitām | yāto'si katamāmāśā bhrātrā putrakasaṅgataḥ ||6|| paradevanamārebhe sā kattu caivamādikam | devaṣiśva pariprāpto gaganāṅgaṇagocaraḥ ||10|| jaṭākūrcadharaḥ śuklavastraprāvṛtavigrahaḥ | avadvāraguṇābhikhyo nāradaḥ kṣitiviśrataḥ ||11|| taṃ samīpatvamāyātamabhyutthāyāparājitā | āsānādhupacāreṇa sādaraṃ samamānayat ||12||
athānantara jo svarga lokakī lakṣmīke samāna rājalakṣmīkā upabhoga kara rahe the aise candrāṅkacūḍa indra ke tulya śrīrāma, pati aura putrake viyogarūpī agnikī jvālāse jinakā śarīra sūkha gayā thā aisī mātā kausalyāko ekadama kyoṃ bhūla gaye the ? ||1-2|| jo nirantara udvigna rahatī thī, jisake netra ā~suoṃse vyāpta rahate the, jo navaprasūtā gāyake samāna apane putrase milaneke lie atyanta vyākula thī, putrake prati sneha prakaṭa karanemeṃ tatpara thī, tīvra śokarūpī sāgarameṃ vidyamāna thī aura putrake darśanakī icchā rakhatī thī, aisī kausalyā sakhiyoṃke sātha mahalake sātaveṃ khaṇḍapara caḍha़ kara saba diśāoṃkī ora dekhatī rakhatī thī ||3-4|| vaha pāgalakī bhā~ti patākāke śikharapara baiṭhe hue kākase kahatī thī ki re vāyasa ! uḍa़-uḍa़| yadi merā putra rāma ā jāyagā to maiṃ tujhe khīrakā bhojana deū~gī ||5|| aisā kahakara usakī manohara ceṣṭāoṃkā dhyāna karatī aura jaba usako orase kucha uttara nahīṃ milatā taba netroṃse ā~suoṃkī ghanaghora varṣā karatī huī vilāpa karane lagatī ||6||| vaha kahatī ki hāya putra ! tū kahā~ calā gayā ? tū nirantara sukhase laḍa़āyā gayā thā| tujhe videśa bhramaṇakī yaha kauna-sī prīti utpanna huī hai ? ||7|| tū kaṭhora mārgameṃ caraṇa-kisalayoṃkī pīḍa़āko prāpta ho rahā hogā| arthāt kaṃkarīle patharīle mārgameṃ calate-calate tere komala paira dukhane lagate hoṃge taba tū atyanta thaka kara kisa vanake nīce viśrāma karatā hogā ? |8|| hāya beṭā ! atyanta duḥkhinī mujha mandabhāginīko choḍa़ tū bhāī lakṣmaṇake sātha kisa diśāmeṃ calā gayā hai ?|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! vaha kausalyā jisa samaya isa prakārakā vilāpa kara rahī thī usī samaya ākāśamārgameṃ vihāra karanevāle devarṣi nārada vahā~ āye |1|| ve nārada jaṭārūpī kūrcako dhāraṇa kiye hue the, sapheda vastrase unakā śarīra āvṛta thā, avadvāra nāmake dhāraka the aura pṛthivīmeṃ sarvatra prasiddha the ||11|| unheṃ samopameṃ āyā dekha kausalyāne uṭhakara tathā āsana ādi dekara unakā

siddhayogamunidṛṣṭvā tāmaśrutaralekṣaṇām | ākārasūcitodāraśoko samparipṛṣṭavān ||13|| kutaḥ prāptā'si kalgāṇi vimānana midaṃ yataḥ | rudyate na tu sambhāvyaṃ tava duḥkhasya kāraṇam ||14|| sukośalamahārājaduhitā lokaviśrutā | ślāghyā'parājitābhikhyā patnī daśarathaśruteḥ ||15|| padmanābhanṛratnasya prasavitrī sulakṣaṇā | yena tvaṃ kopitā mānyā devateva hatātmanā ||16|| ava kurute tasya pratāpākrānta viṣṭapaḥ| nṛpo daśarathaḥ śrīmānnigrahaṃ prāṇahāriṇam ||17|| uvāca nāradaṃ devī sa tvaṃ ciratarāgataḥ | devarṣe vetsi vṛttāntaṃ nemaṃ yeneti bhāṣase ||18|| anya evāsi saṃvṛtto vātsalyaṃ tatpurātanam | kuto viśithilībhūtaṃ lacyate niṣṭhurasya te ||16|| kathaṃ vārtāmapīdānī tvaṃ nopalabhase guruḥ | atidurādivāyātaḥ kuto'pi bhramaṇapriyaḥ ||20|| tenoktaṃ dhātakīkhaṇḍe surendraramaṇe pure | videhe'jani pūrvasmitrailokyaparameśvaraḥ ||21|| mandare tasya devendraḥ surāsurasamanvitaiḥ | divyayā'dbhutayā bhūtyā jananābhiṣavaḥ kṛtaḥ ||22|| tasya devādhidevasya sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ | abhiṣeko mayā dṛṣṭaḥ puṇyakarmapravaddhakaḥ ||23|| ānandaṃ nanṛtastatra devāḥ pramuditāḥ param | vidyādharāśca vibhrāṇā vibhūtimatiśobhanām ||24|| jinendradarśanāsaktastasminnatimanohare | trayoviṃśativarṣāṇi dvīpe'hamuṣitaḥ sukham ||25|| tathāpi jananītulyāṃ saṃsmṛtya bharatakṣitim | mahākṛtikarīmeṣa prāpto'haṃ cirasevitām ||26|| jambūbharatamāgatya vrajāmyadyāpi na kvacit | bhavatī draṣṭumāyāto vārtājñānapipāsitaḥ ||27||
ādara kiyā ||12|| jisake netra ā~suāṃse tarala the tathā jisakī ākṛtise hī bahuta bhārī śoka prakaṭa ho rahā thā aisī kausalyāko dekha nāradane pūchā ki he kalyāṇi ! tumane kisase anādara prāpta kiyā hai, jisase ro rahī ho ? tumhāre duḥkhakā kāraṇa to sambhava nahīṃ jāna paḍa़tā ? ||13-14|| tuma sukośala mahārājakī lokaprasiddha putrī ho, praśaṃsanīya ho tathā rājā daśarathakī aparājitā nāmakī patnī ho ||15|| manuṣyoṃmeṃ ratnasvarūpa śrīrāmakī mātā ho, uttama lakṣaṇoṃse yukta ho tathā devatāke samāna mānanīya ho| jisa duṣṭane tumheṃ krodha utpanna karāyā hai, pratāpase samasta saṃsārako vyāpta karanevāle śrīmān rājā daśaratha āja hī usakā praṇāpahārī nigraha kareṃge arthāt use prāṇadaṇḍa deṃge ||16-17||

tato'parājitāvādīd yathāvṛttamaśeṣataḥ | sarvaprāṇihitācāryasthāgatiṃ gaṇadhāriṇaḥ ||28|| vaidehasya samāyogaṃ mahāvidyādharaprabhoḥ | daśasyandanarājasya pravajyāṃ pārthivaiḥ samam ||26|| sītālakṣmaṇayuktasya padmanābhasya nirgamam | viyogaṃ sītayā sākaṃ sugauvādisamāgamam ||30|| lacamaṇaṃ samare śaktyā laṅkānāthena tāḍitam | droṇameghasya kanyāyā nayanaṃ tvarayānvitam ||31|| ityuktvā'nusmṛtātyantatīvaduḥkhaparāyaṇā | aśrudhārāṃ vimuñcantī sā punaḥ paryadevata ||32|| hā hā putra gataḥ kvāsi ciramehi prayaccha me | vacanaṃ kuru sādhāraṃ magnāyāḥ śokasāgare ||33|| puṇyojjhitā tvadīyāsyamapaśyantī sujātaka | tībaduḥkhānalālīḍhā hataṃ manye svajīvitam ||34|| vandīgṛhaṃ samānatā rājaputrī sukhaidhitā| bālā vanamṛgīmugdhā sītā duḥkhena tiṣṭhati ||35|| nighṛṇena daśāsyena śaktyā lacama gasundaraḥ | tāḍito jīvitaṃ dhatte neti vārtā na vidyate ||36|| hā sudurlabhako putrī hā sīte sati bālike | prāptāsi jaladhemadhye kathaṃ duḥkhamidaṃ param ||37|| taṃ vṛttāntaṃ tato jñātvā vīṇāṃ kṣiptvā mahītale | udvigno nāradastasthau hastāvādhāya mastake ||38|| kṣaṇaniṣkampadehaśca vimṛśya bahuvīkṣitaḥ | abravīd devi no samyamvṛttametadvibhāti me ||36|| trikhaṇḍādhipatiścaṇḍo vidyādharamaheśvaraḥ | vaidehakapināthābhyāṃ rāvaṇaḥ kiṃ prakopitaḥ||40|| tathāpi kauśale śoka mā kṛthāḥ paramaṃ śubhe | acirādeṣa te vārtāmānayāmi na saṃśayaḥ||41|| kṛtyaṃ vidhātumetāvaddevi sāmarthyamasti me | śaktaḥ sa eva śeṣasya kāryasya tava nandanaḥ ||42|| pratijñāmevamādāya nāradaḥ khaṃ samudgataḥ | vīṇāṃ kakṣāntare kṛtvā sakhīmiva parāṃ priyām ||43||
tadanantara aparājitā ( kausalyā) ne jo vṛttānta jaisā huā thā vaha saba nāradase kahā| usane kahā ki saṅghasahita sarvabhūtahita ācāryakā āgamana huā| mahā vidyādharoṃke rājā bhāmaṇḍalakā saṃyoga huā| rājā daśarathane aneka rājāoṃke sātha dīkṣā dhāraṇa kī, sītā aura lakṣmagake sātha rāma vanako gaye, vahā~ sītāke sātha unakā viyoga huā, sugrīvādike sātha samāgama huā, yuddha meṃ laṅkāke dhanī-rāvaṇane lakṣmaṇako śaktise tāḍa़ita kiyā aura droṇameghakī kanyā viśalyā śīghratāse vahā~ le jāī gaī ||28-31|| itanā kahate hī jise tīvra duḥkhakā smaraṇa ho āyā thā aisī kausalyā aśrudhārā choḍa़tī huī punaḥ vilāpa karane lagī ||32|| hāya hāya putra ! tū kahā~ gayā ? kahā~ hai ? bahuta samaya ho gayā, śīghra hī ā, mere lie vacana de-mujhase vārtālāpa kara aura śokasāgarameṃ ḍūbī huī mere lie sāntvanā de ||33|| he satputra ! maiṃ puṇyahīnā tumhāre
khako na dekhatī tathā tīvra duḥkhāgnise vyāpta huī apane jīvanako nirarthaka mānatī hū~||34|| sukhase jisakā lālana-pālana huā tathā jo vanakī hariṇīke samāna bholī hai aisī rājaputrī beṭī sītā śatruke bandīgṛha meṃ paḍa़ī duḥkhase samaya kāṭa rahī hogī ||35|| nidaya rāvaṇane lakṣmaṇako śaktise ghāyala kiyā so jīvita hai yā nahīṃ isakī koī khabara nahīṃ hai ||36|| hāya mere atyanta durlabha putro ! aura hāya merī pativrate beṭī sīte ! tuma samudra ke madhya isa bhayaṅkara duḥkhako kaise prāpta ho gaī ||37||

tadanantara bharata una vidyādharoṃko lekara una mātāoṃke pāsa gayā aura vidyādharoṃne nirantara śoka karane tathā aśrupūrṇa netroṃko dhāraṇa karanevālo una mātāoṃko ānandita kiyā ||101|| rāma-lakṣmaṇakī mātāoṃ aura una vidyādhara dūtoṃke bīca manako prasanna karane tathā unakī vibhūtiko sūcita karanevālī yaha manohara kathā jabataka calatī hai tabataka suvarṇa aura ratnādise paripūrṇa hajāroṃ śīghragāmī vāhanoṃse sūryakā mārga rokakara raṅga-viraṅge meghoṃkā ākāra dhāraṇa karanevāle hajāroṃ vidyādharoṃke jhuṇḍa usa taraha ā pahu~ce jisa taraha ki jinendrāvatārake samaya mahātejasvī deva ā pahu~cate haiṃ ||102-104|| tadanantara ākāśameṃ sthita una vidyādharoṃne saba

trend bhānau padmanārāyaṇau tadā | yānaṃ puṣpakamāruhya sāketāṃ prasthitau śubhau ||1|| parivārasamāyuktā vividhairyānavāhanaiḥ | vidyādhareśvarā gantuṃ saktāstatsevanodyatāḥ ||2||

daśāṅgabhoganagaramadastad dṛśyate priye | rūpavatyāḥ pitā vajraśravā yacchrāvakaḥ paraḥ ||15|| punarālokya dharaṇī punaḥ papraccha jānakī | kānteyaṃ nagarī kasya khecareśasya dṛśyate ||16|| vimānasadṛśairge hairiyamatyantamutkaṭā | na jātucinmayā dṛṣṭā triviṣṭapaviḍambinī ||17|| jānakīvacanaṃ śrutvā diśaścālokya mantharam | kṣaṇaṃ vibhrāntacetasko jñātvā pamaḥ smitī jagau|| pūrayodhyā priye seyaṃ nūnaṃ khecaraśilpibhiḥ | anyeva racitā bhāti jitalaṅkā paradyatiḥ ||16|| tato'nyugraṃ vihāyaḥsthaṃ vimānaṃ sahasā param | dvitīyādityasakāśaṃ vīcya kṣubdhā nagaryasau ||20|| āruhya ca mahānāgaṃ bharataḥ prāptasambhramaḥ | vibhūtyā parayā yuktaḥ śakravaniragāt puraḥ ||21|| tāvadaivata sarvāśāḥ sthagitā gaganāyanaḥ | nānāyānatimānasthairvi citrarddhisamanvitaiḥ ||22|| dṛṣṭvā bharatamāyāntaṃ bhūmisthāpitapuṣpakau | padmalacamīdharau yātau samīpatvaṃ susammadau ||23|| samīpau tāvitau dṛṣṭvā gajādutīrya kaikayaḥ | pūjāmardhaśataiścakre tayoḥ snehādipūritaiḥ ||24|| vimānaśikharāttau taṃ niṣkramya prītinirbharam | keyūrabhūṣitabhujāvagrajāvāliliṅgatuḥ ||25|| dṛṣṭā pṛṣṭau ca kuśalaṃ kṛtaśaṃsanasatkathau | bharatena sametau tāvārūḍhau puṣpakaṃ punaḥ ||26|| praviśanti tataḥ sarve krameṇa kṛtasaskriyām | ayodhyānagarī citrapatākāśabalīkṛtām ||27|| sāhasaṅgatairyānavimānaryāyabhī rathaiḥ | bhanekapaghaṭābhiśca mārgo'bhūdu vyavakāśakaḥ ||28||
kā nagara hai jahā~ lakṣmaṇane tumhāre samāna kalyāṇamālā nāmakī adbhuta kanyā prāpta kī • thī||14|| he priye ! yaha daśāṅgabhoga nāmakā nagara dikhāī detā hai jahā~ rūpavatīkā pitā
vanakarṇa nāmakā utkṛṣṭa śrāvaka rahatā thā ||15|| tadanantara pṛthivīkī ora dekha kara sītāne punaḥ pūchā ki he kānta ! yaha nagarī kisa vidyādhara rājākī dikhāī detī hai ||16|| yaha nagarī vimānoṃke samāna uttama bhavanoṃse atyanta vyāpta hai tathā svargakī viḍamvanā karanevālī aisī nagarī maiṃne kabhī nahīṃ dekhī ||17||
sītāke vacana suna tathā dhīre-dhīre diśāoṃkī ora dekha rāmakā citta svayaṃ kṣaṇabharake lie vibhramameṃ paḍa़ gayā| parantu bādameṃ saba samācāra jāna kara manda hāsya karate hue bole ki he priye ! yaha ayodhyā nagarī hai | jāna paḍa़tā hai ki vidyādhara kārīgaroṃne isakī aisī racanā kī hai ki yaha anya nagarīke samāna jāna paḍa़ne lagī hai, isane laṃkāko jīta liyā hai tathā utkṛṣṭa kāntise yukta hai ||18-16|| tadanantara dvitīya sūryake samāna dedīpyamāna tathā ākāśake madhyameṃ sthita vimānako sahasā dekha nagarī kṣobhako prāpta ho gaī ||20|| kṣobhako prāpta huā bharata mahāgajapara savāra ho mahāvibhūtiyukta hotā huā indra ke samāna nagarose bāhara nikalā ||21|| usī samaya usane nānā yānoṃ aura vimānoṃmeṃ sthita tathā vicitra ṛddhiyoṃse yukta vidyādharoṃse samasta diśāoṃko ācchādita dekhā ||22|| bharatako ātā huā dekha jinhoṃne puṣpakavimānako pṛthibī para khaḍa़ā kara diyā thā aise rāma aura lakṣmaṇa harṣita ho samīpameṃ āye ||23|| tadanantara una donoṃko samopameṃ āyā dekha bharatane hāthīse utara kara snehādise pūrita saikaḍa़oṃ aghoṃse unakī pūjā kī ||24|| tatpaścāt vimānake śikharase nikala kara bājūvaṃdoṃse suśobhita bhujāoṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle donoṃ agrajoṃne baḍa़e premase bharatakā āliṅgana kiyā ||2|| eka dūsareko dekha kara tathā kuśala samācāra pūcha kara rāma-lakṣmaṇa punaḥ bharatake sātha puṣpakavimāna para ārūḍha hue ||26||
tadanantara jisakī sajāvaṭa kī gaī thī aura jo nānā prakārako patākāoṃse citrita thī aisī ayodhyā nagarīmeṃ kramase sabane praveśa kiyā ||27|| dhakkā dhūmīke sātha calanevāle yānoṃ,
1. puraḥ ma0| 2. bharataḥ| 3. aśvaiḥ| 4. vigatāvakāśaḥ |

padmapurāṇe
pralaṃmbajalabhṛttulyāstūryaghoṣāḥ samudyayuḥ | śaṅkhakoṭiravonmiśrā bhambhābherīmahāravāḥ ||26|| paṭahānāṃ paṭīyāṃso mandrāṇāṃ mandratā yayuḥ | lampānāṃ kampaśampānāṃ dhundhūnāṃ madhurā bhṛśam ||30|| jhallāmlātakahakānāṃ haikahukārasaṅginām | guñjāraṭitanāmnāṃ ca vāditrāṇāṃ mahāsvanāḥ ||31|| sukalāḥ kāhalā nādā ghanā halahalāravāḥ | aṭṭahāsāsturaṅgabhasiṃhavyāghrādinisvanāḥ ||32|| vaṃśasvanānugāmīni gītāni vividhāni ca | vinarditāni bhāṇḍānāṃ vandināṃ paṭhitāni ca ||33|| saṅkrīḍitāni ramyāṇi rathānāṃ sūryatejasām | vasudhākṣobhaghoṣāśca pratiśabdāśca koṭiśaḥ ||34|| evaṃ vidyādharādhīśairbibhradbhiḥ paramāṃ śriyam | vṛtau viviśataḥ kāntau puraṃ padmābhacakriṇau ||35|| bhāsan vidyādharā devā indrau panāmacakriṇau | ayodhyānagarī svargo varṇanā tatra kīdaśī ||36|| pamānananiśānāthaṃ vīcaya lokamahodadhiḥ | kaladhvaniyaṃyau vṛddhimatyāvarttanavelayā ||37|| vijñāyamānapuruṣaiḥ pūjyamānau pade pade | jaya varddhasva jīveti nandeti ca kṛtāśiṣau ||38|| atyuttuṅgavimānābhabhavanānāṃ śiraḥ sthitāḥ | sundaryastau vilokantyo vikacāmbhojalocanāḥ ||36|| sampūrṇacandrasaṅkāśaṃ padma padmanibhekṣaṇam | prāvṛṣeṇyadhanacchāyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca sulakṣaṇam ||40|| nāryoṃ nirīkṣituṃ satā muktāśeṣāparakriyāḥ | gavākṣān vadanaiścakromāmbhojavanopamān ||41|| rājannanyonyasamparke nirbhare sati yoṣitām | sṛṣṭā'pūrvā tadā vṛṣṭiśchinnahāraiḥ payodharaiḥ ||42||
vimānoṃ, ghoḍa़oṃ, rathoṃ aura hāthiyoṃkī ghaṭāoṃse ayodhyāke mārga avakāśarahita ho gaye ||28|| lūmate hue meghoṃkī garjanāke samāna turahīke śabda tathā karoḍa़oṃ śaṅkhoṃke śabdoṃse miśrita bhaṃbhā aura bheriyoṃke śabda hone lage ||26|| baḍa़e-baḍa़e nagāḍa़āke joradāra śabda tathā bijalīke samāna caścala laṃpa aura dhundhuoṃke madhura śabda gambhīratāko prāpta ho rahe the ||30|| haika nāmaka vādiyoṃko hu~kārase sahita jhālara, amlātaka, hakkā, aura guñjā raṭita nāmaka vāditroṃke mahāśabda, kāhaloṃke asphuṭa evaṃ madhura śabda, niviḍatāko prāpta hue halahalāke śabda, aṭṭahāsake śabda, ghoḍa़e, hāthī, siṃha aura vyāghrādike śabda, bā~surīke svarase mile hue nānā prakārake saṃgītake śabda, bhā~ḍa़oṃke viśāla śabda, vaṃdījanoṃke virada pāṭha, sūryake samāna tejasvī rathoṃkī manohara cītkāra, pṛthivīke kampanase utpanna hue śabda aura ina sabakī karoḍa़oṃ prakārakī pratidhvaniyoṃke śabda saba eka sātha milakara viśāla śabda kara rahe the ||31-34|| isa prakāra parama śobhāko dhāraṇa karanevāle vidyādhara rājāoṃse ghire hue sundara śarīrake dhāraka rāma aura lakṣmaṇane nagarīmeṃ praveśa kiyā ||35|| usa samaya vidyādhara deva the, rāma-lakṣmaṇa indra the aura ayodhyānagarī svarga thī taba unakā varṇana kaisā kiyā jāya ? ||36|| śrīrāmake mukha rūpī candramāko dekhakara madhuradhvani karanevālā loka rūpī sāgara, baḍha़tī huī velāke sātha vṛddhiko prāpta ho rahā thā ||37|| pahicānameṃ āye puruṣa jinheṃ pada-pada para pūja rahe the, tathā jayavanta raho, baḍha़te raho, jīte raho, samṛddhimān hoo, ityādi śabdoṃke dvārā jinheṃ sthāna-sthāna para āśīrvāda diyā jā rahā thā aise donoṃ bhāī nagarameṃ praveśa kara rahe the ||38|| atyanta ū~ce vimāna tulya bhavanoṃke śikharoṃ para sthita triyoṃke netrakamala rāma lakṣmaṇako dekhate hī khila uṭhate the ||36|| pūrṇa candramāke samāna kamalalocana rāma aura varṣākālīna meghake samāna śyāma, sundara lakṣaṇoṃke dhāraka lakṣmaṇako dekhane ke lie tatpara triyā~ anya saba kāma choḍa़ apane mukhoṃse jharokhoṃko kamala vanake samāna kara rahīṃ thīṃ ||40-41|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki rājan ! usa samaya parasparameṃ atyadhika samparka hone para jinake hāra ṭūṭa gaye the aisī striyoṃke payodharoṃ arthāt stanarūpī payodharoṃ arthāt meghoṃne
3. bhaṭṭahāsā -ma0|

dvadhaśītitamaṃ parva
cyutaṃ mipatitaṃ bhūmau kāñcīnū purakuṇḍalam | tāsāṃ tadgatacittānāṃ dhvanayaścaivamudgatāḥ ||43|| yasyaiṣāṅgatā bhāti priyā guṇadharā satī | devī videhajā so'yaṃ padmanābho mahekṣaṇaḥ ||44|| nihataḥ pradhane yena sugrīvākṛtitaskaraḥ | vṛtradaityapatenaptā sa sāhasagatiḥ khalaḥ ||45|| ayaṃ lacamīdharo yena śakratulyaparākramaḥ | hato laṅkeśvaro yuddhe svena cakreṇa vakṣasi ||46|| sugrīvo'yaṃ mahāsattvastanayo'syāyamaṅgadaḥ | ayaṃ bhāmaṇḍalābhikhyaḥ sītādevyāḥ sahodaraḥ ||47|| devena jātamātraḥ sannāsīd yo'pahṛtastadā | mukto'nukampayā bhūyo dṛṣṭo vidyādharendunā ||48|| unmādena (?) vane tasmin gṛhītvā ca pramodinā | putrastavāyamityuktvā puṣyavatyai samarpitaḥ||46|| eṣo'sau divyaratnātmakuṇḍalodyotitānanaḥ | vidyādharamahādhīśo bhāti sārthakaśabditaḥ ||50|| candrodarasutaḥ so'yaṃ sakhi śrīmān virādhitaḥ | śrīśailaḥ pavanasyā'yaṃ putro vānaraketanaḥ ||5|| evaṃ vismayayuktābhistoṣiṇībhiḥ samutkaṭāḥ| lakṣitāḥ pauranārībhiḥ prāptāste pārthivālayam ||52|| tāvatprāsādamūrddhasthe putranehaparāyaṇe | samprasrutastane vīramātarāvavateratuḥ ||53|| mahāguṇadharā devī sādhuśīlā'parājitā | kekayī kekayā cāpi suprajāśca suceṣṭitāḥ ||54|| bhavāntarasamāyogamiva prāptāstayoramā | mātaro'yuḥ samīpatvaṃ maṅgalodyatacetasaḥ ||55|| tato mātṛjanaṃ vīkṣya muditau kamalekṣaṇau | puṣpayānāt samuttīya lokapālopamadyatī ||56||
apūrva vṛṣṭi kī thī ||42|| jinake citta rāma-lakṣmaṇameṃ laga rahe the aisī striyoṃkī mekhalā, nū pura aura kuṇḍala ṭūṭa-ṭūṭakara pṛthivī para paḍa़ rahe the tathā unameṃ paraspara isa prakāra vārtālāpa ho rahā thā ||43|| koī kaha rahī thī ki jinakī godameṃ guṇoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī yaha rājā janakakī putrī pativratā sītā priyā vidyamāna hai yahī viśāla netroṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle rāma haiṃ ||4|| koī kaha rahī thī ki hā~, ye ve hī rāma haiṃ jinhoṃne sugrīvako ākṛtike cora daityarāja vṛtrake nātī duṣṭa sāhasagatiko yuddhameṃ mārā thā ||4|| koī kaha rahī thī ki ye indra tulya parākramake dhārī lakṣmaṇa haiṃ jinhoṃne yuddha meṃ apane cakrase vakṣaḥsthala para prahāra kara rāvaṇako mārā thā ||46|| koī kaha rahī thī ki yaha mahāśaktiśālī sugrīva hai, yaha usakā beṭā aṃgada hai, yaha sītādevīkā sagā bhāī bhāmaṇḍala hai jise utpanna hote hī devane pahale to hara liyā thā phira dayāse choḍa़ diyā thā aura candragati vidyādharane dekhā thā ||47-48|| yahī nahīṃ kintu harṣase yukta ho use vanameṃ jhelā thā tathā 'yaha tumhārā putra hai| isa prakāra kahakara rānī puṣyavatīke lie sauṃpā thā| apane divya ratnamayī kuṇḍaloṃse jisakā mukha dedīpyamāna ho rahā hai tathā jo sārthaka nāmakā dhārī hai aisā yaha vidyādharoṃkā rājā bhāmaṇḍala atyadhika śobhita ho rahā hai ||46-50|| he sakhi ! yaha candrodarakā laḍa़kā śrīmān virādhita hai ora yaha vānaracihnita patākāko dhāraṇa karanevālā pavanañjayakā putra śrīśaila (hanūmāna) hai ||51|| isa prakāra āścarya tathā saṃtoṣako dhāraṇa karanevālī nagaravāsinī striyā~ jinheṃ dekha rahī thīṃ aise utkaṭa śobhāke dhāraka saba loga rājabhavanameṃ pahu~ce ||52|| jaba taka ye saba rājabhavana meṃ pahuṃce taba taka jo bhavanake śikhara para sthita thī, putroṃke prati sneha prakaṭa karanemeṃ taiyāra thīṃ tathā jinake stanoṃse dūdha bhara rahā thā aisī donoṃ vīra mātāe~ ūparase utara kara nīce ā gaī ||53|| mahāguṇoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī tathā uttama
se yukta aparājitā (kauśalyā) kaikayī (sumitrā'), kekayā (bharatakī mātā) aura suprajā (suprabhā) uttama ceṣṭāko dhāraṇa karanevālī tathā maṅgalācārameṃ nipuṇa ye cāroṃ mātāe~ sātha-sātha rāma-lakṣmaṇake samīpa āī māno bhavāntarameṃ hī saṃyogako prāpta huī ho ||54-55||
__ tadanantara jo mātāoṃko dekhakara prasanna the, jinake netra kamalake samāna the aura jo lokapāloṃke tulya kāntiko dhāraṇa karanevāle the aise rāma-lakṣmaṇa donoṃ bhāī puṣpaka vimānase utara
1.na patitaṃ ka0, kha0, ma. | 2. 'unnādena' iti pāṭhena bhāvyam |

kṛtāñjalipuṭau nau sanṛpau sāṅganājanau | mātṛṇāṃ nematuḥ pādāvupagamya krameṇa tau ||57|| āśīrvādasahasrāṇi yacchantyaḥ śubhadāni tāḥ | pariṣasvajire putrau svasaṃvedyamitāḥ sukham ||58|| punaḥ punaḥ pariṣvajya tṛptisambandhavarjitāḥ | cucumburmastake kampikarāmarśanatatparāḥ || 51 || ānandavāṣpapūrṇākṣāḥ kṛtāsanaparigrahāḥ | sukhaduḥkhaṃ samāvedya dhṛtiṃ tāḥ paramāṃ yayuḥ ||60|| manorathasahasrāṇi guṇitānyasakṛtpurā | tāsāṃ śreṇika puṇyena phalitānīpsitādhikam || 61 || sarvāḥ sūrajananyastāḥ sādhubhaktāḥ sucetasaḥ | snuṣāśatasamākīrṇā lakṣmīvibhavasaṅgatāḥ ||62|| vīraputrānubhāvena nijapuṇyodayena ca | mahimānaṃ pariprāptā gauravaṃ ca supūjitam || 63 || cārodasāgarāntāyāṃ pratighātavivarjitāḥ | citāvekātapatrāyāṃ dadurājñāṃ yathepsitam || 64 || āryācchandaḥ
122
iṣṭasamāgamametaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ paṭhati cātiśuddhamatiḥ | labhate sampadamiṣṭāmāyuḥ pūrṇa supuṇyaṃ ca || 65||
eko'pi kṛto niyamaḥ prāpto'bhyudayaṃ janasya sadbuddheḥ | kurute prakāśamuccai ravivi tasmādimaṃ kuruta || 66 ||
ityārṣe raviṣeṇācārya prokte padmapurāṇe rāmalakṣmaṇasamāgamābhidhānaṃ nāma drayaśītitamaṃ parva || 82||
kara nīce āye aura donoṃne hātha joḍa़kara namrībhūta ho sāthameṃ āye hue samasta rājāoṃ aura apanī striyoṃke sātha kramase samīpa jākara mātāoṃke caraṇoṃ meṃ namaskāra kiyā ||56-57|| kalyāṇakārī hajāroṃ āśīrvādoṃko detī huī una mātāoṃne donoṃ putroṃkā āliṅgana kiyā | usa samaya ve saba svasaṃvedya sukhako prāpta ho rahī thīṃ arthāt jo sukha unheṃ prāpta huā thā usakā anubhava unhīṃko ho rahā thā - anya loga usakā varṇana nahīṃ kara sakate the || 58 || ve bāra-bāra āliṅgana karatī thīṃ phira bhī tṛpta nahīṃ hotī thīṃ, mastaka para cumbana karatī thīṃ, kā~pate hue hātha se unakā sparśa karatī thīṃ, aura unake netra harṣake ā~suoṃse pūrṇa ho rahe the| tadanantara āsana para ārūḍha ho parasparakā sukha-duḥkha pūcha kara ve saba parama dhairyako prāpta huī ||56-60 || gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! inake jo hajāroṃ manoratha pahale anekoṃ bāra guṇita hote rahate the ve aba puṇyake prabhāva se icchāse bhī adhika phalībhūta hue || 61 || jo sādhuoṃkī bhakta thīṃ, uttama cittako dhāraṇa karanevālī thīṃ, saikaḍa़oṃ putra vadhuoṃse sahita thīṃ, tathā lakṣmī ke vaibhavako prāpta thīṃ aisī una vīra mātāoṃne vīra putroṃke prabhāva aura apane puṇyodaya se lokottara mahimā tathā gauravako prāpta kiyā ||62-63 || ve eka chatrase suśobhita lavaṇasamudrānta pṛthivīmeṃ vinā kisī bādhā ke icchānusāra ājñā pradāna karatī thīṃ ||64 || gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki atyanta viśuddha buddhako dhāraṇa karanevālā jo manuṣya isa iṣṭa samāgamake prakaraṇako sunatā hai athavā paḍha़tā hai vaha iṣṭa sampatti pūrṇa āyu tathā uttama puṇyako prāpta hotā hai || 65 || sadbuddhi manuṣyakā kiyā huā eka niyama bhī abhyudayako prāpta ho sūryake samāna uttama prakāśa karatā hai| he bhavya jano ! isa niyamako avaśya karo || 66 ||

isa prakāra ārṣa nāmase prasiddha, śrī raviṣeṇācārya dvārā kathita padmapurāṇa meṃ rāma-lakṣmaṇa ke samāgamakā varṇana karanevālā vyāsīṣā~ parva samāpta huā| ||82||

dhārayāmi svayaṃ chanaṃ śaśādhavalaṃ tava | śatrughnaścāmaraṃ dhatte mantrī lakṣmaṇasundaraḥ ||7|| viśeṣatā nahīṃ dikhāī detī ||57|| jinakā śarīra apavitra vastuoṃse tanmaya hai tathā jo kevala camaḍa़ese ācchādita haiṃ aisī striyoṃse unakī sevā karane vāle puruṣako kyā sukha hotā hai ? ||58|| mūrkhamanā prāṇī malabhūta ghaṭake samāna atyanta lajjākārī saṃyogako prāpta ho mujha sukha huā hai aisā mānatā hai ||56|| are ! jo icchāmātrase utpanna honevāle svargasambandhī bhogoṃke samūhase tṛpta nahīṃ hotā use manuṣya paryāyake tuccha bhogoṃse kaise tṛpti ho sakatī hai ? ||60|| īndhana becane vālā manuṣya vanameṃ tṛṇoṃke aprabhāga para sthita osake kaṇoṃse tṛptiko prāpta nahīṃ hotā kevala śramako hī prāpta hotā hai ||61|| usa saudāsako to dekho jo rājalakṣmīse tṛpta nahīṃ hubhā kintu isake viparīta jisane naramāṃsa-bhakṣaṇa jaisā ayogya kārya kiyā ||62|| jisa prakāra pravāhayukta gaṅgāmeṃ māṃsake lobhī kāka, mṛta hastīke śavako cūthate hue tṛpta nahīṃ hote aura anta meṃ mahāsāgarameṃ praviṣṭa ho mṛtyuko prāpta hote haiṃ usī prakāra saṃsārake prāṇī viṣayoṃmeṃ tṛpta na ho anta meṃ bhavasāgarameṃ ḍabate haiṃ ||63|| he ātman ! moharūpī kīcaḍa़meṃ phaṃsī yaha terī prajārūpī meṃḍakī lobharūpī tīvra sarpake dvārā grasta ho āja naraka rūpī bilameṃ le jāī jā rahī hai ||64|| isa prakāra vicāra karate hue usa śānta cittake dhāraka virāgī bharatakī dīkṣāmeṃ vighna karane vāle bahutase dina vyatīta ho gaye ||6|| jisa prakāra samartha hone para bhī piṃjaḍa़e meṃ sthita siṃha dukhī hotā hai usī prakāra bharata dīkṣācāraṇa karanemeṃ samartha hotā huā bhī sarva duḥkhako naṣṭa karane vāle jinendravratako nahīṃ prāpta hotā huā duḥkhī ho rahā thā ||66|| bharatakī mātā kekayāne use rokaneke lie gamalakṣmaṇase yācanā kī so atyadhika snehake dhāraka rāmalakṣmaṇane praśāntacica bharatako roka kara isa prakāra samajhāyā ki he bhāī ! dīkṣāke abhilāṣī pitāne tumhīṃko sakala pṛthivītalakā rājā sthāpita kiyā thā ||67-68|| yataśca pitāne jagatkā śāsana karaneke lie niścayase āpakā abhiṣeka kiyā thā isalie hamalogoṃke bhī āpa ho svāmī ho| ataḥ āpa hī lokakā pālana kījiye ||66|| yaha sudarśana cakra aura ye vidyādhara rājā tumhārī ājñāke sādhana haiṃ isalie patnīke samāna isa vasudhākā upabhoga karo ||70|| maiṃ svayaṃ tumhāre ūpara

isī bīca meṃ mahāmegha ke samāna trilokamaṃḍana nāmakā jo prasiddha gajarāja thā vaha khambheko toḍa़kara apane nivāsagṛhase bāhara nikala āyā | usa samaya vaha mahābhayaṃkara śabda kara rahā thā tathā mada jalase ākāśako varṣāyukta kara rahā thā || 110 - 111|| meghakī saghana viśāla garjanā ke samāna usakī garjanā sunakara samasta ayodhyāpurī aisī ho gaī māno usake samasta loga unmatta hī ho gaye hoṃ || 112 || jinhoṃne bhīḍa़ ke kāraṇa dhakkāmukkī kara rakkhī thī, tathā jinake kāna aura netra bhayase sthira the aise idhara-udhara dauḍa़nekā śrama uṭhāne vāle mahāvatoṃse yukta hāthiyoṃse nagara rājamārga bhara gaye the ||113|| ghoḍa़oṃ ke vegako grahaṇa karanevāle ve mahābhayadāyī madonmatta hāthī icchānukūla daśoṃ diśāoṃ meṃ bikhara gaye - phaila gaye ||114|| jisake mahāśivara suvarṇa tathā ratnamaya the aise parvata ke samāna viśāla gopurako toḍa़kara vaha trilokamaṇḍana hāthī jisa

- tadanantara jo parijñānī thā, atyanta dīrgha ucchrāsa choḍa़ rahā thā aisā vaha vikārarahita hāthī isa prakārako cintāko prāpta huā ||127|| vaha cintā karane lagā ki yaha vahī hai jo brahmottara svargameṃ candramāke samāna śukla śobhāko dhāraṇa karanevālā merā parama mitra deva thā ||128|| yaha vahā~ se cyuta ho avaśiṣṭa puṇyake kāraṇa uttama puruṣa huā aura kheda hai ki maiṃ nindita kārya karatā huā isa tiryaśca yonimeṃ utpanna huā hū~ ||126|| maiṃ kārya-akāryake vivekase rahita

caturaśītitamaṃ parva
tathā vicintayanneṣa vinayī dvipasattamaḥ | padmābhacakrapāṇibhyāṃ vahadbhayā vismayaṃ param ||1|| kiñcidāśaktiātmābhyāmupasṛtya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | mahākālaghanākāro jagṛhe bhāṣitapriyaḥ ||2|| prāpya nārāyaṇādājñāmanyairuttamasammadaiḥ | sarvālaṅkārayogena parāṃ pūjāṃ ca lambhitaḥ ||3|| . praśānte dviradaśreṣṭhe nagaryākulatojjhitā | ghanāghanapaṭonmuktā rarāja śaradā samam ||4|| vidyādharajanādhīśaiścaṇḍā yasyottamā gatiḥ| rorbu nātibalaiḥ śakyā nākasabhireva vā ||5|| so'yaṃ kailāsakampasya rākṣasendrasya vāhanaḥ | bhūtapūrvaḥ kathaṃ ruddhaḥ sīriṇā lacamaṇena ca ||6|| tāraśīṃ vikṛtiṃ gatvā yadayaṃ śamamāgataḥ | tadasya pūrvalokasya puṇyaṃ dīrghāyurāvaham ||7|| nagaryāmiti sarvasyā paraṃ vismayamīyuṣaḥ | lokasya saṃkathā jātā vidhūtakaramastakā ||8|| tataḥ sītāviśalyābhyāṃ samaṃ taṃ vāraṇeśvaram | āruhya sumahābhūtibharataḥ prasthito gṛham ||6|| mahālaṅkāradhāriṇyaḥ śeṣā api varāṅganāḥ| vicitravāhanārūḍhā bharataṃ paryaveṣṭayan ||10|| turaṅgarathamārūḍho vibhūtyā parayā'nvitaḥ | śatrughno'sya mahātejāḥ prayayāvagrataḥ sthitaḥ ||11|| kamlāmlātakabheryādimahāvādinisvanaḥ | sañjātaḥ śaṅkhaśabdena miśraḥ kolāhalānvitaḥ ||12|| kusumāmodamudyānaṃ tyaktvā te nandanopamam | tridaśā iva saṃmprāpurālayaṃ sumanoharam ||13|| uttīrya dviradād rājā praviśyā''hāramaṇḍapam | sādhun santarpya vidhivat praṇamya ca viśuddhadhīḥ ||14||
athānantara jo isa prakāra vicāra kara rahā thā jisakā ākāra mahāśyāma medhake samāna thā tathā jisake prati madhura śabdoṃkā uccāraṇa kiyā gayā thā aise usa hāthīko parama āścarya dhāraṇa karanevāle tathā kucha kucha śaṅkita cittavāle rāma lakṣmaṇane dhīre dhīre pāsa jākara pakaḍa़ liyā ||1-2|| lakṣmaṇakī ājñā pākara uttama harṣase yukta anya logoṃne sarva prakārase alaṃkāra pahinākara usa hāthīkā bahuta bhārī satkāra kiyā ||3|| usa gajarājake śānta honepara jisakī ākulatā chūṭa gaī thī aisī vaha nagarī megharūpī paṭase rahita ho śarad ṛtuke samāna suśobhita ho rahī thī ||4|| jisakī atyanta pracaṇḍa gati vidyādhara rājāoṃ tathā atyanta balavān devoṃke dvārā bhī nahīṃ rokī jā sakatī thī ||5|| aisā yaha kailāsako kampita karanevāle rāvaṇakā bhūtapūrva vāhana rāma aura balabhadra ke dvārā kaise roka liyā gayā ? ||6|| usa prakārakī vikṛtiko prāpta hokara jo yaha śānta bhāvako prāpta huā hai so yaha usakī dīrghāyukā kāraṇa pūrva paryāyakā puṇya hī samajhanā cāhie ||7|| isa taraha samasta nagarīmeṃ parama āścaryako prāpta hue logoṃmeṃ hātha tathā mastakako hilānevālī caco ho rahī thī ||5|| tadanantara sītā aura viśalyāke sātha usa gajarāja para savāra ho mahāvibhūtike dhāraka bharatane gharakī ora prasthāna kiyā ||6|| jo uttamottama alaṃ. kāra dhāraṇa kara rahī thīṃ tathā nānā prakārake vāhanoṃpara ārūḍha thīṃ aisī śeṣa striyā~ bhī bharatako ghere hue thīṃ ||10|| ghoḍa़oṃke rathapara baiṭhā parama vibhūtise yukta mahātejasvī śatrughna, bharatake āge āge cala rahā thā ||11|| śaṅkhoṃke śabdase miśrita tathā kolāhalase yukta kamlā amlātaka tathā bherī ādi mahāvāditrīkā śabda ho rahā thā ||12|| jisa prakāra deva nandana vanako choḍa़kara apane atyanta manohara svargako prāpta hote haiṃ usī prakāra ve saba phūloṃkī sugandhise yukta kusumāmoda nāmaka udyānako choḍa़kara apane manohara gharako prāpta hue ||13||

mitrāmātyādibhiḥ sā bhrātṛpatnībhireva ca | āhāramakarot svaṃ svaṃ tato yāto janaḥ padam ||15|| kiṃkaḥ kiṃ punaḥ śāntaḥ kiṃsthito bharatāntike | kimetaditi lokasya kathā nebhe nivartate ||16|| magadhendrātha niḥśeṣā mahāmātrāḥ samāgatāḥ| praṇamyādariṇo'vocan pamaṃ lacamaṇasaṅgatam ||17|| aho'ya vartate deva turīyo rājadantinaḥ | vimuktapūrvakṛtyasya ślathavigrahadhāriṇaḥ ||18|| yataḥ prabhṛti saṃkṣobhaṃ samprāpya śamamāgataḥ | tata eva samārabhya vartate dhyānasaṅgataḥ ||16|| mahāyataṃ viniḥśvasya mukulākṣo'tivihvalaḥ | ciraṃ kiṃ kimapi dhyātvā hanti hastena medinīm ||20|| bahupriyaśataiḥ stotraḥ stūyamāno'pi santatam | kavalaṃ naiva gṛhṇāti na ravaṃ kurute śrutau ||21|| vidhāya dantayoragre karaṃ mīlitalocanaḥ | lepyakarma gajendrasya ciraṃ yāti samunnatam ||22|| kimayaṃ kṛtrimo dantī kiṃvā satyamahādvipaḥ | iti tatra samastasya matirlokasya vartate ||23|| cāṭuvākyānurodhena gṛhītamapi kṛcchutaḥ| vimuñcatyāsyamaprāptaṃ kavalaṃ mṛṣṭamapyalam ||24|| tripadīchevalalitaṃ samutsṛjya śucānvitaḥ | āsajya kiñcidālāne viniḥśvasyāvatiṣṭate ||25|| samastaśāstrasatkāravimalīkṛtamānasaiḥ | prakhyātairapyalaṃ vaidye vo nāsyopalacyate ||26|| racitaṃ svādareṇāpi saṅgītaṃ sumanoharam | na śṛṇoti yathāpūrva kvāpi nikṣiptamānasaḥ ||27|| maṅgalaiḥ kautukaiogaimantravidyābhirauṣadhaiḥ | na pratyāpattimāyāti lālito'pi mahādaraiḥ ||28|| na vihāra na nigāyāṃ na māse na ca vāriṇi | kurute yācito'pīcchāṃ suhṛnmānamito yathā ||26||
aura vidhipūrvaka praṇāma kara sādhuoṃko santuṣṭa kiyā ||14|| tatpaścāt mitroṃ, mantrī ādi pari. janoṃ aura bhaujāiyoṃke sātha bhojana kiyā | usake bāda saba loga apane apane sthāna para cale gaye ||15|| trilokamaṇḍana hāthī kupita kyoṃ huā ? phira śānta kaise ho gayā ? bharatake pāsa kyoṃ jā baiṭhā? yaha saba kyā bāta hai? isa prakāra logoṃkī hastiviṣayaka kathā dara hī nahīṃ thī| bhāvārtha-jahā~ dekho vahīṃ hāthīke viṣayakī carcā hotī rahatī thī ||16|| tadanantara gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! saba mahāvatoṃne ākara tathā ādara pūrvaka praṇāma kara rāma lakṣmaṇase kahā ||17|| ki he deva ! aho ! saba kārya choḍa़e aura śithila śarīrako dhāraṇa kiye hue trilokamaṇḍana hāthīko āja cauthā dina hai ||18|| jisa samayase vaha kṣobhako prāpta ho śānta huā hai usī samayase lekara vaha dhyānameṃ ārūḍha hai ||1|| vaha ā~kha bandakara atyanta vihvala hotā huā baḍa़ī lambī sāṃsa bharatā hai aura cirakāla taka kucha kucha dhyāna karatā huā saiṃḍase pṛthvīko tāḍa़ita karatā rahatā hai arthāt pṛthivīpara sūṃḍa़ paṭakatā rahatā hai ||20|| yadyapi usakī nirantara saikaḍa़oṃ priya stotroṃse stuti kī jātī hai tathāpi vaha na grāsa grahaṇa karatā hai aura na kānoṃmeṃ śabda hī karatā hai arthāt kucha bhī sunatā nahīṃ hai ||21|| vaha netra bandakara dā~toṃke agrabhāga para sa~ḍa rakhe hae aisā niścala khaḍa़ā hai māno cirakāla taka sthira rahanevālā hāthīkā citrāma hī hai ||22|| kyā yaha banāvaṭī hāthī hai ? athavā sacamucakā mahāgajarāja hai isa prakāra usake viṣayameṃ logoṃmeṃ tarka utpanna hotā rahatā hai ||23|| madhura vacanoṃke anurodhase yadi kisī taraha grāsa grahaṇa kara bhī letā hai to vaha usa madhura grāsako mukha taka pahu~caneke pahale hī choḍa़ detā hai ||24|| vaha tripadī chedakī līlāko choḍa़kara śokase yukta hotā huā kisī khambhe meṃ kucha thoḍa़ā aṭakakara sāṃsa bharatā huā khaḍa़ā hai ||25|| samasta śāstroṃke satkārase jinakā mana atyanta nirmala ho gayā hai aise prasiddha prasiddha vaidyoṃke dvārā bhī isake abhiprāyakā patā nahīṃ calatā ||26|| jisakā citta kisī anya padārthameṃ aṭaka rahā hai aisā yaha hāthī baḍa़e ādarake sātha racita atyanta manohara saṃgītako pahaleke samāna nahīṃ sunatā hai ||27|| vaha mahāna ādarase pyāra kiye jāne para bhī maṅgala maya kautuka, yoga, mantra, vidyā aura auṣadhi ādike dvārā svasthatāko prāpta nahīṃ ho rahā hai ||28|| vaha mānako prāpta hue mitrake samāna yācita honepara bhī na vihārameṃ, na nidrāmeṃ,

__ athānantara jo atyanta pavitra the, ajñānarūpī andhakārako naṣṭa karanevāle the, saṃsārarūpī ghora sāgarake nānā duḥkhoṃkā nirūpaṇa karanevāle the aura bharatake pūrvabhavoṃkā varṇana karanevāle the aise mahāmuni śrī deśabhūṣaṇa kevalīke ukta vacana suna kara vaha samasta sabhā citralikhitake samāna niścala ho gaī ||1-2|| tadanantara jinake hāra aura kuṇḍala hila rahe the, jo pratāpase prasiddha the, śrīmān the, indrake samāna vibhramako dhāraṇa karanevāle the, atyadhika saṃvegake dhāraka the, jinakā śarīra namrībhūta thā, mana udāra thā, jinhoṃne hastarūpī kamalakī boḍa़iyoṃko bā~dha rakkhā thā aura jo saṃsāra sambandhī nivāsase atyanta khinna the aise bharatane pṛthivī para ghuṭane ṭeka kara munirāja ko namaskāra kara isa prakāra ke atyanta manohārī vacana kahe ||3-5|| ki he nātha ! maiṃ saṃkaṭapūrṇa hajāroṃ yoniyoṃ meṃ cirakālase bhramaṇa karatā huā mārgake mahāśramase khinna ho cukā hū~ ataḥ mujhe mokṣakā kāraṇa jo tapaścaraṇa hai vaha dījiye ||6|| he bhagavan ! maiṃ janma-maraṇa rūpī ū~cī laharoṃse yakta saṃsārarūpī nadīmeṃ cirakālase bahatā calā ā rahā hū~ so āpa mujhe hāthakā sahārā dījiye ||7|| isa prakāra kaha kara bharata samasta parigrahakā parityāga kara paryaṅkāsanase sthita ho gaye tathā mahādhairya se yukta ho unhoṃne apane hāthase keśa loṃca kara ḍāle ||8|| isa prakāra parama samyaktvako pākara mahāvratako dhāraṇa karanevāle bharata tatkṣaṇameṃ dīkṣita ho utkṛṣṭa muni ho gaye ||6|| usa samaya bharatake muni avasthāko prāpta honepara ākāśa meṃ devoṃkā dhanya dhanya yaha śabda huā tathā divya puṣpoṃkī varṣā huī ||10|| bharatake anurāgase prerita ho kucha adhika eka hajāra rājāoṃne kramāgata rājyalakṣmīkā parityāga kara munidīkṣā dhāraṇa kī ||11|| jinakī śakti hīna thī aise kitane hī logoṃne munirājako namaskāra kara vidhipūrvaka gṛhastha dharma dhāraṇa kiyā ||12|| jo nirantara aśruoṃkī varṣā kara rahī thī, tathā jisakī cetanā atyanta ākula thī aisī bharatakī mātā kekayā ghabaḍa़ā kara unake pīche-pīche dauḍa़tī jā rahī thī so bīca meṃ hī pṛthivī

atha sādhuḥ praśāntātmā lokatrayavibhūṣaṇaḥ | bhaṇuvratāni muninā vidhinā parilambhitaḥ ||1|| samyagdarśanasaṃyuktaḥ paṃjñānaḥ sakriyodyataḥ | sāgāradharmasampūrṇo mataṅgajavaro'bhavat ||2|| pakṣamāsādibhirbhaktaścyutaiḥ' patrādibhiḥ svayam | śukaiḥ sa pāraṇāṃ cakre dinapūrṇa kavelikam || 3|| gajaḥ saṃsārabhīto'yaṃ sacceṣṭitaparāyaṇaḥ | arcyamāno janaiḥ kṣoṇīṃ vijahāra viśuddhimān || 4 || laḍḍukān maṇḍakān mṛṣṭānvividhāścārupūrikāḥ | pāraṇāsamaye tasmai sasatkāraṃ dadau janaḥ ||5||

athānantara jisakī ātmā atyanta śānta thī aise usa uttama trilokamaṇḍana hāthīko munirājane vidhipūrvaka aṇuvrata dhāraṇa karāye || 1|| isa taraha vaha uttama hāthī, samyagdarśana se yukta, samyagjñānakā dhārī, uttama kriyāoṃke ācaraṇameṃ tatpara aura gṛhastha dharmase sahita huā ||2|| vaha eka pakṣa athavā eka māsa ādikā upavāsa karatā thā tathā upavāsake bāda apane āpa gire hue sūkhe pattoṃ se dina meṃ eka bāra pāraṇā karatā thā || 3|| isa taraha jo saṃsārase bhayabhīta thā, uttama ceṣṭāoṃke dhāraṇa karane meṃ tatpara thā, aura atyanta viśuddhise yukta thā aisā vaha gajarāja manuṣyoṃ ke dvārā pūjita hotā huā pṛthivī para bhramaṇa karatā thā ||4|| loga pāraṇāke samaya usake lie baḍa़e satkāra ke sātha mīṭhe-mīṭhe lāḍū mā~ḍe aura nānā prakārakī pūriyā~ dete ||5|| jisake śarīra aura karma - donoṃ hī atyanta kṣīṇa ho gaye the, jo saṃvega rūpī khambhese ba~dhā huā thā, tathā yama hī jisakā aṃkuśa thā aise usa hāthīne cāra varṣa taka ugra tapa kiyā || 6 || jo dhīre-dhīre bhojanakā parityāga kara apane tapaścaraṇako ugra karatā jātā thā aisā vaha hāthī sallekhanā dhāraṇa kara brahmottara svargako prāpta huā ||7|| vahā~ uttama striyoṃse sahita tathā hāra aura kuṇḍaloṃse fuse usa hāthīne puṇya ke prabhāvase pahale hī jaisā devoṃkā sukha prāpta kiyā ||8||
idhara jo mahātejake dhāraka the, mahāvratī the, vibhu the, parvatake samāna sthira the, bāhyābhyantara parigrahake tyāgī the, śarīra kī mamatā se rahita the, mahādhīra vīra the, jahā~ sūrya ḍūba jātā thā vahīṃ baiṭha jāte the, aura cāra ārādhanāoṃkī ārādhanā meṃ tatpara the aise bharata mahāmuni nyāyapūrvaka vihāra karate the ||6- 10 || ve vāyuke samāna bandhana se rahita the, siṃhake samāna nirbhaya the, samudra ke samāna kṣobhase rahita the, aura meruke samāna niṣkampa the || 11 || jo digambara mudrāko dhāraṇa karanevāle the, satyarūpī kavacase yukta the, kṣamārūpī vāṇoṃse sahita the aura parīṣahoṃke jītane meṃ sadā tatpara rahate the aise ve bharatamuni sadā taparūpī yuddhameṃ vidyamāna rahate the || 12 || ve śatru aura mitra, sukha aura duḥkha tathā tṛṇa aura ratnameṃ samāna rahate the | isa taraha ve samabuddhike
