tato dārakriyāyogya dṛṣṭvā tāvatisundarau | vajrajaṅgho matiṃ cakre kanyānveṣaṇatatparām ||1|| lakṣmīdevyāḥ samutpannāṃ śaśicūlābhidhānakām | dvātriṃśatkanyakāyuktāmādyasthākarupayatsutām ||2|| vivāhamaṅgalaṃ draṣṭumubhayoryugapannṛpaḥ | abhilakṣyan dvitīyasya kanyāṃ yogyāṃ samantataḥ ||3|| apaśyanmanasā khedaṃ pariprāpta ivottamām | sasmāra sahasā sadyaḥ kṛtārthavamivātrajat ||4|| pṛthivī nagareśasya rājño'sti pravarāṅgajā | śuddhā kanakamālākhyāmṛtavatyaṅgasambhavā || 5|| rajanīpatilekhetra sarvalokamalimlucā | śriyaṃ jayati yā padmavatī padmavivarjitā || 6 || yā sāmyaṃ śaśicūlāyāḥ samāśritavatī śubhā | iti sañcintya taddhetordūtaṃ preṣitavānnṛpaḥ ||7|| pṛthivīpuramāsādya sa krameṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ | jagāda kṛtasammāno rājānaṃ pṛthusaṃjñakam ||8|| tāvadevekṣito dṛṣṭayā dūto rājñā viśuddhayā | kanyāyācanasambandhaṃ yāvad gṛhṇāti no vacaḥ || 1 || uvāca ca na tere dūta kācidapyasti dūṣitā | yato bhavān parādhīnaḥ paravākyānuvādakṛt ||10|| niruṣmāṇaśvalātmāno bahubhaṅgasamākulāḥ | jalaughā iva nīyante yatheṣṭaṃ hi bhavadvidhāḥ ||11|| kartu tathāpi te yukto nigrahaḥ pāpabhāṣiṇaḥ | pareṇa preritaṃ ki yantraṃ hantu vihanyate || 12 || kiñcitkartumaśaktasya rajaḥpāta samātmanaḥ | apākaraṇamātreṇa mayā te dūta satkṛtam ||13||
athānantara una sundara kumāroṃko vivāhake yogya dekha, rājā vājaṃghane kanyāoṃke khojane meṃ tatpara buddhi kī ||1|| so prathama hī apanī lakṣmī rānīse utpanna śaśicūlā nāmakī putrīko anya battīsa kanyāoṃke sātha lavaṇako denā niścita kiyā ||2|| rājā vajana donoṃ kanyāoṃkā vivāha maṅgala eka sātha dekhanā cāhatā thā| isalie vaha dvitīya putrake yogya kanyāoṃkī saba ora khoja karatā rahā ||3|| uttama kanyāko na dekha eka dina vaha manameṃ khedako prāpta hueke samāna baiṭhā thā ki akasmāt use śīghra hī smaraṇa āyā aura usase vaha māno kṛtakṛtyatāko hī prāpta ho gayā || 4 || usane smaraṇa kiyā ki 'pṛthivī nagarake rājākī amṛtavatī rānīke garbha se utpanna kanakamālā nāmakī eka śuddha tathā śreṣṭha putrī hai ||5|| vaha candramākī rekhāke samāna saba logoṃko haraṇa karanevālī hai, lakṣmīko jītatī hai aura kamaloṃse rahita māno kamalinī hī hai || 6 || vaha śaśicūlākī samānatāko prāpta hai tathā śubha hai'| isa prakāra vicāra kara usake nimittase rājā vajaṃdhane dūta bhejā || 7 || buddhimān dūtane krama-krama se pṛthivīpura pahu~ca kara tathā sanmāna kara vahā~ ke rājā pṛthuse vārtālāpa kriyā ||8|| usī samaya rājā pṛthune viśuddha dṛṣṭise dūtakī ora dekhā aura dūta jaba taka kanyākī yācanāse sambandha rakhanevālā vacana grahaṇa nahīṃ kara pāta hai ki usake pahale hī rājā pṛthu bola uṭhe ki re dūta ! isameṃ terā kucha bhī doṣa nahīṃ hai kyoṃki tū parādhīna hai aura parake vacanoṃkā anuvāda karanevālā hai ||6- 10|| jo svayaṃ ūṣmā ātmagaurava ( pakṣa meṃ garamī ) se rahita haiṃ, jinakī ātmā cañcala hai tathā jo bahubhaṃgoṃ aneka apamānoṃ ( pakṣa meṃ aneka taraṃgoṃ ) se vyāpta haiṃ isa taraha jalake pravāhake samāna jo āpa jaise loga haiṃ, ve icchānusāra cāhe jahā~ le jāye jāte haiṃ ||11|| yadyapi yaha saba hai tathāpi tūne pāpapūrṇa vacanoṃkā uccāraṇa kiyā hai, ataḥ terā nigraha karanā yogya hai kyoṃki dūsare ke dvārā calāyā huā vighātaka yantra kyā naṣṭa nahīṃ kiyā jātā ? ||12|| he dūta ! maiṃ jānatā hū~ ki tū dhūlī pānake samāna hai, aura kucha bhī karane meṃ samartha nahīṃ hai isalie yahā~ se haṭā denā mātra hī terā satkāra (?) arthāt

nigraha hai || 13 || yadyapi kula, śīla, dhana, rūpa, samānatā, bala, avasthā, deśa aura vidyā gama ye guṇaka tathāpi uttama puruṣa una sabameṃ eka kulako hī śreṣṭha guṇa mānate haiṃisakā honā āvaśyaka samajhate haiṃ, śeṣa guṇoṃ meṃ icchānusāra pravṛtti hai arthāt ho to ṭhīka na hoṃ to ṭhīka ||14- 15|| parantu vahī kula nāmakā prathama guṇa jisa varameṃ na ho use saba orase mānanīya kanyā kaise dī jā sakatī hai ? ||16|| so isa taraha nirlajjatāpūrvaka viruddha vacana kahane vāle usake lie kumārī arthāt putrīkā denā to yukta nahīṃ hai parantu kumārī arthāt khoṭā maraṇa maiṃ avaśya detā hū~ ||17|| isa prakāra jisake vacana sarvathā upekṣita kara diye gaye the aise dūtane nirupāya ho vāpisa jākara vājaṅghake lie saba samācāra kaha sunāyā || 18 ||

evamuktā satī devī jagāda vitāmrakā | na kasyacidahaṃ putrau kupitā kamalekṣaṇī ||2|| bhavatpiturmayā dhyātamadya tenā'smi duḥkhitā | rodimi prabalāyātanayanodakasantatiḥ ||63|| uktavatyāmidaṃ tasyāṃ tadā śreṇika vīrayoḥ | siddhārtho na pitā'smākamiti buddhiḥ samudgatā ||6|| tatastāvūcaturmātaḥ ko'smākaṃ janakaḥ kva vā | iti pṛṣṭā'gadatsītā svavṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ||65|| svasya sambhavamācakhyau rāmasambhavameva ca | araṇyāgamanaṃ caiva hṛtimāgamanaṃ tathā ||66|| yathā devarṣiṇā khyātaṃ tacca sarva savistaram | vartate'dyāpi kaḥ kālo vṛttāntasya nigṛhane ||67|| etaduktvā jagau putrau bhavatorgarbhajātayoḥ | kiṃvadantībhayenāhaṃ yuṣmapinojjhitā vane ||6|| tatra siharavākhyāyāmaṭavyāṃ kṛtarodanā | vāraṇārtha gatenāhaṃ vajrajaṅghana vīkṣitā ||66|| anena prāptanāgena vinivartanakāriṇā | viśuddhaśīlaratnena śrāvakeṇa mahātmanā ||7|| ahaṃ svaseti sambhāṣya karuṇāsaktacetasā | ānītedaṃ nijaṃ sthānaṃ pūjayā cānupālitā ||71|| tasyāsya janakasyeva bhavane vibhavānvite | bhavantau samprasūtā'haṃ padmanābhaśarīrajau ||72|| teneyaṃ pṛthivī vatsī himavatsāgarāvadhiḥ | lacamaṇānujayuktena vihitā paricārikā ||73|| mahā''have'dhunā jāte śroṣyāmi kimaśobhanam | nāthasya bhavatoḥ kiṃvā kiṃ vā devaragocaram ||7|| anena dhyānabhāreṇa paripīḍitamānasā | ahaṃ rodimi satputrau kuto'nya diha kāraṇam ||75|| tacchu tvā paramaṃ prāptau sammadaṃ smitakāriṇau | vikāsivadanāmbhojāvūcaturlavaṇāṅkuśau ||7||
kā kāraṇa batalānekī prasannatā karo ||61|| isa prakāra kahane para sītā devīne aśru dhāraṇa karate hue kahā ki he kamalalocana putro ! maiṃ kisī para kupita nahīṃ hū~ ||62|| āja mujhe tumhāre pitākā smaraṇa ho āyā hai isīlie duḥkhī ho gaī hū~ aura isīlie balāt abhaṃ ḍālatī huī ro rahī hū~ ||63|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! sītāke isa prakāra kahane para una donoṃ vīroṃkī yaha buddhi utpanna huī ki siddhārtha hamārā pitā nahīṃ hai ||64|| tatpaścāt una donoṃne pūchā ki he mātaḥ ! hamārā pitā kauna hai ? kahā~ hai ? isa prakāra pūchane para sītāne apanā saba vṛttānta kaha diyā ||6śā apanā janma, rāmakā janma, vanameṃ jānā, vahā~ haraṇa honā tathā punaḥ vāpisa ānā ādi jaisā vṛttānta nāradane kahā thā vaisā saba vistārase kaha sunāyā kyoṃki vṛttāntake chipāne kā aba kauna-sā avasara hai ? ||66-67||
yaha kaha kara sītāne kahā ki jaba tuma donoṃ garbha meṃ the taba lokāpavāda ke bhayase tumhāre pitāne mujhe vanameṃ choḍa़ diyā thā ||68|| maiṃ usa siṃharavā nāmakī aṭavīmeṃ ro rahī thī ki hāthī pakaḍa़neke lie gaye hue vanajaṃdhane mujhe dekhā ||6|| jo hāthī prāpta kara aṭavīse lauṭa rahā thā, jo viśuddha śakti rūpī ratnakā dhāraka thā, mahātmā thā evaṃ dayālucitta thā, aisā yaha śrāvaka vajrajaṃgha mujhe bahina kaha isa sthāna para le āyā aura baḍa़e sanmānake sātha usane hamārā pālana kiyā ||70-71|| jo tumhāre pitāke hī samāna hai aise isa vajrajaṃghake vaibhavaśālī gharameṃ maiṃne tuma donoṃko janma diyā hai| tuma donoṃ śrīrāmake śarīrase utpanna ho ||72|| he vatso ! lakṣmaṇa nāmaka choṭe bhāīse sahita una śrīrāmane himālayase lekara samudraparyantakī isa samasta pṛthivīko apanī dāsī banāyā hai ||73|| aba āja unake sātha tumhārā mahāyuddha honevālā hai so maiṃ kyā patikī amāṅgalika vārtā sunū~gī ? yā tumhārī ? athavā devara kī ? ||4|| isī dhyānake kāraṇa khinna citta honese maiṃ ro rahī hū~ | he bhale putro ! yahā~ aura dūsarā kāraṇa kyā ho sakatā hai ?||7||

aho so'sau pitā'smākaṃ sudhanvā lokapuṅgavaḥ | śrīmān viśālasatkīrtiḥ kṛtānekamahādbhutaḥ ||77|| viṣādaṃ mā gamaḥ mātarbane 2tyaktāhamityataḥ | bhagnāṃ mānonnatiṃ paśya rāmalacara
||78|| sītādhyavīdalamalaṃ virodhu guruṇā sutau| na vartata idaṃ katu bajatāṃ saumyacittatām ||7|| mahādhinayayogena samāgatya kṛtānatī| pitaraṃ paśyataṃ vatsau mārgo'yaṃ nayasaṅgataḥ ||8|| ucatustau ripusthānaprāptaṃ mātaḥ kathaṃ nu tam | bravo gatvā vacaḥ klobamāvā te tanayāviti ||8|| varaṃ maraṇamāvābhyāṃ prāpta saṅagrāmamūrddhani | na tu bhāvitamīhakṣa pravīrajananinditam ||2|| sthitāyāmatha vaideyāṃ joṣaṃ cintārtacetasi | abhiṣekādikaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhejāte lavaṇāṅkuśau ||3|| śritamālasaṅghau ca kṛtasiddhanamaskṛtī| prasānravya mātaraṃ kiñcit praṇamya ca mumaṅgalī ||4|| bhārūḍhau dviradau candrasūyau~ vā nagamastakam | prasthitāvabhisāketaṃ laṅkā vā rāmalakṣmaṇau ||5|| tataḥ sannāhaśabdena jñātvā nirgamanaṃ tayoḥ | kṣipraṃ yodhasahasrāṇi nirjagmuḥ pauṇḍarīkataḥ ||86|| parasparapratispa samutkarṣitacetasām | sainyaṃ darśayatāṃ rājñāṃ saṃghaṭṭaḥ paramo'bhavat ||7|| svairaṃ yojanamātra tī mahākaṭakasaṅgatau | pālayantau mahīṃ samyaṅnāśasyopaśobhitām ||8|| agrataḥ mahatodārapratāpī parameśvarau| prayātau viṣayanyastaiḥ pūjyamānau nareśvaraiḥ ||86|| mahākuṭhārahastānāṃ tathā kuddāladhāriṇām | puṃsāṃ daśasahasrāṇi saṃprayāṃti tadagrataḥ ||10|| chindantaḥ pādapādīste janayanti samantataḥ | uccāvacaninirmukkāṃ mahīṃ darpaṇasannibhām ||6||
dhāraka tathā aneka mahāna āścaryake karanevāle śrī rāma hamāre pitā haiṃ ||76-77|| he mātaḥ ! 'maiṃ vanameṃ choḍa़ī gaī hū~' isa bātakā viṣāda mata karo| tuma śīghra hī rāma-lakṣmaṇakā ahaṃkāra khaṇḍita dekho ||7|| taba sītāne kahā ki he putro ! pitāke sātha virodha karanā rahane do | yaha karanā ucita nahīṃ hai| tuma loga śāntacittatāko prāpta karo ||76|| he vatso ! baḍa़ī vinayake sātha jāo aura namaskāra kara pitāke darśana karo yahī mārga nyāyasaṃgata hai ||80||
yaha suna lavaṇāṅkaśane kahā ki ve hamāre śatruke sthānako prāpta haiṃ ataḥ he mātaḥ ! hama loga jākara yaha dīna vacana unase kisa prakāra kaheṃ ki hama tumhāre laḍa़ke haiṃ ||81|| saṃgrāmake agrabhāga meṃ yadi hama logoṃko maraṇa prāpta hotā hai to acchā hai parantu vīra manuṣyoṃke dvārā nindita aisā vicāra rakhanā acchā nahīṃ hai ||52|| athānantara jisakā citta cintāse duḥkhī ho rahā thā aisī sītā cupa ho rahī aura lavaṇāṃkuśane snāna ādi kārya sampanna kiye ||3|| tatpaścāta jinhoṃne maṅgalamaya munisaṃghakī sevā kī thī, siddha bhagavānko namaskāra kiyā thā tathā mātāko sāntvanā dekara praṇāma kiyā thā aise maṅgalamaya veṣako dhāraṇa karanevāle donoṃ kumāra do hāthiyoṃ para usa prakāra ārūḍha़ hue jisa prakāra ki candramā aura sūrya parvatake śikhara para ārūḍha़ hote haiṃ | tadanantara donoṃne ayodhyākī ora usa taraha prayāṇa kiyā jisa taraha ki rāma-lakṣmaṇane laṅkākī ora kiyā thā ||84-85|| tatpaścāt taiyārīke śabdase una donoṃkā nirgamana jānakara hajāroṃ yodhā śīghra hī pauṇḍarīkapurase bāhara nikala paḍa़e ||86|| parasparako pratispardhāse jinakā citta baḍha़ rahā thā aise apanī-apanī senāe~ dikhalānevāle rājāoṃmeṃ baḍa़ī dhakama-dhakkā ho rahī thī ||8|| tadanantara jo eka yojana taka phailī huī baḍa़ī bhārī senāse sahita the jo nānā prakārake dhānyase suśobhita pṛthivīkā acchī taraha pālata karate the, jinakā utkṛṣṭa pratāpa āgeāge cala rahā thā aura jo una-una deśoṃmeṃ sthāpita rājāoṃke dvārā pūjā prāpta kara rahe the, aise donoṃ bhāī prajākī rakṣā karate hue cale jā rahe the ||88-86|| baḍa़e-baḍa़e kulhāḍa़e aura kadāleṃ dhāraṇa karanevāle daśa hajāra puruṣa unake āge-āge calate the ||10|| ve vṛkṣoṃ ādiko

nādarśi malinastatra na dīno na bubhukṣitaḥ | tṛṣito na kuvastro vā jano na ca vicintakaḥ ||106|| nānābharaṇasampanāścāruveṣāḥ sukāntayaḥ | puruṣāstatra nāryaśca rejaḥ sainyamahārṇave ||17|| vibhūtyā parayā yuktāvevaṃ janakajātmajau | sāketāviṣayaṃ prāptāvindrāviva surāspadam ||10|| yavapuṇḍrekṣugodhūmaprabhṛtyuttamasampadā | sasyena śobhitā yatra vasudhāntaravarjitā ||10|| sarito rājahaṃsaudhaḥ sarāṃsi kamalotpalaiḥ | parvatā vividhaiḥ puṣpairgītairudyānabhūmayaḥ ||11|| nacikīmahipīvātaimahokṣa svarahāribhiḥ gopībhirmañcasaktābhiryatra bhānti vanāni ca ||111|| sīmāntāvasthitā yatra prāmā nagarasannibhāḥ| triviṣṭapapurābhāni rājante nagarāṇi ca ||112|| svairaṃ tamupabhujānau viṣayaṃ viṣayapriyam | pareṇa tejasā yuktau gacchantau lavaṇāṅkuśau ||113|| dantināṃ raṇacaṇḍānāṃ gaṇḍanirgatavāriṇā' | kardamatvaṃ samānītā sakalāḥ pathi pāṃsavaḥ ||11|| bhṛśaṃ paṭukhurāghātai jināṃ cañcalātmanām | jarjaratvamivānītā kosalāviṣayāvaniḥ ||115|| tataḥ sandhyāsamāsaktaghanaudheneva saṅgatam | dūre nabhaḥ samālacaya jagadurlavaṇāṃkuśau ||116|| kimetaddaśyate māma tuṅgaśoṇamahādyuti | vajrajakastato'vocatparijñāya cirādiva ||117|| devāveṣā vinītāsau raśyate nagarī parā | hemaprākārasajjātā yasyāśchāyeyamunnatā ||11|| asyāṃ haladharaḥ śrīmānāste'sau bhavatoḥ pitā | yasya nārāyaṇo bhrātā śatrudhnaśca mahāguṇaḥ ||116|| śauryamānasametābhiḥ kathābhiritisaktayoḥ | sukhena gacchasorāsīdantarāle tayornadī ||120||
baḍa़e ādarake sātha sabake lie madhu, svādiṣṭa peya, ghī, pānī aura nānā prakārake rasīle bhojana saba ora pradāna karate rahate the ||104-105|| usa senāmeṃ na to koī manuṣya malina dikhāī detā thā, na dīna, na bhūkhā, na pyāsā, na kutsita vastra dhāraṇa karanevālā aura na cintātura hī dikhāī paḍa़tā thā ||106|| usa senārūpī mahāsāgarameṃ nānā ābharaṇoṃse yukta, uttama veśase susajjita evaṃ uttama kāntise yukta puruṣa aura striyā~ suśobhita thīṃ ||107| isa prakāra paramavibhūtise yukta sītāke donoṃ putra usa taraha ayodhyāke usa deśameṃ pahu~ce jisa taraha ki indra devoṃke sthānameṃ pahu~cate haiṃ ||10|| jau, pauḍe, īkha tathā gehū~ ādi uttamottama dhānyoṃse jahā~kī bhūmi nirantara suśobhita hai ||106|| vahā~kī nadiyā~ rājahaṃsoṃke samūhoṃse, tālāba kamaloṃ aura kuvalayoṃse, parvata nānā prakārake puṣpoṃse aura bāga-bagīcoṃkī bhūmiyā~ sundara saṃgītoṃse suśobhita haiṃ ||110|| jahā~ ke vana baḍa़e-baḍa़e bailāṃke śabdoṃse, sundara gāyoṃ aura bhaisoṃke samūhase tathā macānapara baiṭhī gopālikāoṃse suśobhita haiṃ ||111|| jahā~kī sīmāoṃpara sthita gā~va nagaroṃke samāna aura nagara svargapurīke samāna suśobhita haiṃ ||112|| isa taraha pañcendriyake viṣayoṃse priya usa deśakā icchānusāra upabhoga karate hue, paramatejake dhāraka lavaṇāṅkaśa ānandase cale jāte the ||113|| raṇake kāraṇa tīvra krodhako prāpta hue hāthiyoṃke gaṇḍasthalase jharanevāle jalase mārgakī samasta dhūli kīcaḍa़pane ko prāpta ho gaī thī||114|| caścala ghoḍa़oṃke tīkṣṇa khurāvātase usa komala deśako bhūmi māne atyanta jarjara avasthāko prāpta ho gaī thī ||115|||
tadanantara lavaṇāṅkaśa, dūrase hī ākāśako sandhyākālīna meghoṃke samūha sahita jaisā dekhakara bole ki he māma! jisakī lāla-lāla viśāla kānti bahuta ū~cī uṭha rahī hai aisā yaha kyā dikhāī de rahā hai ? yaha suna vajrajaṅghane bahuta derataka pahicānaneke bāda kahā ki he devo! yaha vaha utkṛṣṭa ayodhyā nagarī dikhāī de rahī hai jisake suvarṇamaya koṭakī yaha kānti itanā ū~cī uṭha rahī hai ||116-118|| isa nagarīmeṃ vaha śrīmān balabhadra rahate haiṃ jo ki tuma donoṃke pitā haiṃ tathā nārāyaṇa aura mahāguṇavān śatrughna jinake bhāī haiṃ ||116|| isa taraha śūra-vīratā

pravṛttavegamātreṇa nagarī grahaṇepiṇoḥ | jātā'sāvantare tṛṣṇā siddhiprasthitayoriva ||12|| sainyamāvāsitaṃ tatra pariśramasamāgatam | surasainyamivodāramupanandananimnagām ||122|| atha śrutvā parānīkaṃ sthitamāsannagocare | kiñcidvismayamāpanācatuḥ pammalakṣmaṇau ||12|| tvaritaṃ kaḥ punamata mayaṃ vāñchati mānavaḥ | yuddhāpadeśamāśritya yadetyantikamāṣayoḥ||124 dadau nārāyaṇaścājñāṃ virādhitamahībhṛte | kriyatāṃ sādhanaṃ saja yuddhāya kṣepavarjitam ||125|| vṛpanāgaplavaṅgādiketanāḥ khecarādhipāḥ | kriyantāmuditajñānā samprāpte raṇakarmaṇi ||126|| yathā''jñāpayasīyuktvā virādhitakhageśvaraḥ | nṛpān kiṣkindhanāthādyān samāhvāya samudyataḥ||127|| datadarśanamātreṇa sarve te khecareśvarāḥ | ayodhyānagarī prāptā mahāsādhanasaṅgatāḥ ||12|| athātyantākulāramānau tadā siddhārthanāradau | prabhāmaṇḍalarājāya gatvā jñāpayatāṃ drutam ||126|| śruṣā svasuryathā vṛttaṃ vātsalyaguṇayogataḥ | babhūva paramaṃ duḥkhī prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ||130|| viṣādaṃ vismayaṃ harpa vibhrāṇaśca tvarānvitaḥ | āruhya manasā tulyaṃ vimānaṃ pitṛsaṅgataḥ ||531|| sametaḥ sarvasainyena kirtavyatvavihvalaḥ | pauṇḍarīkapuraṃ caiva prasthitaḥ snehanirbharaḥ ||132|| prabhāmaṇḍalamāyātaṃ janakaṃ mātaraṃ tathā | dṛṣṭvā sītā navībhūtaśokotthāya svarānvitā ||13|| vipralāpaṃ pariṣvajya cakretrakṛtadurdinā | nirvāsanādikaṃ duḥkhaṃ vedayantī suvihvalā ||13|| sānvayitvā'tikṛccheṇa tāṃ prabhāmaṇḍalo jagau| devi saṃśayamāpanau putrau te sādhu no kṛtam ||135||
aura gauravase sahita kathāoṃse jo atyanta prasanna the aise sukhase jāte hue una donoṃke bīca nadī ā paḍa़ī ||120|| jo apane cālū vegase hī usa nagarīko grahaṇa karanekī icchā rakhate the aise una donoṃ vīroṃke bīca vaha nadī usa prakāra ā paḍa़ī jisaprakāra ki mokṣake lie prasthāna karane vāleke bīca tṛṣṇā ā paḍa़tī hai ||121|| jisa prakāra nandana,vanakī nadīke samīpa devoṃkī viśāla senā ṭhaharāī jātī hai usī prakāra usa nadīke samīpa thakī māṃdī senā ṭhaharā dī gaī ||122||
athānantara śatrakī senāko nikaṭavartī sthānameṃ sthita suna parama āścaryako prāpta hote hae rāma lakṣmaṇane kahā ki ||123|| yaha kauna manuṣya śīghra hī maranā cāhatā hai jo yuddhakā bahānā lekara hama donoṃ ke pāsa calā ā rahā hai ||124|| lakṣmaṇane usī samaya rājā virādhitako ājñā do ki binā kisī vilambake yuddha ke lie senā taiyāra kī jāya ||125|| raṇakā kārya upasthita huā hai isalie vṛpa, nāga tathā vānara ādikī patākāoṃko dhāraṇa karane vāle vidyādhara rājāoṃ ko saba samācārakā jñāna karāo arthāt unake pāsa saba samācāra bheje jā~ya ||126|| 'jaisī āpa ājñā karate haiṃ vaisā hī hogā' isa prakāra kaha kara rājā virādhita sugrīva ādi rājāoṃ ko bulā kara yuddhake lie udyata ho gayā ||127|| dūtake dekhate hī ve saba vidyādhara rājā baḍa़ī-baḍa़ī senāeṃ lekara ayodhyā ā pahu~ce ||128||
____ athānantara jinakī ātmā atyanta ākula ho rahī thī aise siddhārtha aura nāradane śīghra ho jā kara bhāmaṇḍalake lie saba khabara dī ||126|| bahina sītākā jo hāla huā thā use suna kara vātsalpa guṇake kāraṇa bhāmaṇḍala bahuta dukhī huā ||130|| tadanantara viṣāda vismaya aura harṣako dhāraṇa karane vālā, śīghratāse sahita evaṃ snehase bharā bhāmaṇḍala, kiṃkatevyavimūḍha hoṃ pitā sahita manake samāna śīghragāmī vimāna para ārūḍha़ ho saba senāke sātha pauṇḍarīkapurakī ora calā ||131-132|| bhāmaṇḍala, pitā aura mātāko āyā dekha jisakā śoka nayā ho gayā thā aisī sītā śīghratāse uṭha sabakā āliṅgana kara āsuṃoṃkī lagātāra varṣā karatī huī vilāpa karane lagī| vaha usa samaya apane parityāga ādike duḥkhako batalātī huī vihvala ho uṭhatī thī ||133-134|| bhāmaṇḍalane use baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse sāntvanā dekara kahā ki he devi ! tere putra

halacakradharau tābhyāmupetya cobhitau yataḥ | surāṇāmapi yau vīrau na jayyau puruṣottamau ||136|| kumārayostayoryāvaspramādo nopajāyate | vrajāmastāvadevāśu cintayāmo'bhirakṣaṇam ||137|| tataḥ snuṣāsametā'sau bhāmaṇḍalavimānagā| pravṛttā tanayau tena vajrajabalānvitau ||13|| rāmalacamaṇayorlacamī ko'sau varṇayituṃ tamaḥ | iti śreṇika saṃkṣepāskīya॑mānamidaṃ śṛṇu ||136|| rathāśvagajapādātamahārṇavasamāvṛtau | vahantāviva saṃrambhaṃ nirgatau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||140|| bhaśvayuktarathārūḍhaḥ śatrudhnaśca pratāpavān | hārarājitavakṣasko niryayau yuddhamānasaḥ || 14 || tato'bhavatkṛtāntāsyaḥ sarvasainyapuraḥsaraḥ| mānī hariṇakeśīva nākaukāsanikāgraṇīḥ ||142|| śarāsanakṛtacchāyaṃ caturaṅga mahādyuti | aprameyaṃ balaṃ tasya pratāpaparivāraṇam ||143|| suraprāsādasaṅkāśo madhyastambho'ntakadhvajaḥ | śātravānīkaduḥprekṣo reje tasya mahārathaḥ ||144|| anumārga nimūnoṃ'sya tato vahniśikho nṛpaḥ | siṃhavikramanāmā ca tathā dīrghabhujaśrutiḥ ||145|| siṃhodaraḥ sumeruśca bālikhilyo mahābalaḥ | pracaṇḍo raudrabhūtiśca śarabhaḥ syandanaḥ pṛthuḥ ||146|| kuliśaśravaṇaścaṇḍo māridattoraṇapriyaḥ | mṛgendravāhanādyāśca sāmantā mattamānasāḥ ||147|| sahasrapañcakeyattā nānāśastrāndhakāriṇaḥ | nirjagmurvandi nāṃ vṛndairugītaguṇakoṭayaḥ ||148|| evaṃ kumārakovyo'pi kuṭilānīkasaṅgatāḥ | dṛṣṭapratyayaśastrāneṃ kṣaṇavinyastacakṣuṣaḥ ||14|| yuddhānandakṛtotsāhā nāthabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | mahābalārasvarāvatyo nirīyuḥ kampitakṣamāḥ ||15|| rathaiḥ kecinagaistuṅgaircāipaiḥ kecidghanopamaiḥ | mahārṇavataraṅgābhaisturaṅgairaparaiḥ pare ||151||
saṃśayako prāpta hue hai| unhoṃne yaha acchā nahīṃ kiyā ||135| unhoṃne jākara una balabhadra aura nārāyagako kṣobhita kiyā hai jo puruṣottama vīra devoṃke bhī ajeya haiṃ ||136|| jaba taka una kumārīkā pramāda nahīṃ hotā hai taba taka āo śīghra hī caleṃ aura rakṣākā upāya soceṃ ||137|| tadanantara putra-vadhuoṃ sahita sītā bhāmaṇḍalake vimānameṃ baiṭha usa ora calī jisa ora ki vajrajaṅgha aura senāse sahita donoṃ putra gaye the ||138||
athānantara gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! rāma lakṣmaṇakī pūrṇa lakṣmīkā varṇanake lie kauna samartha hai ? isalie saṃkṣepase hī yahā~ kahate haiṃ so suna ||136|| ratha, ghoḍa़e, hāthī aura paidala sainika rūpa mahāsāgarase ghire hue rāma lakṣmaṇa krodhako dhāraṇa karate hueke samāna nikale ||140|| jo ghoḍa़e jute hue ratha para savāra thā, jisakā vakṣaḥ sthala hārase suśobhita thā tathā jisakā mana yuddhameṃ laga rahā thā aisā pratāpī śatrughna bhī nikala kara bāhara āyā ||141|| jisa prakāra hariṇakeśī deva sainikoṃkā agraṇī hotā hai usī prakāra mānī kṛtāntavaktra saba senākā agrasara huā ||142|| jisameṃ dhanuṣoṃkī chāyā ho rahī thī tathā jo mahā kāntise yukta thī aisī usakī aparimita caturaṅgiṇī senā usake pratāpako baḍha़ā rahī thī ||143|| jisameṃ bīcake khambhā ke ūpara dhvajā phaharā rahī thī, tathā jo śatruoṃkī senāke dvārā durnirīkṣya thā aisā usakā baḍa़ā bhārī ratha devoṃke mahalake samāna suśobhita ho rahā thā ||144|| kṛtāntavaktrake pīche trimūrdha, phira agniśikha, phira siṃhavikrama, phira dīrghabāhu, phira siṃhodara, sumeru, mahābalavān bālikhilya, atyanta krodhī raudrabhūti, śarabha, syandana, krodhī vanakarṇa, yuddhakā premī māridatta, aura madonmatta manake dhāraka mṛgendravāhana ādi pā~ca hajāra sāmanta bāhara nikale| ye sabhī sāmanta nānā śastra rūpī andhakārako dhāraṇa karanevāle the tathā cāraṇoṃke samūha unake karoḍa़oṃ guṇoṃkā udgāna kara rahe the ||145-148|| isī prakāra jo kuṭikta senāoṃse sahita thī, jinhoṃne viśvāsaprada śastra ke ūpara kṣaṇa bharake lie apanī dṛṣṭi ḍālī thā, yuddha sanbandhī harṣase jinakā utsāha baḍha़ rahā thā, jo svāmīkī bhaktimeṃ tatpara thīṃ, mahābalavān thīṃ, śīghratāse sahita thīṃ aura jinhoṃne pṛthivīko kampita kara diyā thā aisī kumāroṃkī aneka śreṇiyā~ bhī bāhara nikalīṃ ||146-150|| nānā prakāra

dvayuttaraśataṃ parva śibikāśikharaiḥ kecidyuyogyataraiḥ pare | niryayubahuvādibadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhāḥ ||152|| sakaṭaśirastrāṇāḥ krodhāliṅgitacetasaḥ | purāiṣṭasuvikrāntaprasādaparasevakāḥ ||153|| tataḥ śrutvā parānīkaniḥsvanaṃ sambhramānvitaḥ | samāteti sainyaṃ svaṃ vajrajā: samādiśat ||15|| tataste parasainyasya śrutvā niḥsvanamāvṛtāḥ | svayameva susamaddhāstasyāntikamupāgaman ||155|| kālānalopracaṇḍāvanā nepālavarvarāḥ | pauṇḍrā māgadhasausnāśca pāraśailāḥ sasiṃhalāḥ ||156|| kālikāśca rājāno ratnākādyā mahābalāḥ | ekādaśasahasrāṇi yuktā jhuttamatejasā ||15|| evaṃ tatparamaṃ sainyaṃ parasainyakṛtānanam | saṅghamuttamaṃ prāptaṃ calitaṃ pracalāyudham ||15|| tayoḥ samāgamo raudro devāsurakṛtādbhutaḥ | babhūva sumahāśabdaḥ kṣubdhākūpārayoriva ||15|| prahara prathamaṃ kṣudra muñcāstraṃ kimupecase | prahantuṃ prathamaṃ śastraṃ na me jātu pravartate ||16|| prahṛtaṃ ladhunā tena viśado'bhūbhujo mama | praharasva vapurgāḍhaṃ daḍhapīḍitamuṣṭikaḥ ||16|| kiścid vraja purobhāgaṃ sañcāro nāsti saṅgare | sāyakasyanamujjhitvā churikāṃ vā samāśraya ||162| ki vepase na hanmi svāṃ muñca mārgamayaṃ paraḥ | bhaṭo yuddhamahākaṇḍūcapalo'gre'vatiṣṭhatām ||163|| kiṃvathā garjasi vadana vīrya vāci tiṣṭhati | ayaṃ te ceṣṭiteneva karomi raṇapūjanam ||16|| evamācā mahārāvā bhaṭānāṃ śauryaśālinām | niśceharatigambhīrā vadanebhyaḥ samantataḥ ||165||
ke vāditroṃse jinhoṃne diśāoṃko bahirā kara diyā thā, jo kavaca aura ṭopase sahita the, jinake citta krodhase vyāpta the, tathā jinake sevaka pūrva dṛṣṭa, parama parākramī aura prasannatā prāpta karane meṃ tatpara the aise kitane hī loga parvatoṃke samāna ūṃce rathāsa, kitane hī meghoṃ ke samāna hādhiyāṃsaṃ kitane hī mahāsāgarakī taraṅgoṃke samāna ghoḍa़oṃse, kitane hī pālakīke śikharoṃse aura kitane hī atyanta yogya vṛṣabhoṃse arthāt ina para ārūḍha ho bāhara nikale ||151-153||
tadanantara parakīya senākā śabda sunakara saṃbhramase sahita vajrajacanne apanī senāko ādeśa diyā ki taiyāra hoo ||154|| tadanantara para-senākā śabda sunakara kavaca ādise āvṛta saba sainika taiyāra ho vanajaṅghake pāsa svayaṃ ā gaye ||155|| pralaya kālakī agnike samāna pracaṇḍa aṅga, baṅga, nepāla, varvara, pauṇḍa, māgadha, sausna, pāraśaila, siṃhaka, kāliṅgaka tathā ratnāṅka ādi mahābalavān evaṃ uttamatejase yukta gyāraha hajāra rājā yuddhake lie taiyāra hue ||156-157|| isaprakāra jisane śatrusenākī ora mukha kiyā thā, tathā jisameṃ śastra cala rahe the aisī vaha cañcala utkṛṣṭa senā uttama saṃghaṭṭako prāpta huī arthāt donoṃ senāoṃ meṃ tībra muṭhabheḍa़ huī ||158|| una donoṃ senāoṃ meṃ aisā bhayaṃkara samāgama huā jo pahale hue deva aura asuroṃke samāgamase bhī kahīṃ āścaryakārī thā tathā kṣobhako prāpta hue do samudroṃke samāgamake samāna mahāśabda kara rahā thā ||156|| 'are kṣudra ! pahale prahāra kara, śastra choḍa़, kyoṃ upekṣā kara rahā hai ? merā śastra pahale prahāra karaneke lie kabhī pravṛtta nahīṃ hotā ||160|| are, usane halakā prahāra kiye isase merī bhujā svastha rahī āī arthāt usameṃ kucha huā hī nahīṃ, jarā dṛḍha़ muṭṭhī kasa kara śarīrapara joradāra prahāra kara ||161|| kucha sāmane ā, yuddha meṃ vāṇakā saṃcāra ṭhīka nahīṃ ho rahā hai, athavā phira vāṇako choḍa़ churī uṭhā ||162|| kyoṃ kā~pa rahā hai ? maiṃ tujhe nahīṃ māratā, mārga choḍa़, yuddhakī mahākhājase capala yaha dūsarā prabala yoddhā sāmane khaḍa़ā ho ||163|| are kṣudra ! vyartha kyoṃ garaja rahā hai ? vacanameṃ śakti nahīṃ rahatī, yaha maiṃ terī ceṣṭāse hī raṇako pūjā karatā hū~ ||164|| inheṃ ādi lekara, parākramase suśobhita yoddhāoṃke mukhoṃse saba ora atyanta gambhīra mahāśabda nikala rahe

athānantara jaba kartavya ke jñāna aura prayogameṃ atyanta nipuṇa hanūmānne lavaṇāṅkuśakī vāstavika utpatti sunī taba vaha vidyādhara rājāoṃke saṃghaṭṭako śithila karatā huā lavaṇāṅkuśake pakṣa meṃ ā gayā ||166-170|| lāṅgūla nāmaka śastrako hāthameṃ dhāraṇa kara rāmakī senā se nikalate hue hanūmānne bhāmaṇḍalakā citta harṣita kara diyā || 171 || tadanantara vimāna ke śikhara para ārūḍha jānakīko dekhakara saba vidyādhara rājā udāsīnatāko prāpta ho gaye || 172 || aura hātha joḍa़ baḍa़e ādarase use praṇāma kara atyadhika āścaryako dhāraṇa karate hue use gherakara khaḍa़e ho gaye ||173 || sītāne jaba donoṃ senāoṃkī muṭhabheḍa़ dekhī taba usake netra bhayabhīta hariṇīke samāna cañcala ho gaye, usake śarīra meṃ romāna nikala āye aura ka~paka~pī chūṭane lagī || 174 ||

padmapurāṇe
niḥkrāmadhirodgārasahitorubhaṭasvanam | vegavacchatrasampātajātavahnikaṇotkaram ||166|| kariśūskṛtasambhūtasīkarāsārajālakam | karidāritavakṣaskabhaṭasaṅkaṭabhūtalam ||117|| paryastakarisarudvaraṇamārgākulāyatam | nāmameghapariśyotanmuktāphalamahopalam ||16|| muktāsārasamāghātavikaṭaṃ karmaraṅgakam | nāgocchālitapunnāgakṛtakhecarasaṅgamam ||166|| śira krītayaśoravaṃ mūrkhājanitaviśramam | maraṇaprāptanirvāṇaṃ babhūva raṇamākulam ||20||
āryācchandaḥ jīvitatṛṣṇārahitaṃ sādhusvanajaladhilubdhayaudheyam | samaraṃ samarasamāsīnmahati laghiṣṭhe ca vīrāṇām ||201|| bhaktiḥ svāmina paramā niṣkrayadānaṃ pracaṇḍaraṇakaṇḍūḥ |
ravitejasā bhaṭānāṃ jagmuḥ samāmahetutvam ||202|| ityārṣe śrīraviṣeṇācāryaprokte śrīpadmapurāṇe lavaṇāṅa kuśasametayuddhābhidhāna dvayuttaraśataṃ parva ||102||
rahe the, jo ghoḍa़oṃke vegase uḍa़e hue sāmanta bhaṭoṃse vyāpta thā ||15|| jisameṃ mahāyoddhāoṃke śabda nikalate hue khūnake udgārase sahita the, jahā~ vegaśālī śastroṃke paḍa़nese agnikaṇoṃkā samūha utpanna ho rahā thā ||166|| jahā~ hāthiyoṃke sūsū śabdake sātha jalake chīṃṭoṃkā samūha nikala rahā thā, jahā~ hāthiyoṃke dvārā vidīrṇa vakṣaḥsthala vāle yoddhāoṃse bhūtala vyāpta thā ||167|| jahā~ idhara-udhara paḍa़e hue hāthiyoṃse yuddhakā mārga ruka jāneke kāraṇa yātāyātameṃ gaḍa़baḍa़ī ho rahī thī| jahā~ hāthī rūpī meghoṃse muktāphala rūṣī mahopaloṃ-baḍa़e baḍa़e oloṃkī varṣā ho rahī thī, ||168|| jo motiyoṃkī varṣāke samāghātase vikaṭa thā, nānā prakāra ke karmokī raṅgabhūmi thā, jahā~ hāthiyoṃ ke dvārā ukhāḍa़ kara ūpara uchāle hue punāgake vṛkṣa, vidyādharoṃkā saṃgama kara rahe the ||166|| jahā~ śiroṃke dvārā yaśarūpī ratna kharīdā gayā thā, jahā~ mūrchāse viśrāma prāpta hotā thā, aura maraṇase jahā~ nirvāṇa milatā thā ||200|| isa prakāra vīroṃ kī cāhe baḍa़ī ṭukaḍa़ī ho cāhe choṭī, sabameṃ vaha yuddha huā ki jo jīvanakī tṛṣṇāse rahita thā, jisameṃ yodhāoṃke samūha dhanya dhanya śabdarūpī samudrake lobhī the tathā jo samarasase sahita thā-kisī bhī pakṣakī jaya parājayase rahita thā ||201|| svāmīmeṃ aṭūṭa bhakti, jīvikā prāptikā badalā cukānā aura raṇakī teja khāja yahī sava sūryake samāna tejasvī yoddhāoṃke saṃgrāmake kāraṇapaneko prāpta hue the ||202|| isa prakāra ārṣa nāmase prasiddha, śrīraviṣeṇācārya dvārā kathita padmapurāṇameṃ lavaṇāṃkuśa
ke yuddhakā varṇana karane vālā eka sau dovāṃ parva samāpta huā ||102||

bhato magadharājendra bhavāvahitamānasaḥ | nivedayāmi yuddhaṃ te viśeṣakṛtavartanam || 1|| sabyeṣṭā vajrajaṅgho'bhūdanaṅgalavaṇāmbudheḥ | madanāṃkuśanāthasya pṛthuḥ prathitavikramaḥ ||2|| sumitrātanujātasya candrodaranṛpātmajaḥ | kṛtāntavaktratigmāṃśuḥ padmanābhamarutvataḥ ||3|| vajrāvattaṃ samuddhṛtya dhanuratyudhuradhvaniḥ | padmanābhaḥ kṛtāntāsyaṃ jagau gambhīrabhāratiḥ ||4|| kṛtāntavaktra vegena rathaṃ pratyari vāhaya | moghībhavattanūbhāraḥ kimevamalasāyase ||5|| so'vocava vīkṣasva vājino jarjarīkṛtān | amunā naravīreṇa suniśātaiḥ śilīmukhaḥ ||6|| amī nidrāmiva prāptā dehavidāṇakāriṇīm | dūraṃ vikāranirmuktā jātā galitaraṃhasaḥ ||7|| naite cāṭuśatānyuktāna hastatalatāḍitāḥ | vahantyāyatamaṅgaṃ tu kvaṇantaḥ kurvate param ||8|| śoṇaṃ śoṇitadhārābhiḥ kurvāṇā dharaṇītalam | anurāgamivodāraṃ bhavate darśayantyamī ||6|| imau ca paśya me bāhū śaraiḥ kakkaṭabhedibhiḥ | samutphullakadambasragguṇasāmyamupāgatau ||10|| pano'vadanmamāpyevaṃ kārmukaṃ śithilāyate | jñāyate karmanimuktaṃ citrārpitaśarāsanam ||11|| etanmuśalaratnaṃ ca kāryeṇa parivarjitam | sūryāvarttagurūbhūtaṃ dodaṇḍamupavidhyati ||12|| durvāraripunāgendrasṛṇitāṃ yacca bhūriśaḥ | gataṃ" lāgalaratnaṃ me tadidaṃ viphalaṃ sthitam ||13|| parapakṣaparikṣodadakṣāṇāṃ pārakṣiṇām | amoghānāṃ mahāstrāṇāmīdaśī vartate gatiḥ ||14||
athānantara gautama svāmī rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he magadharājendra ! sāvadhāna citta hoo aba maiṃ tere lie yuddhakā viśeṣa varṇana karatā hū~ ||11|| alaṅgalavaṇa rūpī sāgarakā sārathi vajaja thā, madanāṅkaśakā prasiddha parākramī rājā pṛthu, lakṣmaṇakā candrodarakā putra birādhita aura rāma rūpī indrakā sārathi kṛtāntavaktra rūpī sūrya thā ||2-3|| viśāla garjanā karane vāle rāmane gambhīra bāṇī dvārā vanāvarta nāmaka dhanuṣa uṭhā kara kṛtāntavaktra senāpatise kahā ||4|| ki he kṛtāntavaktra! śatrukī ora śīghra hī ratha baḍha़āo| isa taraha śarīrake bhārako śithila karate hue kyoṃ alasā rahe ho ? ||5| yaha suna kṛtāntavaktrane kahā ki he deva ! isa nara vīrake dvārā atyanta tīkṣṇa vāṇoṃse jarjara hue ina ghoḍa़oṃko dekho ||6|| ve śarīrako dūra karane vālī nidrāko hī māno prāpta ho rahe hai athavā vikārase nirmukta ho vega rahita ho rahe haiṃ ? ||7|| aba ye na to saikaḍa़oṃ mīṭhe śabda kahane para aura na hatheliyoṃse tāḍa़ita hone para śarīrako lambā karate haiṃ-śīghratāse calate hai kintu atyadhika śabda karate hue svayaṃ hī lambā śarīra dhāraṇa kara rahe hai |nāye rudhira kī dhārāse pṛthivītalako lāla lāla kara rahe haiṃ so mānoṃ āpake lie apanā mahāna anurāga hī dikhalā rahe hoṃ ||6|| aura idhara dekho, ye merī bhujāe kavacako bhedana karane vāle vāṇoṃse phūle hue kadamba puṣpoṃkī mālāke sādṛśyako prāpta ho rahī haiṃ ||10|| yaha suna rāmane bhī kahā ki isī taraha merā bhī dhanuṣa śithila ho rahā hai aura citralikhita dhanuṣakī taraha kriyā śūnya ho rahā hai ||11|| yaha muśala ratna kāryase rahita ho gayā hai aura sūryāvarta dhanuṣake kāraṇa bhārī hue bhujadaṇḍa ko pīḍa़ā pahu~cā rahā hai ||12|| jo duri śatru rūpī hāthiyoṃko vaśa karaneke lie anekoṃ bāra aṅkaśaeneko prāpta huā thā aisā yaha merā hala ratna niṣphala ho gayā hai ||13|| śatrupakṣako naṣṭa karane meṃ samartha evaṃ apane pakṣakī rakṣā karane vāle amogha mahā śastroṃkī bhī aisī daśā ho rahī hai

yathāparājitājasya vartate'narthakāstratā | tathā lakṣmīdharasyāpi madanāṅakuśagocare ||15|| vijñātajātisambandhī sāpekṣī lavaṇāṅkuśau | yuyudhāte'napekṣau tu nitiau rāmala camaṇau ||16|| tathāpyalaṃ sadivyāstro viṣādaparivarjitaḥ | prāsacakraśarāsāraṃ mumuce lakṣmaṇo'ṅkuśe ||17|| vajradaṇḍaiḥ śarairvṛṣṭiṃ tāmapākiradakuśaḥ | padmanābhavinirmuktāmanaṅgalavaṇo yathā ||18|| upavakṣastataḥ padma prāsena lavaṇo'kṣiṇot | madanāṅkuśavīraśca lacamaṇaṃ naipuṇānvitaḥ ||16|| lakṣmaṇaṃ ghūrṇamānātihṛdayaṃ vīcya sambhramī | virādhito rathaṃ cake pratīpaṃ kośalāṃ prati ||20|| tataḥ saṃjñāṃ pariprāpya rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā'nyataḥ sthitam | jagāda lacamaṇaḥ kopakapilīkṛtalocanaḥ ||21|| bho virāthita sadbuddhe kimidaṃ bhavatā kṛtam | rathaṃ nivarttaya tinaṃ raṇe pṛṣṭaṃ na dīyate ||22|| putipūritadehasya sthitasyābhimukhaṃ ripoḥ | śūrasya maraṇaṃ ślāghyaṃ nedaṃ karma jugupsitam ||23|| suramānupamadhye'smin parāmapyāpadaṃ śritāḥ | kathaṃ bhajanti kātayaṃ sthitāḥ puruṣamūrddhani ||24|| putro daśarathasyāhaṃ bhrātā lāṅgalalacamaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ kṣito khyātastasyedaṃ sadṛśaṃ katham ||25|| tvarita gaditenaivaṃ rathastena nivartitaḥ | punaryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ pratīpāgatasainikam ||26||
lakṣmaṇena tataḥ kopāsanāmāntacikīrṣayā | amoghamuddhataṃ cakraṃ devāsurabhayakkaram ||27|| ||14|| idhara lavaṇāṅkuśake viṣayameṃ jisa prakāra rāmake śastra nirarthaka ho rahe the udhara usī prakāra madanāṅkaśake viṣayameṃ lakṣmaṇake śastra bhī nirarthaka ho rahe the ||15||
gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki idhara lavaṇāṅkaśako to rāma lakṣmaṇake sātha apane jāti sambandhakā jñāna thā ataḥ ve unako apekṣā rakhate hue yuddha karate the-arthāt unheṃ ghātaka coṭa na laga jāve isalie bacā bacā kara yuddha karate the para udhara rāma lakṣmaṇako kucha jñāna nahīṃ thā isalie ve nirapekṣa ho kara yuddha kara rahe the ||16|| yadyapi isa taraha lakṣmaṇake śastra nirarthaka ho rahe the tathāpi ve divyāstrase sahita honeke kāraṇa viṣādase rahita the| abakī bāra unhoṃne aṅkuśake ūpara bhāle sāmānya cakra tathā vāṇoṃkī joradāra varṣā kī so usane vana daṇḍa tathā vāṇoṃke dvārā usa varṣāko dūra kara diyā| isī taraha anaṃgalavaṇane bhī rāmake dvārā choḍa़ā astra-vṛṣṭiko dūra kara diyā thā ||17-18||
tadanantara idhara lavaṇane vakṣaḥsthalake samīpa rāmako prāsa nāmā śastrase ghāyala kiyā aura udhara cāturyase yukta vīra madanāṃkuśane bhī lakṣmaṇake ūpara prahāra kiyā ||16|| usakī coṭase jisake netra aura hṛdaya ghūmane lage the aise lakṣmaṇako dekha virādhi tane ghabaḍa़ā kara ratha ulaṭā ayodhyākī ora phera diyā ||20|| tadanantara cetanā prāpta hone para jaba lakṣmaṇane rathako dūsarī ora dekhā taba lakṣmaṇane krodhase lāla lāla netra karate hue kahā ki he buddhiman ! virādhita ! tumane yaha kyā kiyā ? śīghra ho ratha lauṭāo| kyā tuma nahīṃ jānate ki yuddhameṃ pīṭha nahīṃ dī jātī hai ? ||21-22|| vāṇoṃse jisakā śarīra vyāpta hai aise śūra vīrakā śatruke sanmukha khaḍa़e khaḍa़e mara jānā acchā hai para yaha ghṛṇita kārya acchā nahīṃ hai ||23|| jo manuṣya, puruṣoṃke mastaka para sthita haiṃ arthāt unameṃ pradhāna haiṃ ve devoṃ aura manuṣyoṃ ke vīca parama āpattiko prāpta ho kara bhī kātaratāko kaise prāpta ho sakate haiṃ ? ||24|| maiṃ daśarathakā putra, rāmakā bhāī aura pṛthivī para nārāyaṇa nāmase prasiddha hū~ usake lie yaha kāma kaise yogya ho sakatā hai ? ||25|| isa prakāra kaha kara lakṣmaṇane śīghra hī punaḥ ratha lauṭā diyā aura punaḥ jisameṃ sainika lauṭa kara āye the aisā bhayaṃkara yuddha huā ||26||
tadanantara kopa vaśa lakṣmaṇane saṃgrāmakā anta karaneko icchāse devoṃ aura asuroṃko bhī

lavaṇāṅkuśamāhātmyaṃ tato jñātrā samantataḥ | mumoca kavacaṃ śastraṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ śokakarṣitaḥ || 43|| śrutvā tamatha vṛttāntaṃ viṣādabharapīḍitaḥ | parityaktacanurvarmā ghūrṇamānanirīkṣaṇaḥ || 44|| syandanāttarasottīrṇo duḥkhasmaraṇasaṅgataḥ | paryastacmātale padmo mūrchāmīlitalocanaḥ || 45 || candanodakasiktaśca spaṣṭāṃ samprāpya cetanām | snehākulamanā yātaḥ putrayorantikaṃ drutam ||46 || tato rathātsamuttīrya tau yuktakarakuḍmalī | tātasyānamatāṃ pādau śirasā snehasaṅgatau ||47|| tataḥ putrī pariṣvajya snehadravitamānasaḥ | vilāpamakarotpadma vāṣpadurdinitānanaḥ || 48 || hā mayā tanayau kaṣṭaṃ garbhasthau mandabuddhinā | nirdoṣau bhīṣaṇe'raṇye vimuktau saha sītayā || 46 || hāsau vipulaiḥ puṇyairmayā'pi kṛtasambhavau | udarasthau kathaṃ prāptau vyasanaṃ paramaṃ vane || 50 || hā sutau vajrajaṅgho'yaṃ vane cettatra no bhavet | paśyeyaṃ vā tadā vaktrapūrṇacandra mimaṃ kutaḥ || 51 || hā śāvakāvirasramodhainihatau na yat | tatsuraiḥ pālitau yadvā sukṛtaiḥ paramodayaiḥ || 52 || hāsau viśikhaiau patitau sayugakṣitau | bhavantau jānakī vīcya kiṃ kuryāditi vedmi na ||53|| nirvākṛtaṃ duḥkhamitarairapi duḥsaham | bhavadbhayāṃ sā suputrābhyāṃ vyājitā guṇaśālinī || 54 || bhavatoranyathābhāvaṃ pratipadya sujātayoḥ | vedmi jīvet dhruvaṃ neti jānakī śokavilā ||55|| lakṣmaṇo'pi savāṣpākṣaḥ sambhrāntaḥ śokavihvalaḥ | snehanirbharamā liṅgad vinayapraṇatāvimau ||56|| sītā parityāgakā bahuta duḥkha anubhava kiyā thā aura āpake dukhī rahate ratnoṃ kī sārthakatā nahīṃ thī ||42 ||

tadanantara siddhārtha se lavaṇāṅkuśakā māhātmya jāna kara śokase kṛśa lakṣmaṇane kavaca aura śastra choḍa़ diye ||43|| athānantara isa vṛttāntako suna jo vipādake bhārase pīḍa़ita the, jinhoṃne dhanuṣa aura kavaca choḍa़ diye the, jinake netra ghūma rahe the, jinheṃ pichale duḥkhakā smaraṇa ho āyā thā, jo baḍa़e vega se rathase utara paḍa़e the tathā mūrcchāke kāraṇa jinake nenna nimīlita ho gaye the aise rāma pṛthivītala para gira paḍa़e ||44-45|| tadanantara candana miśrita jalake sīṃcanese jaba saceta hue taba snehase ākula hṛdaya hote hue śīghra hī putroṃke samīpa cale ||46 ||

śatrudhnāthā mahīpālāḥ śrutvā vṛttāntamīdṛśam | tamuddeśaṃ gatāḥ sarve prāptāḥ prītimanuttamām ||5.7|| tataḥ samāgamo jātaḥ senayorubhayorapi | svāminoḥ saṅgame jāte sukhavismayapūrṇayoḥ ||5|| sītā'pi putramāhātmyaṃ dṛṣṭrā saṅgamameva ca | pauṇḍarīkaṃ vimānena pratītahṛdayā'gamat ||56|| avatīrya tato vyomnaḥ sambhramī janakātmajaḥ | svastrīyau nirbaṇī paśyannāliliṅga savāṣpahā ||6|| lāgūlapāṇirapyevaṃ prāptaḥ prītiparāyaṇaḥ | āliṅgati sma tau sādhu jātamityuracaranmuhuḥ ||61|| śrīvirādhitasugrīvāvevaṃ prāptau susaṅgamam | nṛpā vibhīṣaṇādyāśca susambhāṣaṇatatparāḥ ||62|| atha bhūmyomacārāṇāṃ surāṇāmiva saṅkulaḥ | jātaḥ samāgamo'tyantamahānandasamudbhavaḥ ||63|| pariprāpya paraṃ kāntaṃ panaḥ putrasamāgamam | babhāra paramāṃ lakṣmī pratinirbharamānasaḥ ||6|| mene suputralambhaṃ ca bhuvanatrayarājyataḥ | sudūramadhikaṃ ramyaṃ bhāvaṃ kamapi saṃśritaḥ ||65|| vidyādharyaḥ samānandaṃ banṛturgaganāṅgaṇe | bhūgocarastriyo bhūmau samunmattajagannibham ||66|| paraṃ kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mene nārāyaṇastathā | jitaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pramodotphullalocanaḥ ||67|| sagaro'hamimau tau me vīrabhīmabhagīrathau| iti buddhayā kṛtaupamyo dadhāra paramadya tim ||6|| panaḥ prītiṃ parāṃ bibhradajrajaṅghamapūjayat | bhāmaṇḍalasamastvaṃ me sucetā iti cāvadat ||66|| tataḥ puraiva ramyāsau punaḥ svargasamā kṛtā | sāketā nagarī bhūyaḥ kṛtā paramasundarī ||7|| ramyā yā strīsvabhāvena kalājñāna viśeṣataḥ | ācāramātrataratasyā kriyate bhūpaṇādaraḥ ||71||
bhī vinayase namrībhūta donoṃ putroṃkā baḍa़e snehake sātha āliṅgana kiyā ||56|| śatrughna ādi rājā bhī isa vṛttāntako suna usa sthānapara gaye aura sabhī uttama ānandako prāpta hue ||5|| tadanantara jaba donoṃ senāoṃke svāmī samāgama honepara sukha aura āścaryase pūrṇa ho gaye taba donoṃ senāoṃkā paraspara samāgama huā ||58|| sītā bhī putroṃkā māhātmya tathā samāgama dekha niścita hṛdaya ho vimāna dvārā pauṇḍarīkapura vāpisa lauṭa gaī ||56||
tadanantara saṃbhramase bhare bhāmaṇḍalane ākāśase utara kara ghāva rahita donoṃ bhānejoṃko sāśrudṛṣṭi se dekhate hue unakā āliṅgana kiyā ||60|| prīti prakaṭa karanemeṃ tatpara hanūmānane bhī 'bahuta acchā huā' isa śabdakā bāra-bāra uccāraṇa kara una donoṃkā āliṅgana kiyā ||61|| virādhita tathā sugrīva bhī isī taraha satsamāgamako prāpta hue aura vibhīṣaṇa ādi rājā bhī kumāroṃse vārtālāpa karanemeṃ tatpara hue ||6||
athānantara devoṃke samāna bhūmigocariyoṃ tathā vidyādharoṃkā vaha samāgama atyadhika mahān ānandakā kāraṇa huā ||63|| atyanta sundara putroṃkā samāgama pākara jinakā hṛdaya dhairyase bhara gayā thā aise rāmane utkṛṣṭa lakṣmī dhāraṇa kī ||64| kisī anirvacanīya bhāvako prāpta hue śrīrāmane una suputroṃke lābhako tīnalokake rājyase bhī kahīṃ adhika sundara mānā ||65|| vidyādharoṃkī striyā~ baḍa़e harṣake sātha ākāśarūpī ā~ganameṃ aura bhūmigocariyoṃkī striyā~ unmatta saṃsārakī nāī pṛthvīpara nṛtya kara rahī thīṃ ||66|| harṣase jinake netra phūla rahe the aise nārāyaṇane apane āpako kṛtakṛtya mānā aura samasta saṃsārako jītā huā samajhā ||67| maiṃ sagara hū~ aura ye donoṃ vīra bhīma tathā bhagīratha haiṃ isa prakāra buddhise upamāko karate hue lakṣmaṇa parama dīptiko dhāraṇa kara rahe the ||68|| paramaprītiko dhāraṇa karate hue rāmane vanajaṃghakā khūba sammāna kiyā aura kahā ki sundara hṛdayase yukta tuma mere lie bhāmaṇḍalake samāna ho ||66||

atha vijñāpito'nyasmindine haladharo nṛpaḥ | marunandana sugrīvavibhīṣaṇapuraḥsareḥ ||1|| nātha prasīda viṣaye'nyasminñjanakadehajā | duḥkhamāste samānetuṃ tāmādeśo vidhīyatām ||2|| niḥśvasya dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ kiñcidvicintya ca | tato jagāda padmābho bāṣpaśyāmitadiṅmukhaḥ || 3|| anaghaṃ vedmi sītāyāḥ śīlamuttamacetasaḥ | prāptāyāḥ parivādaṃ tu paśyāmi vadanaṃ katham ||4|| samastaṃ bhūtale lokaṃ pratyāyayatu jānakī | tatastayā samaṃ vāso bhavedeva kuto'nyathā || 5 || etasminbhuvane tasmānnṛpāḥ janapadaiḥ samam | nimaṃtrayaṃtāṃ paraṃ prītyā sakalāśca nabhaśvarāḥ || 6 || samakṣaṃ śapathaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā samyagvidhānataḥ | niraghaprabhavaṃ sītā śacīva pratipadyatām ||7|| emasviti tairevaṃ kṛtaṃ kṣepavivarjitam | rājānaḥ sarvadeśebhyaḥ sarvadigbhyaḥ samāhṛtāḥ ||8|| nānājanapadā bālavṛdvayoṣitsamanvitāḥ | ayodhyānagarīṃ prāptā mahākautukasaṃgatāḥ ||6|| asūryapaśyanāryo'pi yatrā''jagmuḥ sasaṃbhramāḥ | tataḥ kiṃ prakṛtisthasya janasyānyasya bhaṇyatām || 10 || varṣīya so'timātraṃ ye bahuvṛttāntakovidāḥ | rāṣṭraprāgraharāḥ khyātāste cānye ca samāgatāḥ ||11|| tadā dikṣu samastāsu mārgatvaṃ sarvamedinīm | nītā janasamūhena parasaṅghaṭṭamīyuṣā || 12 || turagaiḥ syandanairyugyaiḥ śibikābhimataṅgajaiḥ | anyaiśca vividhairyānairloka sampatsamāgatāḥ || 13 || āgacchadbhiḥ khagairūrdhvamadhaśca citigocaraiḥ | jagajjaṃgameveti tadā samupalacyate || 14||
athānantara kisī dina hanūmān sugrīva tathā vibhīṣaṇa ādi pramukha rājāoṃne śrī rāmase prārthanā kī ki he deva ! prasanna hoo, sītā anya deśa meṃ duḥkhase sthita hai isalie lānekī ājñā kī jāya ||1-2|| taba lambī aura garama śvāsa le tathā kṣaṇa bhara kucha vicāra kara bhāpoṃse diśāoṃ ko malina karate hue śrīrāmane kahā ki yadyapi maiṃ uttama hṛdayako dhāraṇa karane vālī sītāke śīla ko nirdoṣa jānatā hū~ tathāpi vaha yataśca lokāpavādako prāpta hai ataḥ usakā mukha kisa prakāra dekhū~ || 3-4 || pahale sītā pṛthivītala para samasta logoṃko viśvāsa utpanna karāve usake bāda hī usake sātha hamārā nivāsa ho sakatā hai anya prakāra nahīṃ ||5|| isalie isa saṃsāra meṃ deśavāsī logoṃ ke sātha samasta rājā tathā samasta vidyādhara baḍa़e premase nimantrita kiye jāveṃ || 6 || una saba ke samakṣa acchī taraha śapatha kara sītā indrāṇīke samāna niṣkalaṅka janmako prāpta ho ||7|| 'evamastu' - 'aisā hī ho' isa prakāra kaha kara unhoṃne binā kisī vilambake ukta bāta svīkṛta kī; phala svarūpa nānā deśoṃ aura samasta diśāoṃse rājā loga ā gaye ||8|| bālaka vṛddha tathā striyoṃse sahita nānā deśoṃke loga mahākautukase yukta hote hue ayodhyā nagarīko prāpta hue || 6 || sūryako nahīṃ dekhane vālī striyā~ bhī jaba saṃbhramase sahita ho vahā~ āī thīṃ taba sādhāraṇa anya manuṣyake viṣaya meṃ to kahā hī kyā jāve ? ||10|| atyanta vṛddha aneka logoṃkā hāla jānanemeṃ nipuṇa jo rāṣṭrake śreṣṭha prasiddha puruṣa the ve tathā anya saba loga vahā~ ekatrita hue || 11 | | usa samaya parama bhīḍa़ ko prāpta hue jana samūhane samasta diśāoṃ meṃ samasta pṛthivīko mārga rūpa meṃ pariṇata kara diyā thā ||12|| logoṃ ke samūha ghoḍa़e, ratha, baila, pālakī tathā nānā prakārake anya vāhanoṃke dvārā vahā~ āye the ||13|| ūpara vidyādhara ā rahe the aura nīce bhūmigocarī, isalie una sabase usa samaya yaha jagat aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno jaṃgama hī ho arthāt calane phirane vālā hī ho ||14||

pṛthivyāṃ yo'tinīco'pi sītāguṇakathārataḥ | vinītasya gṛhe tasya ratnavṛṣṭiniṃpātyatām ||31|| anurāgeṇa te dhānyarāśiṣu kṣetramānavāḥ | kurvanti sthāpanā 'sasyasampatprārthanatatparā ||32|| etatte puṣpakaṃ devi preṣitaṃ raghubhānunā | prasīdāruhyatāmetadgamyatāṃ kośalāṃ purīm ||33|| padmaḥ puraṃ ca deśaśca na śobhante tvayā vinā | yathā tarugṛhākāśaṃ latādīpendumūrttibhiḥ || 34 || mukhaṃ maithili paśyādya sadyaḥ pūrṇendurukprabhoḥ | nanu patyurvacaḥ kāryamavaśyaṃ kovide tvayā ||35|| evamukkā pradhānastrīśatottamaparicchadā | mahaddhardhā puṣpakārūḍhā tarasā nabhasā yayau ||36|| athāyodhyā purī dā bhāskaraṃ cāstasaṅgatam | sā mahendrodayodyāne ninye cintāturā niśām ||37|| yadudyānaṃ padmāyāstadāsīt sumanoharam | tadetatsmṛtapūrvāyāstasyā jātamasāmpratam || 38 || sītāśuddha canurāgādvā padmabandhāvadhodite | prasādhite'khile loke kiraṇaiḥ kiṅkarairiva || 36 || śapathādiva durvāde bhīte dhvānte kṣayaṃ gate | samīpaṃ padmanābhasya prasthitā janakātmajā ||40|| sā kareṇusamārūḍhā dormanasyāhataprabhā | bhāskarālokadṛṣṭeva sānugā''sīnmahauṣadhiḥ || 41 || tathāpyuttamanārībhirāvṛtā bhadrabhāvanā | reje sā nitarāṃ tanvī tārābhitra vidhoḥ kalā ||42|| tataḥ pariṣadaṃ pṛthvīṃ gambhīrāṃ vinayasthitām | vandyamāneḍyamānā ca dhīrā rāmāṅganāviśat ||43|| viṣādī vismayī harṣī saṃtobhī janasāgaraḥ | varddhasva jarā nandeti cakārāmreḍitaṃ svanam || 44 ||

aura jo pṛthivī meṃ atyanta nīca hone para bhī sītākī guṇa kathāmeṃ tatpara ho usa vinītake ghara meṃ ratnavarṣā kī jāya ||31|| he devi ! dhānya rūpī sampattikī icchā karane vāle kheta ke puruṣa arthāt kṛpaka loga anurāga vaśa dhānyakī rāśiyoṃ meṃ tumhārī sthāpanā karate haiṃ ? bhāvārtha - logoṃ kā viśvāsa hai ki dhānya rāśimeṃ sītākī sthāpanā karanese adhika dhānya utpanna hotā hai ||32|| he devi ! rāmacandra jī ne tumhāre lie yaha puṣpaka vimāna bhejā hai so prasanna ho kara isa para caḍha़| jāya aura ayodhyākī ora calā jāya ||33|| jisa prakāra latāke binā vṛkṣa, dīpake binā ghara aura candramā vinā ākāśa suśobhita nahīṃ hote usī prakāra tumhāre vinā rāma, ayodhyā nagarī aura deśa suśobhita nahīṃ hote ||34|| he maithili ! āja śīghra hī svāmīkā pūrṇacandra ke samāna mukha dekho | he kovide ! tumheṃ pati vacana avaśya svīkṛta karanā cāhie ||35|| isa prakāra kahane para saikaḍa़oṃ uttama striyoṃ ke parikara ke sātha sītā puṣpaka vimāna para ārūḍha ho gaī aura baḍa़e vaibhava ke sātha vegase ākāśamārgase calī || 36 || athānantara jaba use ayodhyānagarī dikhī usī samaya sūrya asta ho gayā ataḥ usane cintātura ho mahendrodaya nāmaka udyāna meṃ rātri vyatīta kī ||37|| rāmake sātha hone para jo udyāna pahale usake lie atyanta manohara jāna paḍa़tā thā vahī udyāna pichalī ghaṭanā smṛta hone para usake lie ayogya jāna paḍa़tā thā ||38||
athānantara sītākī śuddhike anurāgase hī mānoṃ jaba sūrya udita ho cukā, kiṅkaroṃ ke samāna kiraṇoṃse jaba samasta saṃsāra alaṃkṛta ho gayā aura śapathase durvāda ke samāna jaba andhakāra bhayabhīta ho kṣayako prāpta ho gayā tatra sītā rāmake samīpa calī || 36-40 || manakī aśāntise jisakī prabhā naṣṭa ho gaī thī aisī hastinīpara caḍha़ī sītā, sūryake prakāśase ālokita, parvata ke śikhara para sthita mahauṣadhi ke samāna yadyapi niṣprabha thī tathāpi uttama striyoṃ se ghirī, ucca bhāvanāvālī dubalī patalī sītā, tārāoṃse ghirī candramā kī kalāke samāna atyadhika suśobhita ho rahī thī ||41-42||

priyasya prāṇino mṛtyurvariṣṭho virahastu na | iti pūrva pratijñātaṃ mayā niścitacetasā ||85|| yadi tat kiṃ vṛthā devaiḥ prātihāryamidaṃ śaṭhaḥ | vaidehyā vihitaṃ yena yayedaṃ samanuṣṭhitam ||86|| luptakeśīmapīmā me yadi nārpayata dvatam | adya devānadevānvaḥ karomi ca jagadviyat ||7|| kathaṃ me hiyate patnī suraiyāyavyavasthitaiḥ | purastiṣṭhantu me śastraṃ gṛhantu kva nu te gatāḥ ||8|| evamādikṛtāceṣṭo lacamaṇena vinītinā | sāntvyamāno bahupāyaṃ prāptaḥ surasamāgamam ||8||
sarvabhūṣaṇamaikṣiṣṭa tataḥ śravaṇapuṅgavam | gāmbhīryadhairyasampannaṃ varāsanakṛtasthitim ||10|| jvalajjvalanato dīptiṃ bibhrāṇaṃ paramarddhikam | vahantaṃ dahanaṃ dehaṃ kaluṣasyopaseduṣām ||11|| vibudheṣvapi rājantaṃ kevalajñānatejasā | vītajīmūtasaṅghātaṃ bhānubimbamivoditam ||12|| cakṣuḥkumudvatīkāntaṃ candraṃ vā vītalānchanam | pareṇa pariveṣeṇa pravṛttaṃ dehatejasā ||13|| tamālokya muniśreṣṭhaṃ sadyogād bhraṣṭamānatam | avatīyaṃ ca nāgendrāujagāmāsya samīpatām ||14|| vidhāya cājaliṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā śāntaḥ pradakṣiṇām | trividhaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ nātho'nasīnāthamaveśmanām ||15|| munīndradeha jacchāyāstamitāṃśukirīṭakāḥ | vailacyādiva cancaddhiḥ kuṇḍalaiḥ śliṣṭagaṇḍakāḥ ||16||
āvṛta indrake samāna jāna paḍa़te the, unhoṃne lāgala nāmaka śastra hāthameṃ le rakkhā thā, taruṇa kokanada-rakta kamalake samāna unakī kānti thī aura ve kṣaṇa-kṣaṇameṃ locana banda kara lete the tadanantara uccasvarake dhāraka rāmane aise vacana kahe jo ātmīyajanoṃko bhī bhaya dene vāle the ||83-84|| unhoṃne kahā ki priya prāṇīko mṛtyu ho jānā śreṣṭha hai parantu viraha nahīṃ; isī lie maiṃne pahale hadacitta ho kara agni-praveśakī anumati dī thī ||8|| jaba yaha bāta thī taba phira kyoṃ avivekī devoṃne sītākā yaha atiśaya kiyā jisase ki usane yaha dīkṣākā upakrama kiyā ||86|| he devo! yadyapi usane keśa ukhāḍa़ liye haiṃ tathāpi tuma loga yadi usa daśāmeṃ bhī use mere lie śīghra nahīṃ sauṃpa dete ho to maiṃ ājase tumheṃ adeva kara dūṃgā-deva nahīṃ rahane dūṃgā aura jagatko ākāśa banā dūṃgā ||7|| nyāyakī vyavasthā karanevāle devoṃ dvārā merī patnī kaise harī jā sakatī hai? ve mere sāmane khaḍa़e hoṃ tathā śastra grahaṇa kareṃ, kahā~ gaye ve saba ? ||88|| isa prakāra jo aneka ceṣṭāe~ kara rahe the tathā vividha nītiko jānanevāle lakṣmaṇa jinheṃ aneka upāyoṃse sāntvanā de rahe the aise rāma, jahā~ devoṃkā samāgama thā aise udyānameṃ pahu~ce ||6||
tadanantara unhoṃne muniyoṃ meṃ śreṣṭha una sarvabhūṣaṇa kevalīko dekhā ki jo gāmbhīrya aura dhairyase sampanna the, uttama siṃhāsana para virājamāna the ||60|| jalatī huī agnise kahīṃ adhika kāntiko dhāraṇa kara rahe the, parama ṛddhiyoṃse yukta the, śaraṇāgata manuṣyoṃ ke pāpako jalānevāle śarīrako dhāraṇa kara rahe the ||61|| jo kevalajñāna rūpī tejake dvārā devoṃmeṃ bhī suśobhita ho rahe the, meghoṃke āvaraṇase rahita udita hue sūrya maṇḍalake samāna jāna paḍa़te the, ||62|| jo canurūpī kumudiniyoṃ ke lie priya the, athavā kalaṅka rahita candramāke samāna the, aura maṇḍalākāra pariṇata apane śarīra ke uttama tejase āvṛta the ||63||
tadanantara jo abhī-abhī dhyānase unmukta hue the tathā sarva surāsura jinheṃ namaskāra karate the aise una muniśreṣṭhako dekhakara rāma hāthīse nīce utara kara unake samīpa gaye ||4|| tatpaścāt gṛhasthoṃke svāmī śrīrāmane śānta ho bhaktipūrvaka añjali joḍa़ pradakṣiṇā dekara una munirājako mana-vacana-kāyase namaskāra kiyā ||65|| athānantara una munirājakī śarīra sambandhī kāntike kāraṇa jinake mukuṭa niṣprabha ho gaye the tathā lajāke kāraṇa hī māno camakate hue kuṇḍaloṃ dvārā

jinake kapola āliṅgita the, jinhoṃne bhāva pūrvaka namaskāra kiyā thā, aura jo hātha joḍa़kara mastakase lagāye hue the aise devendra vahā~ narendrake samāna yathāyogya baiṭhe the ||66-67|| nānā alaṃkāroṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle cāroṃ prakārake deva, munirājake samīpa aise dikhāī dete the māno sūryake samīpa usakī kiraṇeṃ hī ho ||68| munirājake nikaṭa sthita rājādhirāja rāma bhī aise suśobhita ho rahe the māno sumeruke śikharake samīpa kalpa vṛkṣa hī ho ||66| mukuṭa aura kuṇḍaloṃse suśobhita lakṣmaṇa bhī, kisī parvata mīpa sthita bijalīse sahita meghake samāna suśobhita ho rahe the ||100|| mahāśatruoṃko bhaya denemeṃ nipuṇa sundara śatrughna bhī dvitīya kuverake samāna suśobhita ho rahā thā ||101|| guṇa aura saubhāgyake tarakasa tathā uttama lakṣaṇoṃse yukta ve donoṃ vīra lavaṇa aura aṃkuśa sūrya aura candramāke samāna suśobhita ho rahe the ||102|| vastramātra parigrahako dhāraṇa karanevālī āryā sītā yadyapi bāhya alaṃkāroṃse sahita thī tathāpi vaha aisī saśobhita ho rahī thī māno sūrya kī mūrtise hī sambaddha ho ||103||
__ tadanantara dharmaśravaṇake icchuka tathā vinayase suśobhita samasta manuṣya aura deva jaba yathāyogya pṛthivī para baiṭha gaye taba śiṣya samūhameṃ pradhāna, abhayanināda nāmaka, dhīra vīra munine sandeha rūpī saṃtāpako śānta karaneke lie sarvabhūṣaṇa munirājase pūchā ||104-105|| tadanantara munirājane vaha vacana kahe ki jo atyanta vistṛta the, cāturyapūrṇa the, śuddha the, tattvārthake pratipādaka the, muniyoṃ ke prabodhaka the aura karmokā kṣaya karanevāle the ||106|| gautama svāmī kahate haiṃ ki usa samaya una yogirājane vidvānoṃ tathā mahātmāoṃke lie jo rahasya kahā thā vaha samudrake samāna bhārī thā| he śreṇika ! maiṃ to yahā~ usakā eka kaṇa hī kahatā hū~ ||107|| una parama yogīne jo vastutattvakā nirūpaṇa kiyā thā vaha praśasta darśana aura jñānake dhāraka puruṣoṃ ke lie ānanda denevālā thā tathā bhavya jīvoṃko iṣṭa thā ||108||

yadīyaṃ darśanaṃ jñānaṃ lokālokaprakāśakam | kṣudadravyaprakāśena naiva te bhānunā samāḥ ||13|| karasthāmalakajñānasarvabhāge'pyapuṣkalam | chamastha puruṣotpannaṃ siddhajñānasya no samam ||16|| samaṃ trikālabhedeṣu sarvabhāveṣu kevalī | jñānadaśanayuktātmā netaraḥ so'pi sarvathā ||17|| jñānadarśanabhedo'yaṃ yathā siddhetarātmanām | sukhe'pi dṛśyatāṃ tadvattathā vīrye'pi dṛśyatām ||168|| darśanajñānasaukhyāni sakalatvena tattvataḥ | siddhānāṃ kevalī vetti śeṣeṣvaupamikaṃ vacaḥ ||16|| abhavyātmabhiraprāpyamidaṃ jainendramāspadam | atyantamapi yatnāvyaiḥ kāyasaṃkleśakāribhiḥ ||20|| anādikālasambaddhāṃ viraheṇa vivarjitām | avidyāgehinī te hi śaśvadāśliṣya śerate ||20|| vimuktivanitā''śleṣasamutkaṇṭhāparāyaṇāḥ | bhavyāstu divasāna kṛcchū prerayanti tapaḥsthitāḥ ||22|| siddhiśaktivinimuktā abhavyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | bhaviṣyatsiddhayo jīvā bhavyaśabdamupāśritāḥ ||20|| jinendraśāsanādanyaśāsane raghunandana | na sarvayatnayoge'pi vidyate karmaṇāṃ yaḥ ||20|| yatkarma rupayatyajño bhūribhirbhavakoṭibhiḥ | jñānī muhūrtayogena triguptastadapohayet ||205|| pratīto jagato'pyetatparamātmā nirañjanaḥ | dṛśyate paramārthena yathā prakṣīṇakarmabhiḥ ||206|| gṛhītaṃ bahubhirviddhi lokamārgamasārakam | paramārthapariprāptyai gṛhāṇa jinaśāsanam ||207|| evaṃ raghūttamaḥ śrutvā vacaḥ sākalabhūṣaṇam | praṇipatya jagau nātha tārayā'smādbhavāditi ||20||

ka jñānī manuṣya eka muhūrtameṃ hī kṣaṇa kara detā hai||20|| yaha bāta saṃsārameṃ bhī prasiddha hai ki yathārthameṃ nirañjana-niṣkalaṅka paramātmākā darśana vahī kara pāte haiṃ jinake ki karma kṣīṇa ho gaye haiṃ ||206|| yaha sārahīna saṃsārakā mārga to aneka logoṃne pakaḍa़ rakkhā hai para isase paramārthakī prāpti nahīṃ, ataḥ paramārthakī prāptike lie eka jinaśāsanako hī grahaṇa karo ||207|| isa prakāra sakalabhūṣaṇake vacana sunakara śrīrāmane praṇāma kara kahā ki he nātha! isa saṃsāra-sāgarase pāra

bhagavādhamā madhyā uttamāśvāsudhāriṇaḥ | bhavyāḥ kena vimucyante vidhinā bhavavāsataḥ || 206 || uvāca bhagavān samyagdarśanajñānaceṣṭitam | mokṣava samuddiṣṭamidaṃ jainendraśāsane || 210|| tatvaśraddhānametasmin samyagdarśanamucyate | cetanācetanaṃ tatvamanantaguṇaparyayam ||211|| nisargādhigamadvārādbhaktyā tatvamupādadat | samyagdṛṣṭiriti prokto jīvo jinamate rataḥ || 212 || śaṅkā kāṅkṣā 'cikitsā ca paraśāsana saṃstavaḥ | pratyakṣodāradoṣādyā ete samyaktvadūṣaṇāḥ || 213 || sthairya jinavarāgāre ramaṇaṃ bhāvanā parāḥ | śaṅkādirahitatvaṃ ca samyagdarśanaśodhanam || 214|| sarvajñaśāsanoktena vidhinā jñānapūrvakam | kriyate yadasādhyena sucāritraṃ taducyate || 215|| gopāyitahṛṣīkatvaṃ vacomānasayantraṇam | vidyate yatra niṣpāpaṃ sucāritraṃ taducyate ||216 || ahiṃsā yatra bhūteṣu śraseṣu sthāvareṣu ca | kriyate nyāyayogeṣu sucāritraṃ taducyate ||217|| manaḥśrotra parihlādaṃ snigdhaṃ madhuramarthavat | śivaṃ yatra vacaḥ satyaṃ sucāritraṃ taducyate ||218|| adattagrahaṇe yatra nivṛttiḥ kriyate tridhā | dattaṃ ca gṛhyate nyāyyaṃ sucāritraṃ taducyate || 216 || surāṇāmapi sampūjyaṃ durdharaṃ mahatāmapi | brahmacaryaṃ śubhaṃ yatra sucāritraṃ taducyate || 220 || śivamārgamahāvighnamūcchatyajanapūrvakaḥ | parigrahaparityāgaḥ sucāritraṃ taducyate || 221|| parapīḍāvinirmuktaṃ dānaṃ śraddhādisaṅgatam | dīyate yannivṛttebhyaḥ sucāritraṃ taducyate ||222||

tatra sarvabhūṣaṇa bhagavān ne kahā ki jainendra śāsana - jainadharma meṃ samyagdarśana, samyagjñāna aura samyak cāritra inakī ekatā hī ko mokṣakā mārga batāyā hai || 210|| inameṃse tattvoṃkā śraddhāna karanā samyagdarśana kahalātā hai| ananta guṇa aura ananta paryāyoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālā tattva cetana, acetanake bheda se do prakārakā hai || 211 || svabhāva athavā paropadeśake dvārā bhaktipūrvaka jo tattvako grahaṇa karatā hai vaha jinamatakā śraddhālu samyagdṛṣṭi jīva kahā gayā hai || 212 || śaṅkā kāṃkṣā, vicikitsā, anyadṛṣṭi praśaṃsā aura pratyakṣa hī udāra manuṣyoṃ meṃ doṣādi lagānā- unakī nindā karanā ye samyagdarśana ke pā~ca aticāra haiṃ || 213 || pariṇāmoṃko sthiratā rakhanā, jināyatana ādi dharma kṣetroṃ meṃ ramaṇa karanā - vinayo niyamaḥ śīlaṃ jñānaṃ dānaṃ dayā damaḥ | dhyānaṃ ca yatra mokṣārtha sucāritraṃ taducyate ||223|| etadguṇasamāyuktaṃ jinendravacanoditam | śreyaḥ samprāptaye sevyaṃ cāritraṃ paramodayam ||22|| śakyaṃ karotyaśakye tu śraddhāvān svasya nindakaḥ | samyaktvasahito jantuḥ śaktaścāritrasaṅgataḥ ||225|| yatra tvete na vidyante samīcīnā mahāguṇāḥ | tatra nāsti sucāritraṃ na ca saṃsāranirgamaḥ ||226|| dayādamakṣamā yatra na vidyante na saṃvaraḥ| na jñānaṃ na parityāgastatra dharmo na vidyate ||227|| hiṃsāvitathacauryastrīsamārambhasamāśrayaḥ | kriyate yatra dharmārtha tatra dharmo na vidyate ||22|| dīkṣāmupetya yaḥ pāpe mūḍhacetāḥ pravartate | ārambhiṇo'sya cāritraṃ vimuktirvā na vidyate ||226|| paṇṇāṃ jīvanikāyānāṃ kriyate yatra pīḍanam | dharmavyājena saukhyārtha na tena śivamāpyate ||230|| vadhatāḍanabandhāṅkadohanādividhāyinaḥ | grāmakṣetrādisaktasya pravrajyā kā hatātmanaḥ ||231|| krayavikrayasaktasya paktiyācanakāriṇaḥ | sahiraṇyasya kā muktirdīkṣitasya durātmanaḥ ||232|| mardanasnānasaṃskāramālyadhapānulepanam | sevante durvidagdhā ye dīkṣitāste na mokṣagāḥ ||233|| hiṃsāṃ doṣavinimuktāṃ vadantaḥ svamanīṣayā | śāstraṃ veṣaṃ ca vṛttaṃ ca dūṣayanti samūḍhakāḥ ||23|| ekarātraṃ vasan grāme nagare pañcarātrakam | nityamūrddhabhujastiṣṭhan māse māse ca pārayan ||235|| mṛgaiḥ samamaraṇyānyāṃ śayāno vicarannapi | kurvannapi bhūgoḥ pātaṃ maunavānniḥparigrahaḥ ||236|| mithyādarśanaduṣṭātmā kuliṅgo bījavarjitaḥ | padbhyāmagamyadeśaṃ vā naivāpnoti śivālayam ||237||
samyakcāritra kahate haiṃ ||222|| jisameṃ vinaya, niyama, śīla, jñāna, dayā, dama aura mokṣake lie dhyāna dhāraṇa kiyā jātā hai use samyakcāritra kahate haiṃ ||223|| isa prakāra ina guṇoṃse sahita, 'jina śāsanameṃ kathita, parama abhyudayakā kāraṇa jo samyakcāritra hai, kalyāṇa prāptike lie usakā sevana karanā cāhie ||225|| samyagdṛṣṭi jīva śakya kāryako karatā hai aura aśakya kāryakī
ddhā rakhatā hai parantu jo śakta arthāt samartha hotā hai vaha cāritra dhāraṇa karatā hai ||22|| jisameṃ pūrvokta samocīna mahāguṇa nahīṃ haiṃ usameṃ samyakcāritra nahīṃ hai, aura na usakā saṃsārase nikalanā hotā hai ||226|| jisameṃ dayā, dama, kṣamā nahīṃ haiṃ, saṃvara nahīṃ hai, jñāna nahīṃ hai, aura parityāga nahīṃ haiṃ usameṃ dharma nahīṃ rahatā ||227|| jisameṃ dharmake lie hiṃsā, mūṭha, corī, kuśīla aura parigrahakā āśraya kiyā jātā hai vahā~ dharma nahīṃ hai ||228|| jo mūrkha hṛdaya dīkṣā lekara pāpameṃ pravṛtti karatā hai usa ārambhīke na cāritra hai aura na use mukti prāpta hotī hai ||226|| jisameṃ dharmake bahāne sukha prāpta karaneke lie chaha kāyake jīvoṃkī pīḍā kī jātī hai usa dharmase kalyāṇakī prāpti nahīṃ hotī ||230|| jo māranā, tāḍanā, bā~dhanā, ā~kanā tathā dohanā ādi kārya karatā hai tathā gā~va, kheta ādimeṃ āsakta rahatā hai usa anātmajñakā dīkṣā lenā kyā hai ? ||231|| jo vastuoṃke kharīdane aura beṃcane meṃ āsakta hai, svayaṃ bhojanādi pakātā hai athavā dūsarese yācanā karatā hai, aura svarṇādi parigraha sātha rakhatā hai, aise ātmahīna dīkṣita manuṣyako kyā mukti prāpta hogī ? ||232|| jo avivekī manuṣya dīkṣita hokara mardana, snāna, saṃskāra, mālā, dhūpa tathā vilepana ādikā sevana karate haiṃ ve mokṣagāmī nahīṃ haiṃ-unheṃ mokṣa prāpta nahīṃ hotā ||233|| jo apanī buddhise hiṃsāko nirdoṣa kahate hue śāstra veṣa tathā cāritrameṃ doṣa lagāte haiṃ ve mūḍha़tāse sahita haiṃ-mithyādṛṣṭi haiṃ ||234|| jo gā~vameṃ eka rāta aura nagarameṃ pā~ca rāta rahatā hai, nirantara ūparakī ora bhujā uṭhāye rahatā hai, mahīne-mahīne meṃ eka bāra bhojana karatā hai, mṛgoṃ ke sātha aṭavīmeṃ śayana karatā hai, unhīṃke sātha vicaraṇa karatā hai, bhṛgupāta bhī karatā hai, maunase
rahatā hai, aura parigrahakā tyāga karatā hai, vaha mithyā darśanase dūṣita honeke kāraṇa kuliṅgī hai . tathā mokṣake kāraṇa jo samyagdarśanādi unase rahita hai| aisā jīva pairoṃse calakara kisī agamya

pabhapurāṇe
anivāripraveśādipāpaṃ dharmadhiyā śrayan | prayāti durgatiṃ jīvo mūḍhaḥ svahitavamani ||238|| raudrārtadhyānasaktasya sakāmasya kukarmaṇaḥ | upāyaviparītasya jāyate ninditā gatiḥ ||23|| mithyādarśanayukto'pi yo dadyātsādhvasādhuṣu | dharmabuddhirasau puṇyaṃ badhnāti vipalodayama ||24|| bhukṣāno'pi phalaṃ tasya dharmasyāsau triviṣṭape | lakṣabhāgadalenā'pi samyagdṛṣṭena sasmitaḥ ||24|| sāpagdarśanamuttuṅga suślādhyāḥ saṃvahanti ye | devalokapradhānāste bhavanti niyamapriyāḥ ||242|| kle śivā'pi mahāyatnaṃ mithyādṛṣṭiḥ kuliṅgakaḥ | devakiṅkarabhāvena phalaṃ hīnamavāśnute ||243|| saptāṣṭasu nṛdevatvabhavasaṅkrāntisaukhyabhāk | śramaṇatvaṃ samāśritya samyagdṛṣṭivimucyate ||244|| vītarāgaiḥ samasta rimaṃ mārga pradarśitam | jantuviṣayamūḍhātmā pratipattu na vāñchati ||245|| āśāpāśadṛḍhaṃ baddhā mohenādhiṣṭhitā bhṛśam | tṛṣṇāgāraṃ samānītāḥ pāpahiñjīravāhinaḥ ||246|| rasanaṃ sparśanaṃ prāpya duḥkhasaukhyābhimāninaḥ | varākā vividhā jīvāḥ kliśyante śaraṇojjhitāḥ ||247|| "bibheti mṛtyuto nāsya tato mokṣaḥ prajāyate | kākṣatyanārataṃ saukhyaṃ na ca lābho'sya siddhayati ||248|| ityayaṃ bhītikāmābhyāṃ viphalābhyāṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ | kevalaṃ tāpamāyāti cetano nirupāyakaḥ ||24|| āśayā nityamāviṣṭo bhogān bhoktuṃ samīhate | na karoti tiṃ dharma kāñcane maśako yathā ||250||
sthāna athavā mokṣako prāpta nahīṃ kara sakatā ||235-237|| jo dharma buddhise agnipraveśa tathā jalapraveśa ādi pāpa karatā hai vaha ātmahitake mārgameṃ mūḍha hai aura durgatiko prāpta hotā hai ||238|| jo raudra aura ārtadhyānameṃ āsakta hai, kāmapara jisane vijaya prāpta nahīṃ kī hai, jo khoṭe kāma karatā hai tathā upāyase viparīta pravṛtti karatā hai usakī nindita gati-kugati hotī hai ||23|| jo manuṣya mithyādarśanase yukta hokara bhī dharma buddhise sādhu aura asādhuke lie dāna detā hai vaha vipula abhyudayako denevāle puṇya karmakā bandha karatā hai ||240|| yadyapi aisā jīva svargameṃ usa dharmakā phala bhogatā hai tathāpi vaha samyagdṛṣṭiko prāpta honevāle phalake lākhameṃse eka bhāgake bhī barābara nahīṃ hai ||241|| jo manuṣya utkṛṣṭa samyagdarśana dhāraṇa karate haiṃ tathā cāritrase prema rakhate haiṃ ve isa lokameṃ bhī praśaṃsanīya hote haiṃ aura maraneke bāda devalokameṃ pradhāna hote haiṃ ||242|| mithyādṛṣṭi kuliṅgī manuṣya, baḍa़e prayatnase kleśa uṭhākara bhī devoṃkā kiṅkara bana tuccha phalako prāpta hotā hai| bhāvāthe-mithyādṛṣṭi kuliṅgī manuṣya yadyapi tapaścaraṇake aneka klaśa uṭhātā hai tathāpi vaha usake phalasvarūpa svargameṃ uttama pada prāpta nahīṃ kara pātā kintu devoṃkā kiṅkara hokara hīna phala prāpta kara pātā hai ||243|| samyagdṛṣṭi manuṣya, sāta āṭha bhavoṃmeṃ manuṣya
aura deva paryāyameṃ paribhramaṇase utpanna hue sukhako bhogatā huā antameṃ munidīkṣā dhāraṇakara mukta ho jātā hai ||244|| vītarāga sarvajña devake dvārā dikhāye hue isa mārgako, viṣayī manuṣya prāpta nahīṃ karanā cāhatā ||245|| jo āśārūpī pāśase majabūta ba~dhe haiṃ, mohase atyadhika ākrānta haiṃ, tṛṣṇārūpī gharameṃ lākara ḍāle gaye haiṃ, pāparūpī jañjīrako dhāraṇa kara rahe haiṃ tathā sparśa aura rasako pākara jo daḥkhako hī sakha māna baiṭhe haiṃ isa taraha nānā prakārake śaraṇa rahita becāre dīna prāṇī nirantara kleśa uṭhāte rahate haiṃ ||246-24|| yaha prāṇī mṛtyuse ḍaratā hai para usase chuṭakārā nahīṃ ho pātā | isī prakāra nirantara sukha cāhatā hai para usakī prāpti nahīṃ ho pātī ||248|| isa prakāra niṣphala bhaya aura kāmase vaśa huā yaha prāgo nirupāya ho mātra saṃtāpako prāpta hotā rahatā hai ||246| nirantara āśāse ghirā huā yaha prāṇo bhoga bhoganekī ceṣṭā karatā hai parantu jisa prakāra macchara svarṇameṃ saṃtoṣa nahīṃ karatā usī

udyāne'vasthitasyāsya tatra jñāsvā jano'khilaḥ | vandanāmagamat kartuṃ sammadālāpatatparaḥ ||2|| stuvato'sya paraṃ bhaktyā nādaṃ dhanakulopamam | karṇamādāya saṃśrusya śrīcandro'pṛcchadantikān ||3|| kasyaiṣa śrayate nādo mahāsāgarasammitaḥ | ajānadbhiḥ samādiṣṭastairamātyaḥ kṛto'ntikaḥ ||4|| jñāyatāṃ kasya nādo'yamiti rājñā sa bhāṣitaḥ | gatvā jñāsvā parāvṛtya muni prāptamavedayat ||85|| tato vikacarājīvarājamānanirīkṣaṇaḥ | sastrīkaḥ sammadodbhutapulakaḥ prasthito nṛpaḥ ||86|| prasannamukhatāreśaṃ nirīkṣya munipuṅgavam | sambhramī śirasā natvā nyasīdadvinayādbhuvi ||8|| bhavyāmbhojapradhānasya munibhāskaradarśane | tasyāsīdātmasaṃvedyaḥ ko'pi premamahābharaḥ||8|| tataḥ paramagambhīraḥ sarvaśrutiviśāradaḥ | adājanamahaughāya munistatvopadeśanam ||86|| anagāraṃ sahāgāraṃ dharma 'dvividhamabravīt | anekabhedasaṃyuktaṃ saṃsārottāraṇāvaham ||10|| karaṇaṃ caraṇaṃ dravyaṃ prathamaṃ ca sabhedakam | anuyogamukhaṃ yogī jagāda vadatāṃ varaḥ ||11|| ākṣepaṇī parākṣepakāriṇīmakarot kathām | tato nikṣepaṇī tatvamatanikṣepakovidām ||12|| saṃvejanī ca saṃsārabhayapracayabodhanīm | nivedanī tathā puṇyāṃ bhogavairāgyakāriṇīm ||13|| sandhāvato'sya saṃsāre karmayogena dehinaḥ | kṛcchreṇa mahatā prāptirmuktimārgasya jāyate ||6||
samādhigupta nāmaka bhunirāja usa nagara meṃ āye ||81|| 'munirāja ākara udyānameṃ ṭhahare haiṃ |' yaha jānakara munikī vandanā karaneke lie nagarake saba loga harṣapūrvaka bāta cīta karate hue udyānameṃ gaye ||52|| bhaktipūrvaka stuti karanevāle janasamūhakā meghamaṇḍalake samāna jo bhārī śabda ho rahā thā use kāna lagākara śrīcandrane sunā aura nikaṭavartī logoṃse pūchā ki yaha mahāsāgarake samāna
śabda sanāī de rahā hai? jina logoṃse rājāne pachā thā ve usa śabdakā kāraṇa nahīṃ jānate the isalie unhoṃne mantrīko rājāke nikaṭa kara diyā ||83-84|| taba rājāne matrīse kahā ki mālūma karo yaha kisakā śabda hai ? isake uttara meṃ maṃtrīne jākara tathā saba samācāra jānakara vāpisa ā nivedana kiyā ki udyānameṃ munirāja āye haiṃ ||8||
tadanantara jisake netra khile hue kamalake samāna suśobhita ho rahe the tathā jisake harṣake romāśca uṭha āye the aisā rājā śrīcandra apanī strīke sātha munivandanāke lie calā ||86|| vahā~ prasanna mukhacandrake dhāraka munirājake darśana kara rājāne śīghratāse śira jhukākara unheṃ namaskāra kiyā aura usake bāda vaha vinayapūrvaka pṛthivī para baiṭha gayā ||87|| bhavyarūpī kamaloṃmeṃ pradhāna rājā śrīcandrako manirūpī sarya ke darśana honepara apane āpa anubhavameṃ āne yogya koī adbhata mahāprema utpanna huā ||8|| tatpaścāt paramagambhīra aura sarvaśāstroṃke viśārada munirājane usa apāra janasamūhake lie tattvoṃkā upadeśa diyā ||8| unhoṃne kahā ki avāntara aneka bhedoṃse sahita tathā saṃsāra sāgarase tārane vālā dharma, anagāra aura sāgārake bhedase do prakārakā hai||60ll vaktāoṃ meṃ śreṣṭha munirājane anuyoga dvārase varṇana karate hue kahā ki anuyogake 1 prathamānuyoga 2 karaṇānuyoga 3 caraṇānuyoga aura 4 dravyānuyogake bhedase cāra bheda haiṃ ||61|| tadanantara unhoṃne anya mata-matāntaroṃko ālocanā karanevālī ākṣepaṇī kathā kī| phira svakīya tattvakā nirūpaṇa karane meṃ nipuṇa nikṣepaṇī kathā kī| tadanantara saṃsārase bhaya utpanna karanevālī saṃvejanī kathā kī aura usake bāda bhogoṃse vairāgya utpanna karanevālī puṇyavardhaka nivedanī kathā kī ||62-63|| unhoṃne kahā ki karmayogase saṃsāra meṃ dauḍa़ lagānevāle isa prāṇīko mokṣamārgakī prāpti baḍa़e kaṣṭase

sandhyābuburaphenormi vidyudindradhanuḥsamaḥ | bhāratvena loko'yaṃ na kiṭhicadiha sārakam ||15|| narake duḥkhamekāntādeti tiryakṣu vā'sumān | manuṣyatridaśānāṃ ca sukhenaivaiṣa tṛpyati ||36|| māhendrabhogasampadbhiryo na tṛptimupāgataḥ | sa kathaṃ kṣudrakaistṛti brajenmanujabhogakaiḥ ||17|| kathañcid durlabhaṃ labdhvā nidhānamadhano yathā| naratvaṃ muhyati vyartha viṣayāsvādalobhataḥ ||18|| kāgneḥ śuṣkandhanaistṛptiḥ kāmbudherāpagājalaiḥ | viṣayāsvādasaukhyaiḥ kā tṛptirasya śarīriṇaḥ ||16|| majaśiva jale khiso viṣayāmiṣamohitaḥ | dakṣo'pi mandasāmeti tamo'ndhīkṛtamānasaḥ ||10|| divā tapati tigmāṃśumadanastu divāniśam | samasti vāraṇaṃ bhānomadanasya na vidyate ||10|| janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhaṃ saṃsāre smṛtibhītidam | arahaghaṭīyantrasantataṃ karmasambhavam ||102|| ajaṅgamaṃ yathā'nyena yantraṃ kṛtaparibhramam | śarīramadhavaṃ pūti tathā sneho'tra mohataḥ ||103|| jalabubudaniḥsāraṃ jñātvā manujasambhavam | nirviṇṇāḥ kulajā mārga prapadyante jinoditam ||10|| utsāhakavacacchannā niścayāśvasthasādinaḥ | dhyānakhaḍgadharā dhīrāḥprasthitāḥ sugati prati ||105|| anyaccharīramanyo'hamiti sañcintya niścitāḥ| tathā śarīrake snehaṃ dharma kuruta mānavāḥ ||106|| sukhaduḥkhādayastulyāḥ svajanetarayoḥ samāḥ | rāgadveṣavinirmuktāḥ śramaṇāḥ puruṣottamāḥ ||10|| vairiyaṃ paramodārā dhavaladhyānatejasā | kṛtsnā karmāṭavī dagdhā duḥkhaśvāpadasakulā ||10||
hotī hai ||64|| yaha saṃsāra vināśī honeke kāraṇa saṃndhyā, babūle, phena, taraṅga, bijalī aura indradhanuṣake samāna hai | isameṃ kucha bhī sāra nahīṃ hai ||65|| yaha prāṇī naraka athavā tiryaścagatimeṃ ekānta rūpase duḥkha hī prāpta karatā hai aura manuṣya tathā devoṃke sukhameṃ yaha tṛpta nahīṃ hotā hai ||66|| jo indra sambandhī bhoga-sampadāoṃse tṛpta nahīṃ huā vaha manuṣyoṃke kṣudra bhogoṃse kaise tṛpta ho sakatā hai ? ||67|| jisa prakāra nidhana manuṣya kisī taraha durlabha khajānā pākara yadi pramāda karatā hai to usakā vaha khajānā vyartha calā jātā hai| isī prakāra yaha prāṇī kisī taraha durlabha manuṣya paryāya pākara viṣaya svādake lobhameṃ paḍa़ yadi pramāda karatā hai to usakī manuṣyaparyāya vyartha calī jātī hai ||18|| sūkhe īndhanase agnikī tṛpti kyā hai ? nadiyoṃke jalase samudrako tṛpti kyā hai ? aura viṣayoṃke āsvāda-sambandhī sukhase saṃsārī prāṇīko tṛpti kyā hai ? ||6jalameṃ ḍūbate hue khinna manuṣyake samāna viṣaya rūpī āmiṣase mohita huā catura manuṣya bhī mohāndhīkṛta citta hokara mandatāko prāpta ho jātā hai ||100|| sūrya to dinameṃ hī tapatā hai para kāma rāta dina tapatā rahatā hai | sūryakā āvaraṇa to hai para kāmakā āvaraṇa nahīṃ hai ||101|| saṃsārameṃ arahaṭakī ghaṭīke samāna nirantara karmoṃ se utpanna honevālā jo janma, jarā
aura mṛtyu sambandhī duḥkha hai vaha smaraṇa āte hī bhaya dene vālā hai ||102|| jisa prakāra ajaṃgama yantra jaṃgama prāṇīke dvārā ghumāyā jātā hai usī prakāra yaha anitya tathā bībhatsa śarīra bhī cetana dvārā ghumāyā jātā hai| isa śarīrameṃ jo sneha hai vaha mohake kāraṇa hī hai ||103|| yaha manuṣya janma pānīke babūleke samāna niḥsāra hai aisā jānakara kulīna manuṣya virakta ho jinapratipādita mārgako prāpta hote haiṃ ||104|| jo utsāha rūpī kavacase ācchādita haiṃ, niścaya rūpī ghoḍa़epara savāra haiṃ aura dhyānarūpī khaṅgako dhāraṇa karanevāle haiṃ aise dhīra vīra manuṣya sugatike prati prasthāna karate haiṃ ||10|| he mānavo! śarīra judā hai aura maiṃ judā hū~ aisā vicāra kara niścaya karo tathā śarīrameṃ sneha choḍa़kara dharma karo ||106|| jinheṃ sukha-duḥkhādi samāna haiṃ, jo svajana aura parajanoṃ meṃ samāna haiṃ tathā rāga-dveṣa ādise rahita haiṃ aise muni hī puruṣottama haiṃ ||107| unhīṃ

mohena nindanaḥ straiṇanidānara bhigṛhanaiḥ | strītvamuttamaduḥkhāktaṃ bhajamānā' punaḥ punaḥ ||13|| sādhuṣvavarṇavādena duravasthāvalīkṛtā | pariprāptā kareṇutvamāsīnmandākinītaṭe ||138|| sumahāpavanirmanā parāyattasthirānikā | vimuktamandasūtkārā mukulīkṛtalocanā ||136|| mumūrṣantī samālokya khecareṇa kṛpāvatā | taraṅgaveganāmnāsau karṇajapamupāhṛtā ||14|| tatastanukaṣāyatvāttatkṣetraguṇato'pi ca | pratyākhyānācca tahattācchrībhūteḥ sā sutā'bhavat ||141|| bhikṣārthina muni gehaṃ praviṣṭamavalokya sā | upahāsāttataḥ pitrā śāmitā śrāvikā'bhavat ||142|| tasyāḥ paramarūpāyāḥ sukanyāyāḥ kṛte'vanī | utkaṇṭhitā mahīpālāḥ śambhusteṣu viśeṣataḥ ||143|| mithyāiṣṭiḥ kubereṇa samo bhavati yadyapi | tathā'pi nāsmai deyeyaṃ pratijñeti purodhasaḥ ||144|| tataḥ prakupitenāsau śambhunā śayito niśi | hisitaḥ suratāṃ prāpto jinadharmaprasādataḥ ||145|| tato vedavatīmenāṃ pratyakṣāṃ devatāmiva | anicchantīṃ prabhutvena balādudvoḍhumudyataḥ ||146|| manasā kāmataptena tāmāliṅgayopacumbya ca | visphurantī ratiṃ sākṣānmaithunenopacakrame ||147|| tataḥ prakupitātyantaṃ caṇḍā vahniśikheva sā | viraktahṛdayā bālā vepamānaśarīrikā ||148|| ātmanaḥ śīlanāśena vadhena janakasya ca | vināṇā paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāha lohitalocanā ||146|| vyāpāya pitaraṃ pāpa kāmitā'smi balena yat | bhavadvadhārthamutpatsye tato'haṃ puruṣādhama ||150||
ho karmoṃ ke prabhāvase tiryaśca yonimeṃ cirakāla taka bhramaṇa karatī rahī ||136|| vaha moha, nindā, strī sambandhī nidāna tathā apavāda ādike kāraṇa bāra-bāra tīvra duḥkhase yukta strīparyāyako prāpta karatī rahī ||137|| tadanantara sādhaoṃkā avarṇavāda karaneke kāraṇa vaha daḥkhamayī avasthāse dukhī hotī huī gaṅgā nadīke taṭapara hathinī huī ||138|| vahā~ vaha bahuta bhārī kīcaḍa़meṃ phaṃsa gaī jisase usakā śarīra ekadama parādhīna hokara acala ho gayā| vaha dhīre-dhīre sū-sū śabda choḍa़ne lagī tathā netra bandakara maraṇāsanna avasthāko prāpta huī ||136|| tadanantara use maratī dekha taraṅgavega nāmaka dayālu vidyādharane use kānameṃ namaskāra mantrakā jāpa sunāyā ||140|| usa mantra ke prabhāvase usakī kaṣāya manda paḍa़ gaī, usane usī sthānakā kṣetra saṃnyāsa dhāraṇa kiyā tathā ukta vidyādharane use pratyākhyāna-saṃyama diyā| ina saba kāraṇoṃke milanese vaha śrībhūtināmaka purohitake vedavatī nāmakī putrī huī ||141|| eka bāra bhikṣāke lie gharameṃ praviṣṭa muniko dekhakara usane unakī ha~sī kī taba pitāne use samajhāyā jisase vaha śrāvikā ho gaī ||142|| vedavatī parama sundarī kanyā thī ataḥ use prāpta karaneke lie pṛthivītalake rājā atyanta utkaṇṭhita the
aura unameṃ śambhu viśeṣa rūpase utkaṇṭhita thā ||143|| purohitakī yaha pratijñā thī ki yadyapi mithyādṛṣṭi puruṣa sampattimeṃ kuberake samāna ho tathāpi usake lie yaha kanyā nahīṃ dūṃgā ||144|| isa pratijñāse śambhu bahuta kupita huā aura usane rātrimeṃ sote hue purohitako māra ḍālā | puro. hita marakara jinadharmake prasādase deva huā||145||
tadanantara jo sākṣāt devatāṃke samāna jāna paḍa़tī thī aisī isa vedavatīko usakī icchā na rahanepara bhī śambhu apane adhikārase balāt vivāhaneke lie udyata huā ||146|| sākṣāt ratike samāna śobhāyamāna usa vedavatīkā śambhune kāmake dvārā saṃtapta manase āliṅgana kiyā| cumbana kiyā aura usake sātha balāt maithuna kiyā ||147|| tadanantara jo atyanta kupita thī, agniśikhāke samāna tīkṣṇa thī, jisakā hṛdaya virakta thā, śarīra kā~pa rahā thā, jo apane śīla ke nāśa aura pitāke vadhase tīvra duḥkha dhāraṇa kara rahī thī-tathā jisake netra lāla-lāla the aisī usa vedavatīne śambhuse kahā ki are pāpī ! nīca puruṣa ! tūne pitāko mārakara balāt mere
1. bhajamānāḥ ma0 | 2. kāmatṛsena ma0 | 3. -mutpaśye ma0 |

310
padmapurāṇe
paralokagatasyāpi piturnāhaṃ manoratham | lumpāmi tena duīṣṭikāmanānmaraṇaṃ varam ||15|| harikāntāryikāyāśca pāvaṃ gatvā sasambhramam | pravrajya sākarodvālā tapaḥ paramaduṣkaram ||152|| luñcanotthitasaṃhakṣamūrddhajā māṃsavarjitā | prakaṭāsthisirājālā tapasā śuṣkadehikā ||153|| kāladharma pariprāpya brahmalokamupāgatā | puṇyodayasamānītaṃ surasaukhyamasevata ||15|| tayā virahitaḥ śambhulaṃdhutvaṃ bhuvane gataḥ| vibandhubhṛtyalacamīko prāpadunmattatāṃ kudhīḥ ||155|| mithyābhimānasammūḍho jinavākyātparāṅmukhaḥ | isati śramaṇān dṛṣṭā durukte ca pravartate ||156|| madhumāṃsasurāhāraḥ pāpānumananodyataḥ | tiryaṅnarakavāseṣu suduḥkheṣvabhramacciram ||157|| athopaśamanāskiñcitkarmaṇaḥ keśakāriṇaḥ | kuśadhvajasya viprasya sāvitryāṃ tanayo'bhavat ||158|| prabhāsakundanāmāsau prāpya bodhi sudūrlabhām | pāca~ vicitrasenasya munedardīkṣāmasevata ||15|| vimuktaratikandarpagarvasaṃrambhamatsaraḥ | nirvikārastapaścakre dayāvānirjitendriyaḥ ||16|| ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamā māsādinirāhāraḥ spṛhojjhitaḥ| yatrāstamitanilayo vasan śūnyavanādiṣu ||161|| guṇaśīlasusampannaḥ parīṣahasahaḥ paraḥ | ātāpanarato grīṣme pinaddhamalakañcukaḥ ||162|| varṣāsu meghamuktābhiradbhiḥ klinnastaroravaḥ | prāleyapaṭasaṃvīto hemante pulinasthitaḥ || 163||
evamādi kriyāyuktaḥ so'nyadā siddhamandiram | sammedaṃ vandituṃ yātaḥ smṛtamapyaghanāśanam ||16|| sātha kāma sevana kiyā hai, isalie maiṃ tere vadhake lie hī āgāmī paryāyameṃ utpanna hoū~gī| yadyapi mere pitā paraloka cale gaye haiṃ tathāpi maiṃ unakī icchā naṣṭa nahīṃ karū~gī| mithyādṛṣṭi puruṣako cāhanekī apekṣā mara jānā acchā hai ||148-151||
tadanantara usa bālāne śīghra hī harikāntā nāmaka āryikāke pāsa jākara dīkṣā le atyanta kaṭhina tapaścaraṇa kiyā ||152|| loṃca karaneke bāda usake śirapara rūkhe bāla nikala āye the, tapake kāraṇa usakā śarīra aisā sūkha gayā thā māno māṃsa usameṃ hai hī nahīṃ aura haḍḍī tathā nasoṃkā samūha spaṣṭa dikhāī dene lagā thā ||153|| āyuke antameṃ maraṇa kara vaha brahmasvarga gaī | vahā~ puṇyodayase prāpta hue devoṃke sukhakā upabhoga karane lagī ||154|| vedavatīse rahita śambhu, saṃsārameṃ ekadama hīnatāko prāpta ho gayā, usake bhāī-bandhu, dāsī-dāsa tathā lakṣmī ādi saba chūṭa gaye aura vaha darbaddhi unmatta avasthāko prāpta ho gayā ||155|| vaha maṭha-mūṭhake abhimānameṃ cūra ho rahā thā tathā jinendra bhagavānke vacanoṃse parāṅmukha rahatā thā| vaha muniyoṃko dekha unakī ha~sī uḍa़ātā tathā unake prati duṣṭa vacana kahatā thā ||156|| isa prakāra madhu māṃsa aura madirā hī jisakā āhāra thā tathā jo pāpakī anumodanā karane meṃ udyata rahatā thā aisā śambhu tīvra duḥkha denevāle naraka aura tiryaścagatimeṃ cirakāla taka bhramaṇa karatā rahā ||157||
athānantara duḥkhadāyī pāpa karmakā kucha upaśama honese vaha kuśadhvaja brāhmaṇakī sāvitrī nāmaka strī meṃ putra utpanna huā ||158|| prabhāsakunda usakā nāma thā | phira atyanta durlabha ratnatrayako pākara usane vicitrasena munike samīpa dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||156|| jisane rati kāma, garva, krodha tathā matsarako choḍa़ diyā thā, jo dayālu thā tathā indriyoṃko jītanevālā thā aise usa prabhāsakundane nirvikāra hokara tapaścaraṇa kiyā ||160|| vaha do dina, tīna dina tathā eka pana ādike upavāsa karatā thā, usakī saba prakārako icchāe~ chūṭa gaī thīṃ, jahā~ sūrya asta ho jātā thā vahīṃ vaha śūnya vana ādimeṃ ṭhahara jātā thā ||161|| guṇa aura śīlase sampanna tha', parīpahīko sahana karanevālā thā, grīṣmaṛtumeṃ ātāpanayoga dhāraṇa karane meṃ tatpara rahatā thā, malarūpī kañcuka se sahita thā, varṣāṛtumeṃ vṛkṣake nīce meghoṃke dvārā choḍa़e hara jalase bhīgatā rahatā thā aura hemantaṛtumeṃ barpharūpī vastrase āvṛta hokara nadiyoṃke taṭa para sthita rahatā thā, ityādi kriyāoṃse yukta huā vaha prabhāsakunda kisī samaya usa siddhakṣetra sammedaśikharakī vandanā karaneke lie gayā
